article.articleHeadline: Support Vector Machine Leads Prediction of Infection After Open Pulmonary
article.articleSummary: West China Hospital evaluated nine machine-learning models using 14 clinical variables to predict postoperative infection after open pulmonary lobectomy in 3,160 patients treated from 2017–2025; 369 infections occurred (11.68%). Respiratory tract infections (6.17%) and surgical site infections (5.38%) were the main complications, with deep organ/space infections comprising 70.59% of SSIs. The support vector machine showed the strongest discrimination (AUC 0.645; 95% CI 0.589–0.700), followed by random forest (0.632) and logistic regression (0.624). K-nearest neighbors had the highest accuracy (0.806) and specificity (0.887); SVM had the highest sensitivity (0.586) and negative predictive value (0.921). Random forest posted the top F1 (0.276). Calibration varied (Brier 0.156–0.241). Decision-curve analysis showed net benefit at low thresholds (0.01–0.11). SHAP highlighted age, total surgical duration, and preoperative hospital stay as key predictors across models. Conclusion: ML risk stratification using pre/intraoperative data shows potential and warrants external validation.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can you still get Influenza B after getting H1N1? China CDC's latest assessment: three strains circulating simultaneously, with no cross-protection.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are circulating in China—A(H3N2), A(H1N1)pdm09, and B(Victoria)—with no cross-protection between them, meaning infection with one strain does not guard against others and may raise sequential infections and extend the flu season. Between Oct 26 and Nov 1, influenza-like illness accounted for 4.1% of outpatient/ED visits; southern provinces reported 4.8% versus 3.3% in the north. Nationwide, A(H1N1)pdm09 proportion is rising within the A group, while A(H3N2) remains prevalent and B(Victoria) common; southern regions show higher activity. Lab-confirmed positives: 65.4% influenza A, 34.6% influenza B; among A, 51.2% A(H1N1)pdm09 and 48.8% A(H3N2); B all Victoria. A total of 106 influenza-like outbreaks were reported; breakdown includes 12 A(H3N2), 21 A(H1N1)pdm09, 7 A (unspecified), 17 B(Victoria), 4 B (unspecified), 23 mixed, 3 negative, 19 pending, with ages 5–14 most affected.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Medical Services warns that monkeypox can be transmitted through close contact; if there is a history of exposure or abnormal lesions, seek prompt examination and treatment.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) remains a concern in Thailand, per the Institute of Dermatology, Department of Medical Services. Transmission occurs via close contact and can spread through shared items (towels, clothing, bedding) and respiratory droplets, not limited to sexual activity; kissing is noted. People with exposure history or abnormal skin lesions should seek prompt examination; casual proximity or common settings without contact is not a high-risk transmission route. Diagnosis combines exposure history and skin lesion appearance with PCR confirmation from lesions or mucous membranes. Some patients may lack lymphadenopathy; cases may present with isolated lesions, sometimes only in genital, anal, or oral regions. The incubation is about 3–17 days, potentially up to 21 days, with initial fever, headache, myalgia, and fatigue. Genital/rectal lesions warrant screening for other STIs; condoms do not fully prevent mpox. Early assessment at healthcare facilities is advised.

article.articleHeadline: Study Identifies Key Predictors of Adverse Tuberculosis Outcomes in
article.articleSummary: Retrospective analysis of Ni-kshay records from Maharashtra, India, 2021–2022 identified predictors of adverse outcomes in adult drug-sensitive TB. The unfavourable-outcome cohort included 323,124 cases; the mortality cohort included 315,579. Increased age, male gender, lower pre-treatment weight, tobacco use, and alcohol consumption significantly raised odds of unfavourable outcomes and death; HIV and diabetes also increased risk. Records with missing data for behavioral risks or comorbidities (unknown) likewise carried higher odds. Using multivariable logistic regression, baseline adjustment for age, gender, and weight, and treating missing data as a category, with collinearity checked via Cramer's V and VIF. The study demonstrates the utility of routine digital health data to flag high-risk TB patients and guide state-level interventions in a country that accounts for about one-quarter of global TB cases. TB remains the leading infectious cause of death worldwide.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela presents to PAHO progress toward malaria eradication.
article.articleSummary: Venezuela reported updated progress in malaria control and sustainable transmission reduction at the Regional Meeting on Malaria Elimination in the Americas, convened by the Pan American Health Organization in Brasilia, Brazil. Representing MinSalud, malaria advisor Dr. Magda Magris led the Venezuelan delegation in a technical working space to consolidate global strategies for eradication. The delegation highlighted that key to sustained case reductions has been active participation of the Popular Power and local communities, enabling early detection and timely treatment in districts of highest epidemiological priority. Venezuela detailed diverse strategies and methodological innovations implemented to accelerate vector elimination. With this balance, Venezuela reaffirms commitment to global health goals, underscoring that community-led action is the most effective instrument to eradicate malaria from the country.

article.articleSummary: Ebola remains a deadly crisis in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with US CDC data listing 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths as of 9 November 2026. In North Kivu, ISIS-aligned militants have escalated the humanitarian and health emergency, driving patients and contacts from treatment centers and hampering outbreak control. A Friday attack on the village of Kantin Alowiyat killed at least 33 civilians and damaged homes and a health center, raising fears of wider transmission in an area where roughly half of new infections are now reported. At Kilekili Health Center, 180 evacuees—patients, contacts, and those suspected of infection—were moved amid ongoing violence. International partners warn that insecurity undermines access to care, erodes trust, and fuels rumors, with WHO noting about 60% of deaths occurring in residential areas, underscoring the difficulty in isolating cases and tracing contacts.

article.articleHeadline: Sino-Africa cooperation to enhance infectious disease control, strengthen public health system
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-09, China CDC and Africa CDC signed a joint initiative at the China-Africa Public Health Forum in Guangzhou to build a new line of defense against infectious diseases. Aims include strengthening disease surveillance, risk assessment, laboratory diagnostics and quality control, emergency response, and local production of health products, with technology transfer and improved access. The agreement identifies African needs for diagnostics, vaccines and medicines, assesses product suitability for local conditions, and partners with UNICEF and the Gates Foundation. Africa, home to more than 1.5 billion people across 55 AU member states, faces epidemics, antimicrobial resistance, climate-sensitive diseases, fragile supply chains and fiscal constraints, warranting a self-reliant health system and domestic production under the 2025 Africa Health Security and Sovereignty Agenda. A three-year China-Africa CDC program will strengthen labs for multi-pathogen testing, gene sequencing, bioinformatics, and surveillance with AI/big data and training. Kenya and Gabon exemplify local manufacturing and biosafety lab expansion for malaria, TB and Ebola.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangxi Is About to Cool Down; Will the Cold Make Influenza More Rampant?
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity is rising in Guangxi as temperatures drop. Influenza is caused by influenza viruses, an acute respiratory infection, not simply cold weather. Cold, dry air impairs mucociliary clearance and increases viral stability, while closed, poorly ventilated indoor spaces become transmission hotspots via droplets. As winter approaches, influenza cases noticeably increase. Symptoms include fever, muscle aches, and cough, with higher risk of severe disease in older adults and those with chronic lung conditions such as COPD and bronchiectasis. Preventive measures emphasize timely vaccination (especially for the elderly and chronic lung disease patients), and improving indoor environments to 18–22°C and 40–60% humidity with regular ventilation. Additional guidance includes avoiding crowded enclosed spaces, wearing masks, hand hygiene, adequate nutrition, sleep, hydration, and stress management. Seek early medical care for high-risk individuals if symptoms occur.

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao người khỏe mạnh vẫn sốt xuất huyết nặng?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why do healthy people still suffer from severe dengue fever?
article.articleSummary: Healthy individuals can still develop dengue shock, respiratory failure, or organ damage due to mismanagement, late care, or reinfection. In Vietnam, a previously healthy 23-year-old man progressed to shock and respiratory failure, requiring dialysis and ECMO after several days of fever. In Đồng Nai, two women aged 38 and 59 died from dengue shock after home treatment; one had diabetes. The dangerous phase typically occurs as fever subsides (days 3–7), when plasma leakage can cause hypovolemia and shock. Adults more often bleed and suffer organ injury; children more often have plasma leakage. Four dengue serotypes circulate in Vietnam, so reinfection with a different type raises risk of severe disease. Qdenga vaccine is approved from age 4 (two doses, 3 months apart), with efficacy over 80% against dengue and over 90% against severe disease and hospitalization; more than 32 million doses have been distributed in 43 countries by July 2026. Vaccination plus mosquito control and prompt medical care recommended.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 2026 China Public Health Science and Technology Development Conference opens in Guangzhou; development of broad-spectrum influenza vaccines accelerates.
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou, at Guangzhou International Bio Island, hosts the 2026 China Public Health Science and Technology Development Conference, highlighting accelerated development of broad-spectrum influenza vaccines. Leaders Chen Zhu and Zhong Nanshan present on chronic disease prevention and infectious disease control, respectively. The agenda prioritizes a population cohort data platform for major chronic diseases and aims to deliver milestone outputs, including a domestically developed broad-spectrum influenza vaccine and RSV vaccines. The development plan targets entering clinical trials for the broad-spectrum influenza vaccine and creating AI vaccine-design software with independent IP, aiming to surpass current annual vaccine-update cycles. Guangzhou showcases translational gains: 2025 results include over 420 million yuan in hospital contract value, 3.879 billion yuan in tech innovation revenue, and clinical trials initiated within 18 weeks; a National Health Commission–Guangzhou Development Zone framework will accelerate lab-to-industry translation, aligning with Health China 2030 and the 14th/15th Five-Year Plans.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation presents the 20th Gochon Award, honoring dedication to global TB elimination.
article.articleSummary: The Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation marked the 20th Gochon Award in Bali, Indonesia, honoring TB-elimination efforts by three global groups: Marshall Islands TB Management Program, REACH (India), and Kenya Health Solutions Centre. The Marshall Islands program linked TB screening with diabetes and leprosy testing, screening about 20,000 residents and identifying 314 active TB cases, with a 95.9% treatment success rate. REACH partnered with roughly 180 private pharmacies and clinics, screening over 1.5 million people and identifying 3,000 TB patients; about 400,000 people received psychological counseling and treatment support. Kenya Health Solutions Centre deployed AI-based X-rays and other devices, serving around 165,000 residents and detecting 1,876 new TB cases. The 19th award went to Pakistan’s Dopasi Foundation and Nigeria TB Elimination International Cooperation Programme for funding and infrastructure—8.1 billion rupees and 2.4 billion naira plus $1.2 million in diagnostic equipment; prize remains $100,000.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Respiratory tract diseases have entered an active phase; adapt to seasonal changes; science-based influenza prevention.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity has entered an active autumn–winter phase in China. Rural vaccination campaigns provide free influenza vaccines for residents aged 65 and older and for primary/secondary school students. The China CDC Week 44 report (Oct 26–Nov 1, 2026) shows influenza positives: 65.4% influenza A and 34.6% influenza B; A subtypes: A(H1N1)pdm09 51.2%, A(H3N2) 48.8%; B Victoria lineage. Flu causes fever, chills, headache, myalgia in addition to respiratory symptoms; severe complications like pneumonia, cardiac injury, and shock can occur, especially in the elderly, infants, chronic disease patients, and pregnant women. Transmission is mainly via droplets and contact, amplified in crowded, poorly ventilated spaces such as schools, daycare centers, and nursing homes. Prevention emphasizes vaccination timing (ideally Sept–Oct; 2–4 weeks to protection), masks, cough etiquette, hand hygiene, ventilation, and healthy habits. Other individuals ≥6 months may self-pay for vaccination; vaccination remains the most cost-effective prevention, with priority groups targeted.

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: Uruguai volta a importar carne de aves do Brasil - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Uruguay resumes importing poultry meat from Brazil - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Uruguay resumes importing Brazilian poultry meat after recognizing regionalization of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina, restricting measures to four municipalities and allowing shipments from the rest of Brazil. The decision ends Brazil’s national embargo on exports to Uruguay. The restricted area comprises Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Brazil argues that a localized outbreak does not justify a nationwide ban, and exports from the non-restricted areas continue. The impact on exports is about 15,000 tonnes per month, roughly 3% of Brazil’s average monthly poultry exports (~500,000 t). The outbreak began Oct 18 in Nova Itaberaba, with confirmations in Coronel Freitas (Oct 24) and Nova Erechim (Oct 26; Nov 3). A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared; culling, sanitization, and enhanced veterinary surveillance were implemented; consumption of inspected poultry remains safe. Eleven countries still restrict Santa Catarina entirely; Brazil seeks broader regionalization per OMSA.

article.articleHeadline: Vụ 2 ca tử vong do viêm não mô cầu ở Cà Mau, sức khỏe 87 người tiếp xúc ra sao?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two deaths from meningococcal meningitis in Cà Mau; what is the health status of the 87 people who had contact?
article.articleSummary: Two deaths from meningococcal meningitis occurred in Ca Mau province, Vietnam, in Sông Đốc commune. The Ca Mau CDC reports 87 close contacts were monitored for 10 days from the last exposure; by 8 November no suspected cases surfaced, and monitoring ended. The two deaths happened in late October; sources of infection are undetermined and the cases are not linked. First patient N.D.M., 33, of Rạch Dinh hamlet, presented with sore throat and fever on 26 October, then abdominal pain, diarrhea, dyspnea and purpura; admitted to Trần Văn Thời General Hospital and later Ca Mau General Hospital, died 28 October. Second patient Đ.K.N., 46, of Tân Hòa hamlet, showed chills and cough on 20 October; admitted 22 October; deteriorated and died 23 October. Laboratory confirmation identified Neisseria meningitidis group B in both cases. Since the start of the year, Ca Mau has recorded 3 meningococcal meningitis deaths.

article.articleHeadline: Sequencing Pediatric Lung Fluid Links Microbial Load to Distinct Pneumonia
article.articleSummary: Sequencing pediatric BAL fluid links microbial load to pneumonia phenotypes. In 791 hospitalized children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection in Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China (Aug 2023–Jul 2024), researchers performed targeted next-generation sequencing on bronchoalveolar lavage to quantify DNA load, detect co-pathogens, and assess antimicrobial resistance mutations. BAL collected within 72 hours of admission; a 198-pathogen panel and resistance gene profiling interrogated macrolide-resistance mutations A2063G/A2064G. Inclusion required ages 1 month–16 years and ≥50 pathogen reads with ≥1,000 copies/mL DNA. High MP load defined as >1,000,000 copies/mL; low load 1,000–1,000,000; co-infection if any co-pathogen ≥1,000 copies/mL. Of 791, 309 monoinfection and 482 co-infection (60.9%). 652 high-load and 139 low-load cases. High-load monoinfection associated with persistent fever and localized consolidation; low-load co-infection tied to younger age, respiratory distress, wheeze, dyspnea, higher inflammatory markers, and more severe pneumonia. Background: East Asia macrolide resistance 70–90% vs 10–15% NA/Europe.

article.articleHeadline: 北京疾控提醒：流感病毒进入活跃期，收好这份防护指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC reminds: The influenza virus has entered its active season; keep this protective guide.
article.articleSummary: Beijing reports influenza entering its active season as winter approaches. Flu differs from a common cold: influenza causes abrupt onset with fever, fatigue, and muscle aches, and can cause pneumonia, myocarditis, or encephalitis; infants, the elderly, pregnant women, and people with chronic diseases or weakened immunity are at higher risk of severe illness. Globally, about 1 billion seasonal flu cases occur annually, with 3–5 million severe cases and 290,000–650,000 respiratory deaths. Transmission is mainly via droplets and aerosols; crowded spaces accelerate spread. Prevention centers on vaccination—the most effective measure. 2026–2027 guidelines advise vaccination for all people aged 6 months and older with no contraindications, with antibodies developing over 2–4 weeks. Beijing’s vaccination began Sept 7; northern areas see activity rise in November. Free vaccines are available for seniors 60+, students, frontline workers. Also practice hand hygiene, ventilation, and masks in crowds; book via Jingtong app or clinics.

article.articleHeadline: Lebih dari 2 Juta Orang di Indonesia Jalani Skrining TBC Berbasis AI Sejak 2020
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2 million people in Indonesia have undergone AI-based TB screening since 2020.
article.articleSummary: More than 2 million Indonesians have undergone AI-assisted tuberculosis (TB) screening using Delft Imaging’s CAD4TB software since 2020, announced on November 7, 2026. CAD4TB analyzes chest X-ray images to identify radiographic abnormalities that may indicate TB and to help health workers determine who should receive further testing. AI results are not diagnostic and must be confirmed through additional diagnostics and clinical assessment before a TB diagnosis is made. The approach could strengthen case finding, particularly in regions with limited radiology expertise, but success depends on adequate diagnostic capacity, treatment access, and patient support. Delft Imaging emphasizes knowledge transfer, local capacity building, and sustained collaboration with health services, government, and communities. Progress toward Indonesia’s 2030 TB elimination target will depend on effective follow-up and access to care after screening.

article.articleHeadline: Siapa yang Perlu Skrining TBC? Dokter Sebut 5 Kelompok Berisiko
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Who Should Be Screened for TB? Doctors List Five At-Risk Groups.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major infectious threat in Indonesia. Dr. Erlina Burhan, professor and pulmonologist, notes many cases go undetected due to symptom unawareness and limited health access, heightening transmission risk. WHO data cited by Delft Imaging estimate over one million TB cases in Indonesia in 2025, with about 134,000 deaths annually. On World TB Day 2026, authorities report that every minute two people are infected in Indonesia and every four minutes one person dies. Active screening is essential to identify cases early, especially among high-risk groups. The five priority groups for screening are: 1) household or close contacts of TB patients; 2) people with HIV; 3) infants and children; 4) the elderly; and 5) individuals with weakened immune systems. If screening suggests TB, diagnostic follow-up and appropriate treatment must be secured, with strengthened diagnostics, treatment access, and patient support, under government–facility–community collaboration toward 2030 elimination.

article.articleHeadline: Bảo vệ con trước bệnh do não mô cầu: Đừng đợi đến khi có dấu hiệu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Protect your child from meningococcal disease: Don't wait until symptoms appear.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningococcal disease, with serogroups A, C, Y, and W circulating in Vietnam, poses imminent risk to children. In Ho Chi Minh City, 5 recent pediatric cases and one 12-year-old death due to fulminant septic shock illustrate rapid progression within 24 hours. Since the start of the year, southern surveillance recorded 45 meningococcal cases and 9 deaths. All four serogroups A, C, Y, and W can cause severe disease and lasting sequelae; W and C associated with higher mortality. Vietnam has licensed vaccines, including a quadrivalent meningococcal conjugate vaccine that covers A, C, Y, W in a single dose. A Vietnamese study of 447 vaccine recipients (223 aged 12–23 months; 224 aged 2–73) showed strong humoral response and safety. Since disease can be mild or occult in young children and transmissions occur via close contact, proactive vaccination is recommended. Parents should consult physicians about the quadrivalent vaccine now.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bangkok prepares surveillance and preventive measures for monkeypox, in close coordination; opens Health Hotline 1646 to provide 24-hour service.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox surveillance is strengthened in Bangkok with close inter-agency coordination and a 24-hour Health Hotline 1646. A suspected MPOX case initially presented at Rajpiphat Hospital; early symptoms (fever, myalgia, lymphadenopathy, rash) yielded normal tests. Admission was advised, but the patient declined; treatment was symptomatic. As the illness progressed to a characteristic rash, the patient was tested at a Bangkok medical center and later returned to a Bangkok metropolitan hospital for isolation and investigation. Swabs for real-time PCR were sent to a reference laboratory, and the outbreak team conducted contact tracing. Bed capacity constraints prompted an option for home isolation with telemedicine follow-up. SOPs were updated to strengthen high-risk screening, prompt specialist referrals, and clinician training on monkeypox rash variations. Public guidance emphasizes close contact precautions, 21-day monitoring of contacts, vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis for at-risk groups, and 24/7 confidential testing at Bangkok Pride Clinic sites.

article.articleHeadline: Health Security At Risk: How Climate Change Spawns The Next Epidemic
article.articleSummary: Climate instability is identified as a primary driver of emerging infectious diseases, with habitat fragmentation and shifting wildlife ranges elevating spillover risk. Panel at Sustainability Expo 2026 (November 7) warned that permafrost thaw in Siberia risks reactivating dormant pathogens, and that warming accelerates breeding of Aedes and Anopheles vectors, expanding vector-borne illnesses into new regions. The 1998 Nipah outbreak in Malaysia is cited as a canonical example of how environmental destruction triggers crises; during a severe El Niño in Indonesia, loss of habitat and fruit bat migration led to Nipah entering pig populations and then farm workers. More than 100 human deaths from encephalitis and respiratory distress; about 1.2 million pigs culled to curb transmission. WHO Thailand advocates treating climate change as a public health crisis; emphasis on proactive surveillance, rapid data sharing, education, and disaster-resilient health infrastructure, with genomic diagnostics enabling near real-time responses.

article.articleHeadline: Choléra en RDC: Kinshasa lance une vaste campagne de vaccination en coopération avec le Congo-Brazzaville
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in the DRC: Kinshasa launches a large-scale vaccination campaign in cooperation with Congo-Brazzaville.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo prompts a large-scale cross-border vaccination campaign with Congo-Brazzaville. The World Health Organization reported about 60,000 cholera cases in DRC through October, as authorities aim to immunize two million people living on river island camps along the Congo River. The operation marks a first large-scale transboundary effort, leveraging vaccination along the river corridor rather than a single bank. Initiation began November 3 in Équateur Province, with planned rollout in Mai-Ndombe on November 10 and Kinshasa on November 24, coordinated with Brazzaville. Logistics face weather-driven challenges: the rainy season and El Niño-induced heavy rains raise water levels, complicating campaigns using pirogues, small motorboats, and local relay networks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ：キンシャサがコンゴ共和国（ブラザビル）と協力し大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: WHO報告で約6万人のコレラ症例が確認され、コンゴ川沿いで国境を越えた大規模ワクチン接種（200万人対象）が実施されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクの両方が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのコレラ流行と、隣国コンゴ共和国（ブラザビル）との国境を越えた協力によるワクチン接種キャンペーンを主題としている。コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。雨季とエルニーニョによる増水がロジスティクスに影響を与えている点も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau: Không xuất hiện triệu chứng nghi ngờ ở người tiếp xúc với 2 ca tử vong do não mô cầu - Tuổi trẻ Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cà Mau: No suspected symptoms in people who had contact with two deaths from meningococcal disease - Tuổi trẻ Online
article.articleSummary: Ca Mau province, Vietnam: Two deaths from meningococcal meningitis. After more than ten days of health monitoring, contacts and related individuals have shown no suspected symptoms, and no additional cases have been detected. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details or infection source, and does not indicate any imported or exported cases. Surveillance remains ongoing to detect secondary transmission, but current findings suggest no active transmission among contacts. Authorities continue follow-up with close contacts, but no clinical signs have emerged. The article, published 2026-11-09 by Tuổi Trẻ Online, highlights containment after deadly meningococcal disease events.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省：髄膜炎菌感染症による2名の死亡例の接触者に疑わしい症状は見られず - トゥオイチェー・オンライン
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・カマウ省で髄膜炎菌感染症による死亡例が2件発生したが、接触者調査では追加症例や疑い症状は確認されておらず、現時点で二次感染の拡大は認められないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡2例が確認されているが、感染源・検査確定情報は不明。接触者には現時点で症状なく、監視継続中。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sau 2 ca tử vong do não mô cầu, Cà Mau chưa ghi nhận ca mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After two deaths from meningococcal disease, Ca Mau has not recorded any new cases.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths from meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis group B) occurred in Ca Mau Province, Vietnam. The first case began Oct 20 in Tan Hoa hamlet, Song Doc commune, with chills and cough, followed by purpuric skin lesions; laboratory confirmation on Oct 22 identified meningococcal disease group B. The patient died Oct 23 at 19:10; 37 contacts were traced. The second case began Oct 26 in Rach Dinh hamlet, Song Doc commune; admitted Oct 27 with septic shock and transferred to Ca Mau General Hospital; laboratory confirmation of group B meningococcal disease; death Oct 28 at 08:20; 50 contacts identified. Health authorities monitored contacts for more than 10 days after last exposure; no suspected cases emerged. By Nov 9, 2026, Ca Mau CDC had not recorded any new cases related to these two infections, and contact monitoring was completed per regulations.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症による2名死亡後、カマウ省で新規症例は確認されず
triage.triage_reason: カマウ省で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）により2名が死亡したが、接触者追跡の結果新規症例は発生せず、監視も規定通り完了している。重症度は高いが拡大の兆候はなく経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 同一コミューン（Song Doc）内で短期間に2例の死亡例が発生したが、接触者50名超の追跡調査を含め地域保健当局により封じ込めが完了しており、新規感染の拡大は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nghệ An khẩn trương điều tra nguyên nhân trâu, bò chết hàng loạt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nghệ An Province urgently investigates the causes of mass die-offs of buffalo and cattle
article.articleSummary: In Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, mass die-offs of buffalo and cattle have been reported in Hữu Kiệm commune, rising from 21 deaths by 7 November to 41 by 9 November. The outbreak is centered in the area formerly known as Bao Nam, with Ven Phò Thủy’s family in Khe Nạp reporting 19 cattle lost. Preliminary clinical signs include high fever, neck swelling, abdominal distension, foamy saliva, dyspnea, and rapid death, with officials suspecting acute hemorrhagic septicemia, though lab confirmation from submitted samples is pending. Local authorities have culled all carcasses, disinfected facilities, sprayed disinfectants, and implemented ring vaccination around the remaining herd to contain spread. Farmers are urged to vaccinate, avoid free-ranging grazing, improve nutrition, and promptly report sick animals. Officials caution that transitional weather may weaken immunity and foster outbreaks; separate notes reference strengthened African swine fever controls in pigs across several districts.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省、水牛・牛の大量死の原因を緊急調査
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（水牛・牛）の集団死亡事例であり、急性出血性敗血症が疑われるが未確定。人への感染報告はなく人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は不明だが、原因不明の動物大量死として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患名は『African Swine Fever』と分類されているが、記事本文は水牛・牛の大量死（疑い：急性出血性敗血症）が主題であり、ASFは別項で豚への対策強化として言及されているのみ。人獣共通感染症としての直接的リスクは記載なし。検査結果待ちのため続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Southern Africa: Climate Change and Funding Cuts Threaten Malaria Targets - What SADC Countries Can Do
article.articleSummary: Malaria control in the SADC is at a critical point as cases rise over the past two years. Four countries—DRC, Mozambique, Angola and Tanzania—account for about 22.9% of the global malaria burden. WHO Elimination targets for 2030 are harder amid overstretched national programs and a volatile donor landscape, including the abrupt end of U.S. funding in 2025 and Global Fund Cycle 2026–2028 allocations about 18% lower. Consequently, bednet distributions, malaria indicator surveys and preventive drugs are scaled back, widening protection gaps. La Niña-driven flooding in early 2026 boosted malaria in Zimbabwe and Mozambique (Mozambique +55% Jan–Jun 2026; Zimbabwe Q1 2026: 65,399 cases). About 11.4 million people were forcibly displaced in 2025 in the region, with cross-border movements straining health systems. Drug and insecticide resistance persist; a regional genomics hub, early warning, data sharing and stronger domestic investment are needed.

triage.headline_ja: 南部アフリカ：気候変動と資金削減がマラリア対策目標を脅かす - SADC諸国にできること
triage.triage_reason: マラリア流行は南部アフリカの構造的・慢性的課題であり急性の異常事態ではないが、気候変動（洪水）と資金削減による症例増加（モザンビーク+55%、ジンバブエ65,399例）が報告されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はSADC地域全体（DRC、モザンビーク、アンゴラ、タンザニア、ジンバブエ）のマラリア対策政策・資金動向に関する分析記事であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。急性アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、構造的な資金・気候変動問題に関するトレンド記事のため、フルRRAよりも継続監視が妥当と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết trước nguy cơ dịch lan rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive prevention and control of dengue fever amid the risk of an outbreak spreading.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreaks remain highly active across Vietnam in 2026. By late October, 170,684 dengue cases and 21 deaths were reported nationwide in the first 10 months; 2025 recorded 184,903 cases, the Asia-Pacific region’s highest. The disease is endemic year‑round, with spread reaching northern provinces such as Tuyên Quang and Sơn La. Ho Chi Minh City shows accelerating transmission: 1,959 cases the week of 26 Oct–1 Nov, and 44,549 cases with 11 deaths year‑to‑date. A 17‑day‑old neonate treated at a pediatric hospital had dengue with severe complications; thrombocytopenia and Dengue virus positivity were confirmed. Đồng Nai reports 10 dengue deaths in 2026 and 5,651 outbreaks, with hotspots including Nhơn Trạch and Trảng Bom. Gia Lai, as of 27 Oct, has 9,755 cases (+6,446 vs 2025) and 474 outbreaks. Authorities urge elimination of standing water, bed nets, long sleeves, and repellents; Gia Lai enforces intensified campaigns with 100% household spraying and weekly larval control plus school involvement.

triage.headline_ja: 流行拡大のリスクを前にデング熱の予防・対策を積極的に実施
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで毎年発生している風土病のデング熱の季節流行だが、症例数・死亡者数の増加や北部への拡大、重症例（新生児）の報告があり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疾患タグにSFTS Virusが含まれるが記事本文・サマリーにSFTSへの言及はなく、デング熱のみが主題。発生地域にChinaが含まれるが記事内容はベトナム国内の流行に限定されており、Chinaは地理タグの誤りと判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau kiểm soát tốt các ổ dịch não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau effectively controls meningococcal disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Ca Mau Province has controlled meningococcal disease outbreaks after tracing contacts for two deaths linked to Neisseria meningitidis group B. In October 2026, three cases were recorded: two fatalities in Sông Đốc commune—one in Tân Hòa hamlet (onset 20 Oct; death 23 Oct; 37 contacts) and one in Rạch Dinh hamlet (onset 26 Oct; death 28 Oct; 50 contacts); a third case at Drug Rehabilitation Center 2 in Vĩnh Trạch ward (onset 22 Oct; discharge 2 Nov; 31 close contacts and 587 related). All contacts were monitored for 10 days after last exposure; no suspected cases emerged and no new infections linked to these clusters have been detected. Since the start of 2026, Ca Mau has reported 8 meningococcal disease cases with 3 deaths. Authorities will maintain surveillance and advise hygiene, sanitation, and prompt medical care for symptoms such as high fever, chills, rash, or coughing.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省、髄膜炎菌性疾患の発生を効果的に制御
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例を伴う髄膜炎菌性疾患クラスターが発生したが、接触者追跡の結果新規感染は確認されておらず制御済みと報告されている。重症度の観点から継続監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: 2026年にカマウ省で髄膜炎菌性疾患8例・死亡3例が報告されたが、10月の最新クラスター（3例、死亡2例）は接触者監視後新規症例なく制御されたと当局が発表。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、年間を通じた散発例の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Sau 2 ca tử vong do viêm não mô cầu, Cà Mau công bố không phát sinh ca mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After two deaths from meningococcal meningitis, Ca Mau announces no new cases.
article.articleSummary: Two deaths from meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis group B) in Ca Mau Province, Vietnam, triggered extensive contact tracing. The first case from Tan Hoa Hamlet, Song Doc Commune, onset Oct 20 with chills and cough, then hemorrhagic rash; admitted Oct 22 and laboratory-confirmed as meningococcal meningitis group B; died Oct 23. The second case from Rach Dinh Hamlet, Song Doc Commune, onset Oct 26; admitted Oct 27 in septic shock; confirmed meningococcal meningitis group B; died Oct 28. Health authorities identified 37 close contacts for the first case and 50 for the second, totaling 87 contacts monitored for 10 days after last exposure. By Nov 8, no symptoms and no new infections; monitoring was concluded per regulations. The piece also notes a rapid-response home-visit model in Ho Chi Minh City that helped curb a meningococcal outbreak within 24 hours. As of Nov 9, Ca Mau reports no new cases.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による2例の死亡後、カマウ省は新規症例なしと発表
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（B群）による死亡2例が発生したが、接触者87名を10日間追跡した結果新規感染は確認されず、既に終息が報告されている。重症度は高いが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: カマウ省で発生した2例の死亡例は家族内クラスターとみられ、保健当局による迅速な接触者追跡により新規症例は確認されていない。ホーチミン市での迅速対応モデルも言及されており、ベトナム国内の対応能力は高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: สธ. เผย ฝีดาษลิงที่พบในไทยยังสายพันธุ์เดิม ชี้ อาการคล้ายโรคทางเดินหายใจ-ทอนซิลอักเสบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Public Health says the monkeypox found in Thailand is still the original strain, with symptoms similar to a respiratory tract infection and tonsillitis.
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s Ministry of Public Health says monkeypox in the country remains the original strain. Surveillance shows Clade IIb as the global lineage since 2022, but since mid-2026 Clade Ib has become the dominant circulating strain in Thailand, with a case fatality rate under 0.5%. Most patients are men aged 18–49 with risk factors linked to sexual activity, social gatherings, or cohabitation. Clinical presentation ranges from skin lesions (rash, vesicles, ulcers) on skin and mucous membranes (genital, anal, oral, facial, limbs) to fever, sore throat, or anal/mucosal inflammation; some cases may have no obvious lesions initially, or resemble a respiratory infection or tonsillitis. Transmission occurs via close contact with lesions or body fluids, intimate contact, contaminated items, or prolonged respiratory exposure. Isolate, maintain hygiene, wear a well-fitted mask, and seek medical evaluation; hospitalization is not required for all cases. Hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、タイで確認された痘瘡（サル痘）は依然として既存株であり、症状は呼吸器感染症・扁桃炎に類似していると発表
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でMpox Clade Ibが優勢株に転じ、性的接触等によるヒト-ヒト感染が継続している点、また呼吸器感染症様の非典型的症状が報告されている点は異常かつ国際的拡大リスクを孕むため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: Clade IIbから2026年半ば以降Clade Ibへ優勢株が移行し、性的接触・濃厚接触を介した感染が主な経路。致死率は0.5%未満と報告されているが、症状が呼吸器感染症・扁桃炎に類似するため診断の遅れや見逃しによる感染拡大の懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค ย้ำฝีดาษวานร อาการแสดงหลากหลาย เหมือนทอนซิลอักเสบได้
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control emphasizes that monkeypox has a wide range of clinical manifestations that can resemble tonsillitis.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in Thailand is presenting with diverse clinical manifestations that can resemble tonsillitis, according to the Department of Disease Control on 9 November 2026. Laboratory surveillance shows Clade IIb was common earlier, but since mid-2026 Clade Ib has become the dominant strain, with a case fatality rate under 0.5% though more apparent symptoms in immunocompromised individuals or those with comorbidities. Cases have been detected across major provinces and tourism areas; affected individuals are predominantly males aged 18–49, with risk factors including sexual behavior, socializing with patients, or cohabitation. Transmission occurs through direct or close contact with infected skin lesions, body fluids, droplets, or shared objects; hospitalization is not required for all patients. Suspected cases should seek medical evaluation, avoid sexual contact, keep personal items separate, and consult the helpline 1422 for information.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理局、サル痘（Mpox）は多様な臨床症状を呈し、扁桃炎に類似することもあると強調
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でMpox Clade Ib（国際的に懸念される系統）が主流株に転換したとの公式発表であり、異常性・国際拡大リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: Clade Ib（旧Clade I系統の一部でDRC由来のPHEIC対象系統）が2026年中頃からタイで優勢化したとの報告であり、国際的な系統置換の動向として注視が必要。致死率自体は低いが、免疫不全者での重症化や性行動を介した伝播が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 氣候變遷加劇傳染病風險　專家示警古老病原體恐再現
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change intensifies the risk of infectious diseases; experts warn ancient pathogens may re-emerge.
article.articleSummary: On November 7–9, 2026, Thai medical and environmental experts warned at Bangkok’s Queen Sirikit National Convention Center during the Sustainable Development Expo that climate change could reshape infectious disease spread and unearth ancient pathogens. Virologist Yong Poovorawan, WHO Thailand representative Dr. Alisa Yanasarn, and environmental health expert Sonthi Kochawat outlined three pathways: expanding vectors like mosquitoes, altered animal–human contact, and thawing permafrost exposing long-dormant pathogens. Dengue, malaria, and Zika—driven by temperature and rainfall—could reach new areas, though outbreaks depend on public health measures and local conditions. They cited Russia’s 2016 anthrax outbreak to illustrate exposure risks from heat and permafrost, but cautioned not all ancient microbes threaten humans. WHO estimates climate change may cause about 250,000 additional deaths annually (2030–2050) from malnutrition, malaria, diarrhea, and heat injuries. Calls for integrated environmental monitoring, disease surveillance, and stronger disaster-ready healthcare, especially for pregnant women, children, and outdoor workers.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動が感染症リスクを増大させる　専門家が古代の病原体再出現に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、気候変動と感染症リスクに関する専門家の一般的な警鐘・会議発表であり、特定の公衆衛生緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ・バンコクで開催された持続可能な開発博覧会における専門家の一般論的警告であり、具体的な発生事例の報告ではない。ロシアの2016年炭疽菌アウトブレイクは過去の事例として引用されているのみで、現在進行中のイベントではない。対象国での実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : MSF condamne une tentative d'incendie de son centre Ebola où étaient hospitalisés 36 patients
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: MSF condemns an arson attempt at its Ebola treatment center where 36 patients were hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: An arson attempt targeted Médecins Sans Frontières’ Ebola Treatment Center in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, where 36 patients were hospitalized. The incident occurred around 22:00 on Friday, 6 November 2026, as unknown assailants tried to set the facility on fire amid gunfire. The act appears linked to the death earlier that day of a young woman who tested positive for Ebola and was the wife of a suspected militiaman identified as Wazalendo; associates reportedly sought to retrieve her body. Police found unignited gasoline bottles at the scene; no injuries were reported. The Congolese National Police condemned the attack and urged protection for healthcare workers and facilities, stressing adherence to infection-control measures to limit transmission. The Ebola outbreak in the Beni area remains active, with over 800 cases since resurgence and more than 50% mortality; authorities call for continued support for response teams.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：国境なき医師団、36名の患者が入院していたエボラ治療センターへの放火未遂を非難
triage.triage_reason: DRCベニ地域で活動中のエボラアウトブレイク（800例超・致死率50%超）に加え、治療センターへの放火未遂という対応活動を脅かす重大な事態が発生しており、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事自体は治療センターへの放火未遂事件が主題だが、背景として北キブ州ベニ地域のエボラアウトブレイクが800例超・致死率50%超と深刻化しており、対応活動への妨害（治安問題）が感染拡大リスクを高めている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: "ฝีดาษวานร" พบอาการหลากหลาย Clade Ib เป็นสายพันธุ์หลักในไทย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox shows diverse symptoms; Clade Ib is the predominant strain in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox shows diverse clinical manifestations in Thailand, ranging from rashes, vesicles, or ulcers on skin and mucous membranes (genital, anal, oral, facial areas) to fever, sore throat, proctitis, or mucosal inflammation; some cases may present with minimal or no rash initially. Since mid-2026, Clade Ib has become the predominant strain in Thailand, replacing the prior Clade IIb, with ongoing surveillance. Clade Ib has mortality below 0.5%, but can cause clear disease, especially in the immunocompromised or those with comorbidities who lack timely treatment. Reported cases are dispersed across major provinces, tourist hubs, and crowded areas; no widespread community transmission yet. Most patients are men aged 18–49 with risk factors related to sexual behavior, social gatherings, or cohabitation. Transmission occurs via direct/close contact with lesions, sexual contact, shared contaminated items, or prolonged close exposure. Suspected cases should isolate, avoid close contact and sex, cover lesions, practice hand hygiene, and wear a tight-fitting mask; hospitalization is not universal. Seek prompt medical evaluation and respect patient privacy.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘（Mpox）は多様な症状を呈し、クレードIbがタイで主流株に
triage.triage_reason: 国際的に懸念されるクレードIb（従来アフリカ中心）がタイで主流株となり、クレードIIbを置き換えていることはIHR基準の異常性・国際拡大に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: クレードIbは致死率0.5%未満だが免疫不全者等で重症化しうる。性的接触等によるヒト-ヒト感染が確認されており、主要都市・観光地に散発的に報告されているが、現時点で広範な地域内感染は未確認。継続的なサーベイランス状況の続報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: อัปเดตสถานการณ์ 'ฝีดาษวานร' พบสายพันธุ์ Clade Ib เป็นสายพันธุ์หลักในไทย ชี้อาการแสดงหลากหลาย-คล้ายทอนซิลอักเสบเกิดขึ้นได้
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox Situation Update: Clade Ib identified as the dominant strain in Thailand; symptoms are varied and can resemble tonsillitis.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in Thailand is now predominantly caused by Clade Ib, identified as the dominant strain in mid-2026 laboratory analyses, with mortality under 0.5% but risk of severe outcomes in the immunocompromised. Clinical presentation is diverse: rashes, vesicles/pustules, or ulcers on skin and mucous membranes (genitals, anus, mouth, face); fever, sore throat, anal pain; symptoms can resemble tonsillitis or other respiratory infections even before lesions are clear. Cases are reported across major provinces, tourist areas, and densely populated locales, mainly among men aged 18-49 with risk factors such as sexual activity, parties, or cohabitation. Transmission occurs via direct/close contact with lesions, body fluids, contaminated items, or prolonged close contact including sex; possible droplet exposure in prolonged gatherings. Management favors home isolation when feasible; emphasize lesion cover, hand hygiene, and masks; hospitalization is not always required. Seek prompt medical evaluation; avoid stigma; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: モンキーポックス（Mpox）状況アップデート：タイでクレードIb株が主流に、症状は多様で扁桃炎に類似することも
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が強いクレードIb（WHO PHEIC対象株）がタイで主流株として定着し、観光地を含む広範な地域でヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触等）が継続している点から、国際拡大リスクを含めフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: クレードIbはDRC発の国際的に懸念されるmpox株であり、タイで主流化している点は国際保健上重要。致死率は低いが免疫不全者でのリスクや性的接触を介した継続的な感染拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Peningkatan Kasus Influenza A di Tengah Buruknya Kualitas Udara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Influenza A Cases Amid Poor Air Quality
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases rose in Sept 2026 across Indonesia, with 1,527 influenza-positive results through week 3 and the highest counts in DKI Jakarta, West Java, and Banten. Sentinel surveillance found 148 of 265 samples positive (56%), but officials say this does not reflect population-wide incidence and the rise is not categorized as a large surge, still following seasonal patterns. Drivers cited include seasonal transition, increased mobility, and predominance of Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09. Regional trends mirrored Southeast Asia, with Brunei’s positivity rising from ~12% to 28% and Vietnam from ~7% to 20% by Sept 10. Air quality context shows Jakarta’s 2025 average PM2.5 at 34.1 µg/m³ (WHO guideline 5 µg/m³), suggesting a potential link between air pollution and influenza, though causality is not proven. Supporting evidence includes a 2025 meta-analysis by Ava Orr et al. showing PM2.5 exposure raises influenza risk (about 4% in adults 18–64; up to 29% in hot, dry conditions), and Indonesian pediatric studies indicating higher respiratory infections with higher PM2.5 exposure (Jakarta Barat vs Bandung) though results vary in significance.

triage.headline_ja: 大気質悪化の中でのインフルエンザA型症例の増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の増加であり、当局も「大規模な急増ではない」と評価しているが、東南アジア地域での陽性率上昇傾向や大気汚染との関連可能性があり、続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア国内の季節性インフルエンザ増加を主題とし、ブルネイとベトナムの陽性率上昇にも言及しているが、ブルネイは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。当局は季節性パターンの範囲内と評価しており、重症度や医療逼迫の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation Awards Kochon Prize to Three TB Eradication Groups
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, the Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation announced three organizations—Marshall Islands Tuberculosis Management Program (Marshall Islands), India's REACH, and Kenya's Health Solution Center—as joint recipients of the 20th Kochon Prize for their contributions to global tuberculosis eradication. They were recognized for establishing integrated screening systems that test tuberculosis and other diseases simultaneously, enabling early TB detection and improving access to treatment for patients. The Kochon Prize, established in 2006, honors outstanding contributions to tuberculosis eradication and underscores international efforts to advance TB control through multiplex screening in diverse settings. These programs demonstrate scalable models for early detection and treatment access in the Marshall Islands, India, and Kenya, highlighting cross-national collaboration in tuberculosis prevention and care.

triage.headline_ja: 鍾根堂高村財団、結核撲滅に貢献した3団体に高村賞を授与

article.articleHeadline: Maha to install 300 Truenat Quattro machines for TB diagnosis
article.articleSummary: 300 Truenat Quattro machines will be installed across Maharashtra to speed TB diagnosis, including rifampicin-resistant TB, under a ₹41.92-crore National TB Elimination Programme project over 21 months. Machines will be placed at primary health centres, rural hospitals and district facilities; a tripartite MoU was signed between BPCL Foundation, HITES-HLL Infra Tech Services Ltd (implementing agency) and the joint director of health services (TB and leprosy). Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said diagnostics would reach remote areas. The WHO-approved portable, battery-operated devices detect TB and RR-TB in about an hour; health workers will be trained and performance monitored via the Nikshay platform. The project is expected to enable 9.36 lakh tests annually, identifying about 1.12 lakh TB patients and 4,680 RR-TB cases per year, potentially reducing delays and transmission. CSR funding facilitated the collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラーシュトラ州、結核診断のためTruenat Quattro検査機器300台を設置へ

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola - Why Is There Still No Vaccine?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) underlies the Congo-Kinshasa outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with thousands infected and the outbreak continuing, while the Bundibugyo strain is reportedly less aggressive than Zaire Ebola virus. There is no licensed vaccine or official treatment for BDBV. The existing Ebola vaccine Ervebo, licensed for Zaire EBOV, triggers cross-reactive T-cell responses against Bundibugyo in a DZIF study, and to a lesser extent against Sudan virus, suggesting potential cross-protection, but it remains unproven whether this reduces infection risk or disease severity. Historical outbreaks in Uganda (2007) and DR Congo (2012) raised vaccine hopes, but funding and prioritization left Bundibugyo-specific vaccine development incomplete. Ethical and methodological concerns prevent mass deployment of a vaccine without clear efficacy, as large-scale vaccination could confound outbreak assessments. The study emphasizes the need for more data to determine real-world protection.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱－なぜまだワクチンがないのか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスによる数千人規模の感染が継続しており、有効なワクチン・治療法が存在しないため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダの過去の流行（2007年）にも言及しているが、現在進行中のアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のブンディブギョ株によるもの。ウガンダは歴史的文脈のみで現行の発生国ではないため除外。感染者数（数千人）や国際的拡大リスクについては記事中に明確な記載がなく、続報での確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox alert: Thailand records 470 cases, three deaths in 2026
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Thailand (Bangkok) totals 470 cumulative cases and 3 deaths as of 31 October 2026, prompting tightened hospital screening and surveillance. Globally, the WHO reported 68,096 confirmed mpox cases and 272 deaths across 107 countries between 1 January 2025 and 31 August 2026. Bangkok authorities (BMA) have enhanced procedures across capital hospitals to improve diagnostic accuracy and expedite identification, including thorough exposure assessments, travel history, and risk-factor reviews. Suspected cases are referred to infectious-disease specialists or dermatologists even before full rash development. Lesion samples will be collected for real-time PCR at reference labs; highly likely cases are isolated in negative-pressure rooms or designated facilities, with full PPE for staff. Contact tracing with public health centers, 21-day symptom monitoring, and telemedicine follow-up for home isolation. Vaccination is advised for high-risk occupations, with post-exposure vaccination within 14 days. Testing in Bangkok hospitals and 24 BKK Pride Clinics; hotline 1646.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox警報:タイで2026年に470例、死亡3例を記録
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの継続的な国内発生で死亡例もあるが、感染拡大は限定的で既存の管理体制下にあるため、続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: タイ国内で累計470例・死亡3例の継続的発生。バンコク都市当局が検査・隔離・ワクチン接種体制を強化しており、現時点では国内で管理可能な状況と見られる。WHOの世界統計も引用されているが、本記事の主題はタイ国内の状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: WHO moves to test first vaccines
article.articleSummary: WHO recommended two Ebola vaccine candidates, ChAdOx1 and mRNA-1469, for the Bundibugyo virus trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, joining the Tumaini study that uses ring vaccination to assess transmission prevention. The candidates, developed by Oxford/Serum Institute and Moderna, were selected after review of preclinical and early clinical evidence and join Ervebo, which is being evaluated in Tumaini for potential cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Four vaccination rings have been established as part of the trial, led by INRB with the University of Antwerp, MSF, and Africa CDC, with CEPI support accelerating development. In Nigeria, NCDC and Germany’s Robert Koch Institute hosted a two-day stakeholder dialogue in Abuja under the NiCaDe AMR Project to strengthen antimicrobial resistance surveillance, lab capacity, data quality, and stewardship. A national Hub-and-Spoke framework was proposed to improve coordination and evidence-based treatment decisions across Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：WHOが初のワクチン試験に着手
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクに対し、WHOが複数のワクチン候補の臨床試験開始を主導しており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的対応が必要な事案であるためフルリスク評価へ進める。
triage.notes: 記事後半のナイジェリア（AMR対策に関する関係者対話）は本エボラ事案とは別テーマであり、エボラ発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Morowali Luncurkan GEBRAK TB JUARA, Targetkan Morowali Bebas TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Morowali Health Office Launches GEBRAK TB JUARA, Targets Morowali TB-Free
article.articleSummary: Morowali District Health Office in Central Sulawesi launches GEBRAK TB JUARA—Gerak Bersama Akselerasi Penanggulangan Tuberkulosis Menuju Morowali Juara—to accelerate tuberculosis control. The pilot will run in two villages, Bahomoahi (Bungku Timur) and Bahomakmur (Bahodopi), with a Focus Group Discussion held on 9 November 2026 at Pojok Edukasi, Bahomoahi. The initiative was devised by Nurasiah Musa, Head of Prevention and Control of Diseases (P2P) at Morowali Health Office, and supported by Nirmawati, the Health Office chief. The plan emphasizes increasing TB case finding, strengthening contact investigations, and expanding community education on prevention and treatment, under strong cross-sector collaboration among local government, subdistrict and village authorities, and private sector partners including PT Vale. TB remains a significant challenge in Morowali; the program seeks multi-sector engagement beyond health services to achieve a TB-free Morowali.

article.articleHeadline: Nyamuk Harimau Muncul di Eropa, Ahli Khawatir Wabah Baru Bisa Muncul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tiger Mosquitoes Appear in Europe, Experts Fear a New Outbreak Could Emerge.
article.articleSummary: Tiger mosquitoes (Aedes albopictus) are established in several European countries, raising concerns of dengue fever, chikungunya, and Zika outbreaks. By October 2026, Italy reported 76 locally transmitted dengue cases and France 8, with cases roughly doubling versus 2025. The expansion reflects mosquitoes spreading northward from historical introductions via used tires into Italy in the 1990s, then to France, Spain, Germany, Switzerland, and beyond. European health authorities are strengthening diagnostic and treatment capacity and vector surveillance to prevent endemic transmission; authorities warn infection can occur even without recent travel, as locally biting mosquitoes may acquire virus from travelers returning from tropical regions such as Thailand or Brazil and pass it to others. Portugal began a September 2026 program releasing 30,000 sterile male mosquitos to suppress the population. Immediate containment is urged to avert a sustained outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue recolhe lixo no Cajuru e no Bairro Novo nesta semana - Curitiba | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cleanup drive collects trash in Cajuru and Bairro Novo this week - Curitiba | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: Curitiba's municipal health department conducts the Curitiba sem Mosquito cleanup mutirão in Cajuru and Bairro Novo to curb dengue. Health agents educate residents on dengue prevention and proper entulho disposal; waste is collected by municipal environmental trucks. In Cajuru's São Paulo Health Unit area, teams covered 16 blocks from Tue 3 Nov to Fri 6 Nov, with collection slated for Tue 10 Nov. In Bairro Novo (Sitio Cercado), teams covered 18 blocks in the same period, with collection planned for Thu 12 Nov. Participants should place waste outside on pickup days; smaller items should be bagged. The mutirão collects recyclables, tires (max two per residence), and vegetation (up to 1 cubic meter per residence), but not construction debris, toxic waste (lamps, medicines), furniture, appliances, or vehicles. Tires from businesses are not collected; caliça rubble requires a separate request via 156.

article.articleHeadline: प्राणी-मानव संक्रमित आजारांवर संशोधन! पुण्यासह देशातील पाच ठिकाणी प्राणिसंग्रहालयांत अभ्यास होणार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research on zoonotic diseases! Studies will be conducted at five zoos across the country, including Pune.
article.articleSummary: Three-year national study on zoonotic diseases, based on the One Health framework, will be conducted across five zoos in India, including Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park in Pune. Led by collaborations among ICMR, the National Institute of Virology (NIV), Bharati Vidyapeeth University, and Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park, the project began with a workshop and site surveys on 5 November. The investigation will compare animal, human, and environmental health to identify spillover risks early. Participating zoos include Delhi, Pune, Chennai, Guwahati, and another selected site. Staff who work closely with animals will undergo medical screening, with samples taken as needed; routine health checks of animals will also be performed. Collected samples will be sent to NIV for virological testing and research, while the zoo premises will be surveyed for factors that could enable transmission. The goal is proactive threat detection and preventive measures to avert outbreaks under the One Health approach.

triage.headline_ja: 動物-人間感染症に関する研究！プネを含む国内5カ所の動物園で調査実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、人獣共通感染症の予防的研究プロジェクト（One Healthフレームワークに基づく調査）の開始を報じる記事であり、疾病発生シグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はニパウイルス等の人獣共通感染症に関する予防研究プロジェクトの発足を報じるものであり、実際のニパウイルス感染事例の報告ではない。疾患名『Nipah』はBluedotのタグ付けによるものだが、本文内容は研究体制構築に関するもの。

article.articleHeadline: Butantan usa fungo para matar larva da esquistossomose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butantan uses fungus to kill schistosome larvae.
article.articleSummary: Butantan researchers repurposed the fungus Aspergillus tubingensis as a living nano‑factory to synthesize silver nanoparticle coatings that kill 100% of Schistosoma mansoni cercariae within two hours. The work, published in Environmental Science Nano, has a patent granted by INPI. Schistosomiasis is endemic in Brazil, notably the Northeast, Minas Gerais, and Espírito Santo, with freshwater snails as the intermediate host; cercariae penetrate human skin, causing chronic disease with anemia and hepatic fibrosis in underserved communities. The fungus acts as a bio‑reactor, producing biomolecules that form a protective coating around silver ions, enabling slow, targeted release and reduced environmental toxicity. Tests showed low concentrations kill cercariae, while zebrafish, microcrustaceans, and other fish exhibit far less sensitivity (microcrustaceans require 22× higher doses). The nanoparticle also targets snail embryonic stages more than adults and proved effective against Aedes aegypti larvae, highlighting a One Health, green nanotechnology approach. Field trials and a production chain are needed for real‑world deployment.

triage.triage_reason: 新規の研究開発（ベクター制御技術）に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な発生を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
