article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Handicap International bringt Schutzmaterial und Notausrüstung bis in isolierte Dörfer / Hilfe trotz bewaffneter Gewalt und schlechter Transportwege
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Handicap International delivers protective equipment and emergency supplies to remote villages, despite armed violence and poor transport routes
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to rise, with cases reported in Ituri province and other regions. Handicap International (HI) is delivering protective equipment, medicines, isolation tents and hygiene supplies to remote villages that are hard to reach due to dense forests, muddy tracks, destroyed bridges and roads that become impassable after heavy rains. The security situation outside major cities remains volatile, with armed groups and attacks shaping access. HI is expanding logistics networks, opening new hubs and warehouses to ensure last-mile delivery of essential supplies. From January to September, HI organized over 200 transports, delivering more than 1,000 tonnes of relief. A new base in Uvira will enable ground deliveries, with existing bases in Goma and Beni and planned sites in Bunia and Nia-Nia, including a temperature-controlled warehouse.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ハンディキャップ・インターナショナル、武装暴力と劣悪な交通事情の中、孤立した村々まで防護資材と緊急支援物資を届ける
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の症例増加が継続しており、公衆衛生上深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクがあり、人道支援団体の活動状況からも国際的関心が高いと判断される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は既知の疾患だが、DRCでの継続的な流行拡大、治安悪化によるアクセス困難、人道支援の緊急性から既存のアウトブレイクのフォローアップとしてPICKUP判定。具体的な症例数・死亡数は本記事には記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค ขอผู้มีอาการต้องสงสัย 'ฝีดาษวานร' ให้แยกตัวจากผู้อื่น-เข้ารับการตรวจ - The Reporters
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Disease Control urges anyone with suspected monkeypox symptoms to isolate themselves from others and undergo testing.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Thailand: As of 9 November 2026, the Department of Disease Control reports varied clinical presentations with lesions on skin and mucous membranes, including genital, anal, oral, facial, and limb sites, often accompanied by fever, sore throat, or anal discomfort. Clade IIb has been the main circulating strain, but since mid-2029 Clade Ib has risen to prominence and is now the leading strain in the country, with mortality under 0.5%, though infection can be clearly symptomatic, especially in immunocompromised individuals or those with comorbidities who do not receive treatment. Cases are reported across major provinces and tourist destinations in scattered patterns; the majority of patients are men aged 18–49. Transmission occurs through close contact with lesions or contaminated objects, and via prolonged close contact including sexual contact, with possible droplet exposure. Guidance urges suspected cases to isolate, avoid close contact and sex, cover lesions, wash hands, and wear a well-fitted mask; hospitalization is not universal for confirmed cases, with home isolation guided by clinicians until all lesions heal and skin is renewed.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理局、サル痘(Mpox)の疑い症状がある人に他者からの隔離と検査受診を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: これまでタイで主流だったClade IIbに代わり、より重症度が高いとされるClade Ibが主要流行株となったことは異常・予想外であり、性的接触を含む人-人感染が続いている点で国際的拡大リスクも否定できないため。
triage.notes: Clade Ib（旧Clade I系統、2024年WHO PHEIC対象）がタイ国内で主流株化していることは注視が必要。死亡率は0.5%未満と報告されているが、免疫不全者や基礎疾患保有者での重症化、性的接触を含む人-人感染の継続に留意。続報でのクラスター発生状況や渡航関連事例の有無を確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola : Deux nouveaux vaccins en lice pour les essais cliniques | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Two new vaccines in the running for clinical trials | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain have progressed to scientific review for inclusion in the Tumaini ring-vaccination trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, pending national authorizations. The candidates are ChAdOx1 (Oxford/Serum Institute of India) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna). WHO green-lit evaluation after preclinical/clinical data reviews; trial start awaits national approvals. INRB leads on-field coordination, with partners including University of Antwerp, MSF, Epicentre, African CDC; CEPI funds support development. Tumaini employs ring vaccination protecting contacts; four networks are active. Ervebo is evaluated for cross-protection against Bundibugyo. PARTNERS trial (launched July) includes MBP134, remdesivir and combinations; maftivimab added; obeldevisir for post-exposure. First therapeutic results soon; vaccine results early 2027. Eastern DRC outbreak declared May 15, 2026, amid insecurity and access challenges; signals of cases in Kenya and Nigeria.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：臨床試験に向けて2種の新規ワクチンが選定
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で2026年5月に宣言されたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中であり、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの拡大の兆候があることから、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点でフルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発進捗が主題だが、背景として2026年5月宣言のコンゴ民主共和国東部エボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクの継続と、ケニア・ナイジェリアでの症例兆候が言及されている。インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）の所在地であり、発生国ではないため除外。ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 流感病毒进入活跃期，北京疾控送您"全家防护指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus enters its active period; Beijing CDC brings you the "Family Protection Guide."
article.articleSummary: Influenza is entering its active period in Beijing, with the Beijing CDC warning that autumn–winter indoor, poorly ventilated spaces promote spread. Influenza differs from the common cold: flu starts abruptly with fever, headache, fatigue and myalgia and can lead to pneumonia, myocarditis or encephalitis; infants may present without fever and the elderly may have low fever or fatigue. Globally, about 1 billion seasonal flu cases occur each year, with 3–5 million severe cases and 290,000–650,000 respiratory deaths. Transmission is mainly via droplets and aerosols; contact with contaminated objects is possible. Prevention centers on vaccination as the most effective measure. The 2026–2027 guidelines recommend vaccination for all 6 months and older; antibodies develop in 2–4 weeks. Beijing’s vaccination season runs September–October; the program began Sept 7, with free vaccination for seniors 60+, students, and frontline workers. Booking via 京通 App or clinics; emphasize hand hygiene, ventilation, masking in crowds, and seeking early medical care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスが活発期に突入、北京疾病予防管理センターが「家族向け防護ガイド」を提供
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な啓発・予防広報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行期到来に伴う予防啓発記事であり、異常な感染症イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Armed Men Try to Burn Ebola Centre in Beni
article.articleSummary: Armed men attempted arson at MSF’s Ebola treatment centre in Beni, eastern Congo, about 10 p.m. on 6 November 2026; 36 patients were inside and no casualties were reported. The attack followed the death that day of a woman who tested positive for Ebola; she was the wife of a suspected Wazalendo fighter, and companions tried to seize the body by force. Petrol bottles were found but did not explode. WHO expressed deep concern, noting that attacks in Mabalako on 5–6 November burned three health facilities and forced a suspension of response activities. As of 3 November 2026, WHO counted 10,668 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,198 deaths across eight provinces, with North Kivu hardest hit. Ebola spreads through contact with blood or body fluids and treatment centres isolate patients to limit transmission. The 36 patients’ status at the Beni centre was not clarified.

triage.headline_ja: 武装集団がベニのエボラ治療センターへの放火を試みる
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の大規模エボラ流行（確定症例10,668件、死亡5,198件）に加え、治療センターへの武力攻撃により対応活動が妨げられており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行（8州、死亡5,198人）に加え、治療センターへの放火未遂・医療施設焼失により対応活動が中断されている点が特に懸念される。武装勢力（Wazalendo）関連の治安情勢が感染症対応を阻害している複合的危機。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry Urges Vigilance as Mpox Symptoms Evolve in Thailand
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-09, Thailand reports Mpox evolving clinical presentation with Clade Ib now the primary circulating strain, replacing Clade IIb. Despite broader symptoms, overall community transmission remains low. Most infections involve men aged 18–49, with transmission mainly through close physical or sexual contact, and secondary spread via contaminated items or prolonged close contact including respiratory droplets. Atypical manifestations include localized lesions such as buttock boils, mucosal inflammation, sore throat, and severe anal pain, which can mimic tonsillitis or respiratory illness. Lab surveillance confirms Clade Ib with mortality under 0.5%, though severe disease can occur in immunocompromised individuals or those with untreated conditions. Cases have appeared in major urban centres, tourist hubs, and densely populated areas; no sustained transmission in the general population. Guidance: suspected cases should self-isolate, avoid sexual activity, cover lesions, and maintain hand hygiene; confirmed cases may isolate at home or be hospitalized based on severity. Public urged to reduce stigma and seek evaluation via 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省、Mpox症状の変化に伴い警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: タイにおいてMpoxの主要流行株がClade IIbからより重症化しやすいClade Ibへ変化したことは異常事象であり、国際的拡大リスクも懸念されるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: Clade Ibはアフリカで重症例報告があり、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性が高いとされるため、今後の感染動向とタイ国内外への拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Минздрав ДРК заявил о смерти более 5,3 тыс. человек от Эболы с мая
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC Ministry of Health announced more than 5,300 people have died from Ebola since May.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 10,920 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,323 deaths (case fatality 48.7%) since the outbreak began in May. Ituri province is the epicenter, accounting for 69.7% of cases, with 67 of 178 health zones across eight provinces affected. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there are no WHO-approved medicines or vaccines. Data come from the National Institute of Public Health within the DRC Ministry of Health. The crisis has spread beyond the DRC: Uganda had earlier declared its outbreak over (confirmed by WHO on Aug 25); Kenya reported its first Ebola case on Oct 6, and Nigeria confirmed Ebola on Oct 20. The information reflects ongoing transmission as of Nov 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DRC保健省、5月以降のエボラ出血熱による死者が5,300人を超えたと発表
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.7%、1万人超の感染者、複数国への拡大、承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない株による大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアへの感染拡大が記載されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。震源地はDRCのイトゥリ州。

article.articleHeadline: Âgé de 23 ans, ce jeune rugbyman meurt de la dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 23-year-old rugby player dies from dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old French business-school student Mathis Blondeau died on October 27, 2026 in Vietnam from dengue fever contracted during a Southeast Asia sabbatical. A rugby player for RC Quimpérois and INSEEC Lyon, he was infected while abroad. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Classic dengue includes high fever, chills, muscle pains, nausea, headache, fatigue, and a rash, typically lasting 2–7 days; severe dengue (dengue hemorrhagic fever) can cause plasma leakage, shock, fluid accumulation and respiratory distress. There is no specific antiviral treatment; management is supportive. Prevention relies on vector control and personal protection. Vaccination: Takeda’s Qdenga is recommended in France for certain populations in Guadeloupe, Martinique, Réunion and Mayotte; Dengvaxia is offered to 6–45-year-olds in overseas territories with prior infection. WHO cites tens to hundreds of millions of dengue cases annually, with over 15 million cases and more than 10,000 deaths at recent peaks (notably 2024).

triage.headline_ja: 23歳のラグビー選手、デング熱で死亡
triage.triage_reason: フランス人学生がベトナム滞在中にデング熱に感染し死亡した個別症例報告であり、アウトブレイクや異常な流行パターンを示す情報はない。デング熱は東南アジアで풍地病的であり、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルとは言えない。
triage.notes: 本記事は若いラグビー選手の個人的な死亡例を報じるヒューマンインタレスト記事であり、ベトナムにおけるデング熱のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。フランス及び海外領土（グアドループ、マルティニーク、レユニオン）はワクチン接種政策の文脈で言及されているのみで、対象国リストにも該当しないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Every Hour of Delay After an Open-Globe Injury Raises Endophthalmitis Risk,
article.articleSummary: Open-globe injury-associated endophthalmitis in central China rises with longer injury-to-admission. In 344 surgically treated patients (2017–2024) at a tertiary eye hospital, 172 developed preoperative endophthalmitis and were matched to 172 controls. Median injury-to-admission was 48.0 hours for cases (IQR 24–96) versus 8.0 hours for controls (IQR 5–12.5). Using a log2-transformed interval and propensity-score matching, each doubling of delay increased odds of endophthalmitis by 2.30 (95% CI 1.71–3.10) after adjustment for demographics and trauma factors; results were robust under multiple-imputation and complete-case analyses. The authors caution that this is a retrospective, single-center study and cannot prove causation. They frame the finding as a continuous, graded risk with delay, not a fixed cutoff, implying prompt admission reduces infection risk without identifying a safe interval.

triage.headline_ja: 開放性眼球外傷後の遅延1時間ごとに眼内炎リスクが上昇
triage.triage_reason: 外傷性眼内炎に関する単一施設の後ろ向き研究であり、感染症の公衆衛生リスクや国際的拡大とは無関係。疾患名のCoccidioidomycosisも本文内容と無関係で誤分類と考えられる。
triage.notes: 本記事は外傷性眼内炎（非感染症的な公衆衛生イベント）に関する臨床研究であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。Bluedotの疾患分類・地域付与は誤りと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: ดื่มน้ำแก้วเดียวกัน ติด "ฝีดาษลิง" ได้จริงไหม? กรมควบคุมโรคเฉลยแล้ว : เช็กข่าวชัวร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Drinking from the same glass: Can you really catch monkeypox? The Department of Disease Control has explained it — Check the facts.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Disease Control confirms mpox (monkeypox) can be transmitted through sharing a glass, addressing social-media misinformation. While more than 80% of mpox cases arise from sexual activity and close skin-to-skin contact, the virus can spread via other routes as well. Notably, contact with personal items contaminated with secretions or the virus—such as cups, dishes, utensils, clothing, and bed linens—constitutes a transmission pathway. Additional routes include close proximity without wearing a mask and mother-to-fetus transmission. The confirmation followed inquiries by Sanook News with the Department of Disease Control and Thailand's Centre for Fake News. The report centers on Thailand, published on 2026-11-09, and emphasizes factual, medically accurate guidance to the public.

triage.headline_ja: コップの共有でサル痘に感染する？タイ疾病管理局が事実確認
triage.triage_reason: これは実際の症例発生や流行報告ではなく、タイ疾病管理局によるSNS上の誤情報への事実確認・啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はMpoxの感染経路に関する一般啓発・ファクトチェック記事であり、タイ国内での具体的な新規症例発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 30岁马拉松健将都中招！肺炎链球菌血清型"洗牌"防护需与时俱进
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Even 30-year-old marathon stars are getting hit! Streptococcus pneumoniae serotype reshuffle—prevention must keep pace with the times.
article.articleSummary: World Pneumonia Day (Nov 12) in Hong Kong highlights invasive pneumococcal disease risk beyond the elderly, as a man in his 30s who regularly runs marathons developed severe invasive pneumococcal pneumonia with bacteremia due to serotype 3, required oxygen and 10–14 days in hospital, and left with lung scar and potential traction bronchiectasis. Streptococcus pneumoniae has over 100 serotypes; vaccination reshapes the serotype landscape, with serotypes 15A and 23A rising and often more antibiotic-resistant, complicating treatment though prompt antibiotics within four hours remain crucial. High-risk groups (age ≥50, children, asthma, bronchiectasis, cardiovascular disease) face greater risk of severe disease and complications such as stroke. Vaccination guidance now favors 20- or 21-valent pneumococcal vaccines; 21-valent covers emerging 15A and 23A strains and replaces some older ones. In Hong Kong (2025 data), subsidies target elderly/high-risk; all ages can vaccinate (self-pay or vouchers); co-vaccinate with influenza before autumn-winter peak.

triage.headline_ja: 30歳のマラソン好きも感染！肺炎球菌血清型の『入れ替わり』、予防も時代に合わせたアップデートが必要
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例紹介と世界肺炎デーに合わせた啓発・ワクチン推奨記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一症例の紹介とワクチン接種推奨を目的とした啓発記事。香港における肺炎球菌血清型の変化とワクチン政策についての一般情報であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nghệ An tìm nguyên nhân trâu, bò chết hàng loạt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nghệ An investigates the cause of a mass die-off of buffalo and cattle
article.articleSummary: In Nghệ An province, Vietnam, authorities in Hữu Kiệm commune are coordinating with the provincial Department of Animal Health to investigate a mass die-off of cattle and buffalo. From November 7 to 9, deaths rose from 21 to 41, concentrated mainly in the former Bảo Nam area, with 19 losses in the Ven Phò Thủy family of Khe Nạp village. Initial clinical signs include high fever, neck swelling, abdominal distention, foamy saliva, respiratory difficulty, and very rapid death, with officials suspecting acute anthrax; definitive pathogen confirmation awaits official lab results from submitted samples. Immediate containment includes culling carcasses per biosafety rules, zoning, disinfection, and vaccination of healthy livestock. Farmers are advised to avoid free-ranging grazing, improve nutrition, and report abnormal illness promptly; do not dispose of carcasses improperly and follow local guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省、水牛・牛の大量死の原因を調査
triage.triage_reason: 炭疽が疑われる家畜の大量死事例であり人獣共通感染症としてのリスクはあるが、病原体の確定診断待ちでヒト感染例の報告もないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 炭疽の確定診断は検査結果待ちであり、ヒトへの感染例は報告されていない。家畜の管理・処分（と畜制限、消毒、ワクチン接種）は地方当局により対応中。続報でヒト症例や病原体確定の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: RFI: в ДР Конго зафиксирована вспышка холеры
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RFI: A cholera outbreak has been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 60,000 cases since the start of the current year, with most infections in Upper Lomami, North Kivu, Tanganyika, and South Kivu. Health authorities in the DRC and neighboring Republic of the Congo are preparing preventive vaccination for nearly 2 million people across the Congo River region, including the capital Kinshasa, in the coming weeks to curb transmission along river routes. The situation is complicated by an ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC. Cholera, caused by Vibrio cholerae, spreads through contaminated water or food. Vaccination campaigns are a key mitigation measure, targeting populations in western and northern DRC and southern Republic of the Congo to mitigate cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: RFI：コンゴ民主共和国でコレラの流行が記録される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国東部で年初来6万人超のコレラ症例が報告され、エボラ出血熱の流行と重なり国境を越えた対応（隣国での予防接種計画）が必要とされているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）とコンゴ共和国（Republic of Congo、対象国リスト外）双方の国境地域での対応を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱の同時流行が状況を複雑化させている点にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RFI: в ДР Конго произошла вспышка холеры
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RFI: a cholera outbreak occurred in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has reached more than 60,000 cases since the start of 2026, according to RFI. In response, authorities in the DRC and neighboring Republic of Congo are launching a preventive vaccination campaign targeting up to 2 million people across western and northern DRC and the southern Republic of Congo, with Kinshasa included. The heaviest caseloads are in Haut-Lomami, North Kivu, Tanganyika, and South Kivu provinces. The infection is predominantly riverine, raising the risk of spread toward the Congo River. The outbreak unfolds amid an Ebola epidemic in eastern DRC, complicating public health responses. Cholera is caused by Vibrio cholerae and is transmitted through contaminated food or water.

triage.headline_ja: RFI：コンゴ民主共和国でコレラの流行が発生
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で6万人超のコレラ症例が発生し、エボラ流行と同時進行する中で予防接種キャンペーンが開始されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: エボラ流行と同時進行しているため医療資源の逼迫が懸念される。コンゴ共和国にも波及しているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Est de la RDC : Africa CDC condamne l'attaque des ADF à Cantine et alerte sur les risques de propagation d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eastern DRC: Africa CDC condemns the ADF attack in Cantine and warns of the risks of Ebola transmission.
article.articleSummary: On November 5–6, 2026, the Allied Democratic Forces carried out a deadly attack on Cantine-Aloya in Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), killing at least 33 people (provisional). The assailants struck multiple neighborhoods and set fire to more than 100 structures, including houses, motorcycles, a vehicle, shops, pharmacies, and health posts; casualties extended to Kangé and along the Biena River. At Cantine’s Kelekele hospital, about 180 inpatients fled, including individuals suspected or confirmed to have Ebola, amid the violence. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) condemned the attack and warned that disruptions to care, contact tracing, and surveillance risk fueling the ongoing Ebola outbreak. It urged a rapid corridor of peace to protect civilians, patients, health workers, and facilities in line with international humanitarian law. Dr. Jean Kaseya emphasized the urgent need to safeguard health services and access to communities.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴ：Africa CDCがカンティーヌでのADF襲撃を非難、エボラ拡散のリスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: 武力攻撃により病院からエボラ疑い・確定患者を含む入院患者約180人が避難し、接触者追跡・サーベイランスが中断、既存のエボラ流行拡大リスクが高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ニジェール（Niger）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみであり、対象国リストにもNigerは含まれないため除外した。武力紛争下でのエボラ対応の崩壊という複合的危機であり、既存のエボラアウトブレイクの悪化・拡散に直結する重大イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Spatiotemporal Study Reveals Shifting Malaria Clusters Across Districts in
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Assam, India (2011–2023) shows a substantial statewide decline but persistent, highly focal transmission with clusters in forested border districts and central hill tracts. Across 27 baseline districts (aligned to the 2011 Census), 147,007 cases were recorded. Adults over 15 years bore the majority of the burden (90,801 cases; 61.8%), with males most affected; school-age children (5–14) had the highest relative incidence, while under-5s had lower absolute counts. Rural residents (84.2%) live in flood-prone, monsoonal Assam (≈36.16 million people; 78,438 sq km), where standing water sustains vectors amid historic Plasmodium falciparum malaria, land-use pressures, insecticide/drug resistance, and limited healthcare access. The study used SaTScan cluster detection and Bayesian INLA modeling, finding zero-inflated Poisson models fit best, underscoring ongoing local transmission despite overall decline.

triage.headline_ja: 時空間研究により、アッサム州の各県におけるマラリア集積の変化が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 2011〜2023年の学術的な時空間疫学研究であり、全体的な減少傾向を示す後ろ向き分析。新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や急性のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2011〜2023年の長期データに基づく学術的な空間疫学解析であり、統計的手法（SaTScan、Bayesian INLA）を用いた研究報告。新規発生イベントではないため、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Инфекционист рассказал, в каких странах есть риск заболевания оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An infectious disease specialist explained in which countries there is a risk of contracting monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox risk exists in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Thailand, Spain, the United Kingdom, and other foreign countries as of 2026-11-09. The largest numbers in the latest WHO briefings are in Madagascar, DR Congo, Angola, Kenya, and Cameroon. In Moscow's Domodedovo Hospital, a man who had returned from Barcelona was hospitalized with monkeypox; this marks the fourth case in the past month. In 2026, cases have also been reported in Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador, Singapore, Norway, Costa Rica, Ghana, Lithuania, and other countries. Traveler risk depends on behavior rather than route; a typical tourist with no close contact is unlikely to be infected; higher caution for immunocompromised people, pregnant women, and young children. Monkeypox is a rare viral disease causing fever, malaise, lymphadenopathy, followed by a rash. Rospotrebnadzor issued prevention guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医、サル痘（エムポックス）感染リスクのある国々について解説
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエムポックス（主にクレードI）流行国・輸入症例国を列挙した解説・インタビュー記事であり、DRC・ガーナ・タイに関する具体的な新規症例データや重症度情報が乏しいため、現時点ではフルRRAに進めるには情報不足と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（マダガスカル、アンゴラ、カメルーン、ケニア、モスクワの輸入症例等）に言及する一般的なリスク解説記事であり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC・ガーナ・タイのみ。既知の進行中のエムポックス流行（クレードI/II）に関する再確認的内容であり、新規性・具体性に乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 5,3 тыс. человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in DR Congo exceeded 5.3 thousand.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 5,300 people, with a case fatality rate around 48.7% (NIHP, via TASS; earlier NIHP reports CFR at 51.6%). The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri Province, about 70% of confirmed cases, affecting 67 of 178 health zones across eight provinces. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no WHO-licensed treatments or vaccines, marking the fastest spread since the virus was identified in 1976. The epidemic began in May in DRC and Uganda, with Uganda later declaring the end of its outbreak; October saw the first infections detected in Kenya and Nigeria. Last month the death toll surpassed 5,000, underscoring sustained high transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数が5,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48.7%の大規模エボラ流行で、8州67保健地区に拡大し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアも記事中に言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ウガンダは既に終息宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค เผย 'ฝีดาษวานร' Clade Ib ระบาดหลักในไทย เตือนอาการเจ็บคอ-แผลในปาก อาจไร้ตุ่มชัดเจน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control reveals 'Monkeypox' Clade Ib is the primary outbreak in Thailand; warns of sore throat and mouth ulcers; may not present with clearly visible bumps.
article.articleSummary: Thailand's Department of Disease Control reports Monkeypox (Mpox) Clade Ib as the primary circulating strain in Thailand, with sustained transmission in major provinces, tourist areas, and densely populated communities. Predominantly affected are men aged 18–49; main risk factors include sexual activity, attending parties, and living in close quarters. Clade Ib has a fatality rate below 0.5% but can cause severe complications in immunocompromised individuals or those with comorbidities. Clinical presentation is variable: fever, sore throat, mucosal inflammation, and lesions may appear on genital, anal, oral, or facial mucosa; rash may be absent or not clearly visible early, sometimes mimicking tonsillitis or anal abscess. Transmission occurs via direct/close contact with lesions, fluids, or shared items, and through prolonged close respiratory exposure. Management allows home isolation; isolate until lesions heal and new skin covers. Emphasizes non-stigmatization; testing available; hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病対策局、『サル痘』クレードIbがタイで主流の流行株であると発表、喉の痛みや口内潰瘍に注意、明瞭な発疹が出ない場合もあると警告
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ib（より重篤とされる系統）がタイで主要な流行株として持続的に人-人感染しており、観光地や人口密集地域にも拡大していることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: Clade Ibは従来DRC等で報告されてきたより重篤とされる系統であり、タイで主流株として持続伝播している点は国際的監視上重要。致死率は0.5%未満とされるが、免疫不全者や基礎疾患保有者には重症化リスクあり。観光地での感染拡大は国際的拡散リスクを高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Death Toll Reaches 5,372 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has killed 5,372 people, with a fatality rate of 51.6% among 10,414 recorded cases as of October 30, according to the National Institute for Medical Research. Declared May 15, the outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus and is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, and the world’s second-largest after West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic. Widespread fear of contracting Ebola has led families to avoid visiting health facilities, undermining vaccination programs for children and reducing access to essential maternal and child health services, per clinicians and humanitarian organizations. Local residents like Masika Forahe in Butembo report reluctance to send children to treatment centers due to fatalism about outcomes. The article underscores the ongoing public health challenge in controlling transmission while maintaining routine care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が5,372人に到達
triage.triage_reason: 致死率51.6%、死者5,372人・症例10,414件に達し、DRC史上最大かつ世界第2位の規模のエボラ流行であり、医療忌避によるワクチン接種・母子保健サービスへの悪影響も報告されているためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文ではDRC（特にNorth Kivu州Butembo）での流行のみが主題であり、Angolaでの発生は言及されていないため除外した。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する直接の記述はなく不明とした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Brazil confirms 4 Newcastle disease outbreaks as export restrictions mount
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports four Newcastle disease outbreaks in Nova Itaberaba (6,000-turkey farm), Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim, with the first case detected Oct 18 by routine laboratory surveillance; subsequent detections followed on Oct 24, Oct 26 and Nov 3. All events occurred within the sanitary restriction area after initial detection, prompting a 60‑day animal health emergency for Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim with poultry movement controls. Trade restrictions spread across multiple importers: Malaysia nationwide; Mexico initially nationwide but later regionalised to non‑affected states; China and Chile limited to the affected state. Twenty‑eight export markets have measures within the sanitary‑control area, including Saudi Arabia, UAE, Japan, the EU, the UK and South Korea. Regionalisation is estimated to preserve US$954 million in annual trade. Containment includes culling about 6,000 turkeys, disinfection, movement controls and intensified surveillance; 51 teams inspected 362 backyard and 57 commercial premises by 28 Oct; avian paramyxovirus‑1 was detected in pigeons outside the area but deemed epidemiologically unrelated.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでニューカッスル病の発生が4件確認され、輸出制限が拡大
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きん（鳥類）の疾病であり、人への健康被害や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。主に貿易・農業分野への影響であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも実質的に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家きんの動物衛生事案であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響は記事中に言及なし。ブラジル国内（Santa Catarina州）での発生であり、他国（韓国・米国・日本・メキシコ・中国・チリ・マレーシア・サウジアラビア・UAE・英国）はいずれも輸入規制を課した貿易相手国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Burundi : plus de 2850 cas de choléra en dix mois
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Burundi: more than 2,850 cholera cases in ten months.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Burundi reports 2,855 cases from January 1 to November 3, 2026 across 13 of 47 health districts, with the epidemic ongoing in Bujumbura, the economic capital. In Rumonge, along Lake Tanganyika’s shore in the southwest, about a dozen cases have been reported, with several hospitalizations and at least one death at home. Authorities note a rising tide of cases in the city’s northwest and in the southern part of the country. Health Minister Dr. Fidèle Nkezabahizi calls for partner coordination and a multisectoral response to strengthen local capacities, hygiene, and infection prevention in hospitals, and to complete an elimination plan. Cholera is endemic along Lake Tanganyika and the Rusizi Plain near the DRC border in the west. The main driver is lack of access to safe drinking water, prompting use of contaminated sources. In 2025 Burundi recorded roughly 3,000 cases and 13 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジ：10か月間でコレラ感染者2,850人超
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準で重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の複数項目に該当し、保健大臣が多部門連携と国際支援を呼びかけていることから社会政治的関心も認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブルンジにおけるコレラ流行であり、DRCは国境付近の地理的言及（Rusiziプレーン）のみで実際の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当する国はない。

article.articleHeadline: 종근당고촌재단, 결핵 조기 진단에 기여한 3개국 보건단체에 고촌상 수여
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation awards the Gochon Award to three national health organizations for their contributions to the early diagnosis of tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation awarded the 20th Gochon Award to three national health organizations for advancing early tuberculosis diagnosis and treatment access: the Marshall Islands TB Management Program, India's REACH (TB Patient Support Group), and Kenya Health Solutions Center. The ceremony occurred in Bali, Indonesia, on November 5, with about 300 health officials in attendance; the award recognizes their work in early TB case identification. The Marshall Islands program screened about 20,000 people and detected 314 TB patients. REACH screened roughly 1.5 million people and found 3,000 TB cases. The Kenya Health Solutions Center used AI-assisted chest X-rays to screen 1,876 new TB patients. The event was announced on November 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 鍾根堂古村財団、結核早期診断に貢献した3カ国の保健団体に古村賞を授与
triage.triage_reason: 結核の早期診断・治療支援活動に対する表彰イベントであり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は表彰式に関する内容であり、特定国での結核の異常発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。バリ島は授賞式の開催地に過ぎず、インドネシアでの発生事例ではない。インド・マーシャル諸島・ケニアも既存プログラムの実績紹介であり、対象国リストにマーシャル諸島・ケニアは含まれないためインドのみ検討対象となるが、インドでも異常事態の報告はないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية تحذّر من متحور كورونا الجديد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization warns of the new coronavirus variant.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization warns that the new coronavirus variant PJ.2.1 is hard to distinguish from COVID-19, colds, or flu by symptoms alone, underscoring the need for testing in certain cases to guide treatment and public health actions. The variant, first identified in June 2026, has been detected in about 19 countries, including the United States, China, France, Sweden, Spain, and Singapore, signaling growing global spread. Symptoms may overlap with other respiratory infections; notable features such as severe sore throat and prolonged fatigue after recovery are not definitive. Tests and laboratory confirmation remain the most accurate method to identify PJ.2.1. In the United States, wastewater and traveler-based genomic analyses show the variant accounted for about 20.5% of infections as of October 19, 2026, up from 14.2% two weeks earlier. The CDC monitors PJ.2.1 under airport traveler surveillance and flight wastewater programs.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、新たなコロナウイルス変異株について警告
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が約19か国で検出され国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2つに該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（米国、中国、フランス、スペイン、シンガポール、スウェーデン）にまたがるWHOの国際的警告であり、対象国リストに該当するのは中国のみ。米国の下水・渡航者サーベイランスデータで増加傾向が報告されているが、対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Agusan town logs 467 dengue cases; infection hits all 27 villages
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections in San Francisco, Agusan del Sur rise to 467 cases as of Friday, Nov 6, 2026, with transmission in all 27 villages since year start; two deaths. Teens and young adults aged 15–19 account for 88 cases (18.8%). Top barangays: Lapinigan 59, Pasta 45, 5 38, 1 32, Pisa-an 31. Others with double-digit totals include Barangay 4 (30), Karaus (29), Alegria (27), San Isidro (26), Barangay 2 (23), Bayugan 2 (23), Barangay 3 (19), Hubang (16), Borbon (11), Das-agan (11). Health Office urges continued vigilance despite no new fatalities. DOH’s enhanced 4S strategy advises searching and destroying mosquito breeding grounds, using insect repellents and protective clothing, seeking medical care at fever onset, and targeted fogging in cluster zones. Households should implement 4T routines at 4 p.m.: taob, taktak, tuyo, takip.

triage.headline_ja: アグサン町でデング熱467例を記録、感染は全27村に拡大
triage.triage_reason: フィリピン一地域（Agusan del Sur州San Francisco町）での季節性デング熱流行であり、死亡例もあるが国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域内感染拡大の継続性から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンにおいて毎年発生する風土病であり、本件は地域レベルの流行。DOHが4S戦略・4T対策を実施中で、外部支援の必要性は現時点で示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: ADF Attack at Cantine, North Kivu Could Fuel Ebola Spread - Taarifa Rwanda:
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, is at renewed risk following an attack by the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) on civilians in Cantine-Aloya, Beni territory, on the night of 5–6 November 2026. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention ( Africa CDC) warns that attacks on health facilities and the flight of hundreds of patients, including those with confirmed or suspected Ebola, threaten essential outbreak-response activities such as patient care, contact tracing, and disease surveillance. The organization condemns the assault and emphasizes that disrupted access to care increases transmission risk in communities already contending with the epidemic. Africa CDC calls for a peace corridor, protection of civilians and health workers, safeguarding of facilities, and safe, sustainable access to affected areas. Dr. Jean Kaseya highlighted the elevated risks to populations due to interrupted response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州カンティーヌでのADF(民主同盟軍)の攻撃がエボラ拡大を助長する恐れ - Taarifa Rwanda
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ流行地域で武装勢力の攻撃により患者が医療施設から逃げ出し、接触者追跡や監視活動が中断、Africa CDCが国際支援を含む緊急対応を要請しており、IHR基準複数・WPRO基準複数に該当する。
triage.notes: Africa CDCのJean Kaseya博士が公式に懸念を表明し、安全回廊の設置や医療従事者・施設の保護を要請している。既存エボラ流行への攻撃によるアウトブレイク対応中断が主題であり、新規発生ではなく既知流行の悪化事例。

article.articleHeadline: Специалист назвал страны, в которых есть риск заболевания оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A specialist identified the countries where there is a risk of monkeypox.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox risk exists in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Angola, Kenya, Cameroon, Spain, France, Germany, Italy, and other European countries, according to Professor Murad Shahmar-danov of Russia’s Pyrogov Institute of Clinical Medicine. He notes that the latest WHO tallies show the highest number of cases in Madagascar, DR Congo, Angola, Kenya, and Cameroon, with historically large outbreaks in DR Congo, Uganda, and Sierra Leone. The specialist cautions that Russia faces only a limited risk; transmission occurs mainly through close physical contact with an infected person or contaminated objects. Respiratory transmission is possible but requires prolonged close face-to-face interaction and is unlikely to drive mass outbreaks. The infection runs about 2–4 weeks; a person becomes contagious 1–2 days before rash onset and remains contagious until all crusts fall off and new skin forms.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がサル痘（Mpox）の感染リスクがある国々を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はロシアの専門家がWHOの既存データに基づきMpoxリスク国を解説する一般的な注意喚起記事であり、新規の発生情報や事態の進展を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシア国内向けの一般的な健康啓発記事で、DRCを含むアフリカ諸国での既知のMpox流行状況（WHO発表データ）を紹介する内容。新規の症例急増やアウトブレイクの進展等の具体的情報はなく、専門家インタビュー形式の解説記事に留まる。DRC以外の国（マダガスカル、アンゴラ、ケニア、カメルーン、シエラレオネ、ウガンダ、欧州諸国）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 마셜제도·인도·케냐 3개단체 '결핵 퇴치 공로' 고촌상 수상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three organizations from the Marshall Islands, India, and Kenya win the Gochon Award for tuberculosis elimination.
article.articleSummary: Three organizations from the Marshall Islands, India, and Kenya were named the 2026 Gochon Award winners for tuberculosis elimination by the Chong Kun Dang Gochon Foundation. The 20th Gochon Award ceremony was held in Bali, Indonesia, on November 5 (local time) and announced on November 9. The Marshall Islands Tuberculosis Management Program screened about 20,000 residents in Majuro for TB, diabetes, and leprosy, detecting 314 active TB cases with a treatment success rate of 95.9%. In India, the Riche group partnered with private hospitals and pharmacies to screen approximately 1.5 million people, identifying 3,000 TB patients. In Kenya, the Health Solutions Centre employed mobile diagnostic equipment in underserved areas, detecting 1,876 TB cases. Since inception, the foundation has supported 13 scholars and 22 organizations with grants totaling 3.5 billion KRW. Current date reference: 2026-11-09.

triage.headline_ja: マーシャル諸島・インド・ケニアの3団体、結核撲滅功労で高村賞受賞
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核撲滅活動への表彰に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な感染拡大等のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: マーシャル諸島・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドネシアは授賞式開催地として言及されているが主題ではない点に留意。本記事は表彰イベントの報道であり、新規の感染症発生情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: une grenade découverte devant le Bureau de la zone de santé de Beni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a grenade discovered in front of the Beni Health Zone Office.
article.articleSummary: as of 9 November 2026, authorities in North Kivu’s Beni Health Zone, DRC, report a grenade found outside the Beni Health Zone Office. The discovery follows a weekend of violence affecting Ebola response sites. During the night of 5-6 November, an attack by the armed ADF hit a health facility in Cantine, Beni Territory, treating patients suspected and confirmed with Ebola. The subsequent night, unidentified individuals attempted arson at an Ebola Treatment Center supported by Doctors Without Borders (MSF), where about thirty patients were hospitalized. International organizations involved in the response to the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC condemned the incidents. The report provides no precise details on the grenade’s origin or intended target, underscoring ongoing security and safety threats to Ebola care and containment efforts in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行下のDRC：ベニ保健地区事務所前で手榴弾発見
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のDRC第17次エボラ流行の対応拠点が武装勢力の攻撃・放火未遂・手榴弾発見という治安悪化に見舞われており、感染症対応の継続性と拡大リスクに直結するため、フルRRAでの評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ自体の新規症例報告ではなく、北キブ州ベニ地区のエボラ対応施設に対する武装勢力(ADF)の攻撃・放火未遂・手榴弾発見という治安インシデントが主題。MSF支援の治療センターに約30名の患者が入院中であり、対応活動の中断・治安悪化が流行制御に深刻な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。国際機関が懸念を表明しており、既存の第17次エボラ流行の進展として継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: แค่สัมผัสก็ติดได้! กรมควบคุมโรคเตือน "ฝีดาษวานร" อาการเปลี่ยน ยันสายพันธุ์หลักระบาดในไทยยังควบคุมได้ - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Just touching it can infect you! The Department of Disease Control warns that monkeypox symptoms have changed, and the main circulating strain in Thailand remains under control.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Thailand remains under control, with the main circulating strains shifting from Clade IIb to Clade Ib by mid-2026. Symptoms vary by lesion location and can include rashes, blisters, or ulcers on skin and mucous membranes (genital, anal, oral, facial, limbs), often with fever or sore throat; rash can be minimal or absent. Clade Ib's case fatality rate is below 0.5% but can cause clearer disease in immunocompromised or untreated individuals. Cases have appeared across major provinces and tourist areas, with no evidence of widespread transmission. Most patients are men aged 18–49 with risk factors such as sexual behavior, gatherings, or cohabitation. Transmission is via direct/close contact with lesions or contaminated objects, or prolonged close sexual contact; respiratory droplets are possible. Suspected cases should isolate, cover lesions, wash hands, wear a mask, and seek medical evaluation; hospitalization not always required. Hotline 1422.

triage.headline_ja: 触れるだけで感染!? 疾病管理局が「サル痘」の症状変化を警告 ― タイで流行中の主要株は依然として制御可能と確認
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内でMpox Clade Ibへの主要株シフトが報告されているが、当局は『制御可能』と評価しており、広範な伝播の証拠はないため、続報注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 致死率0.5%未満で当局は制御下にあると明言。主なリスク因子は性的接触等で、ハイリスク層への限定的流行と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ nhiễm nhiều virus hô hấp cùng lúc có nguy hiểm?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is it dangerous for children to be infected with multiple respiratory viruses at the same time?
article.articleSummary: An 8-month-old in Ho Chi Minh City with concurrent RSV and Rhinovirus infection does not automatically imply greater severity than a single-virus infection. Co-infection can raise the risk of bronchiolitis, pneumonia, or respiratory failure if inflammation progresses, but severity depends on the pathogen, airway injury, and the child’s age and health. Infants under one year, especially premature babies or those with congenital heart disease, chronic lung disease, or immunodeficiency, are at higher risk of complications. Most cases are managed with supportive care: hydration, nasal suction, and close monitoring; antibiotics only for suspected bacterial infection. Seek urgent care for rapid breathing, chest retractions, poor feeding, lethargy, or cyanosis. Prevention: minimize exposure to sick contacts, avoid tobacco smoke, and follow vaccination schedules (influenza, pneumococcus, RSV, pertussis). Dr. Vo Thi Minh Tuyền, Tam Anh General Hospital, District 8.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A H1N1 Dominates Thailand as Cases Surge
article.articleSummary: Thailand's influenza surveillance shows Influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 dominating October, accounting for 115 of 122 lab-confirmed flu infections (94.3%) from 581 specimens tested. For January–October 2026, 8,734 samples were analyzed with 1,278 positives (positivity 14.63%); H1N1pdm09 caused 704 cases (55.09%), followed by A(H3N2) with 306 (23.94%) and Influenza B Victoria lineage with 268 (20.97%). Genomic data indicate H1N1pdm09 subclade 6B.1A.5a.2a.1 as the principal circulating group; H3N2 is dominated by the K clade, and B by V1A.3a.2. Antiviral resistance testing of 127 October specimens found no known resistance mutations, including absence of H275Y linked to oseltamivir. Officials urge continued genomic surveillance, vaccination, hygiene, early clinical assessment, and ongoing monitoring given rapid subtype shifts and potential resistance emergence.

triage.headline_ja: タイでインフルエンザA型(H1N1)が優勢、症例急増
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザのサーベイランス報告であり、薬剤耐性変異は検出されておらず、異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない通常の監視情報である。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告。抗ウイルス薬耐性変異（H275Y等）は検出されず、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn châu Phi diễn biến phức tạp ở Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever in Dak Lak Province develops in a complex manner.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, remains highly active as of early November 2026, devastating smallholder herds. Since January, ASF has affected 279 households across 46 communes, with over 11,600 pigs dead or culled, and nearly 650 tons of pork removed. In October and early November, 27 households across seven communes (Ea Súp, Ea Bung, Krông Ana, Ea Khăl, Ea Kiết, Cuôr Đăng, Ea Kao) reported outbreaks, totaling more than 350 pigs dead or culled and about 20 tons of weight. Twenty communes still have outbreaks not yet 21 days free of disease, indicating ongoing risk, especially for small-scale producers. Authorities are intensifying surveillance, controlling pig movement and sales, enforcing timely culling and disinfection, and cracking down on violations such as hidden infections and illicit transport, while promoting strict biosecurity and caution against restocking until conditions are safe.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でアフリカ豚コレラ（ASF）の流行が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: ASFは家畜（豚）のみに感染する非ズーノーシス疾患であり直接的な公衆衛生リスクはないが、広範な地域で継続的な発生と防疫対応が報告されており、経済的・農業的影響の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、IHR(2005)上の公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。ただし豚産業への経済的打撃と地域拡大が続いており、農業・貿易関連の動向として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : huit zones de santé en moins, et le foyer qui bascule vers le Nord-Kivu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Eight health zones fewer, and the epicenter shifts toward North Kivu.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shifts the epicenter toward North Kivu, while Ituri remains the epicenter with 70% of total cases but only 37.1% of new infections. As of 6 November, 58 of 178 health zones are affected, down from 66 two weeks earlier. Ituri remains the epicenter; Mandina zone has peaked but stays at risk. The outbreak spans six provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Tshopo, Bas-Uélé and North Ubangi—with South Ubangi over 42 days without a new case. Since onset, more than 2,881 recoveries and an 83.9% follow-up rate. Cholera shows a downward trend since week 38; on 27 October, North Kivu reported 63 new confirmed cholera cases and 27 deaths in 24 hours, with Kasindi isolation centers opened on the Ugandan border. On 3 November, Eve Bazaiba launched the STAR-RDC emergency component, funded at $250 million by the World Bank, to bolster surveillance and prevent resurgence.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：保健ゾーンが8つ減少、流行の中心が北キブ州へ移行
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに加え、コレラによる多数の死者（24時間で27人）が報告されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダ国境での隔離施設開設）がある。
triage.notes: ガンビア（Lower River Division, Mandina）の地名は、DRC国内の同名地区（Mandina zone）との混同によるタグ付けミスと考えられ、記事主題とは無関係のため除外した。世界銀行資金によるSTAR-RDC緊急対応プログラム（2.5億ドル）が開始されており、国際支援が既に動いている。

article.articleHeadline: Burundi : 2 855 cas de choléra recensés dans 13 districts du 1er janvier au 3 novembre 2026 - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Burundi: 2,855 cholera cases recorded in 13 districts from January 1 to November 3, 2026 - Mali Actu.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Burundi totals 2,855 cases across 13 districts from January 1 to November 3, 2026, per the WHO office in Bujumbura reporting on November 8, 2026. The epidemic affects Bujumbura, the economic capital, and Rumonge in the southwest, with Rumonge recording about ten cases, several hospitalizations, and at least one death at home. The 2025 annual tally was about 3,000 cases and 13 deaths; figures cover different periods. The outbreak remains concentrated along Lake Tanganyika and the Rusizi plain near the Democratic Republic of Congo border, driven by limited access to safe drinking water and use of contaminated sources; heavy rains can elevate water contamination. In the north, 2,052 homes were destroyed by storms in Butanyerera by mid-October 2026. Health Minister Fidèle Nkezabahizi urged better coordination and intensified preventive measures and hygiene in health facilities to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジ：2026年1月1日から11月3日までに13県でコレラ2,855例を記録 - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: コレラ感染者2,855例、入院・死亡例があり、安全な飲料水へのアクセス不足により感染が継続しているため、WPRO基準で複数該当し保健大臣の公的言及もあることからフルRRAへの移行を検討すべき。
triage.notes: 主発生国はブルンジであり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは国境付近の地理的言及のみで、発生国としての記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Flambée de choléra au Burundi : Plus de 2 850 cas recensés, la capitale et le Sud en alerte - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera outbreak in Burundi: More than 2,850 cases recorded, the capital and the South on alert - Mali Actu.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Burundi: 2,855 cases reported from January 1 to November 3, 2026, with active Vibrio cholerae transmission in 13 health districts. The hardest-hit areas are the northwestern suburbs of Bujumbura and Rumonge commune in the southwest, with hospitalizations and at least one death recorded at home. Traditionally endemic along the Rusizi plain near the Democratic Republic of Congo border and along Lake Tanganyika, the outbreak is driven by severe water shortages and reliance on contaminated surface water. The Ministry of Public Health and the World Health Organization have launched a multisectoral response to break transmission, prioritizing intensified field interventions, strengthened community-level actors, improved hygiene and infection prevention in health facilities, and finalization of a national cholera elimination plan. Burundi reported around 3,000 cases and 13 deaths in 2025; without rapid improvements in potable-water access, a similar toll is possible in late 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ブルンジでコレラ流行：2,850人以上の症例確認、首都と南部で警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: コレラのアウトブレイクで死亡例・複数地区への拡大があるが、対象国（DRC等）での発生ではなくブルンジが主体であり、対象国リストに該当する国での直接発生は確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブルンジにおけるコレラ流行であり、DRCは国境地域として言及されているのみで発生国ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国は含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Papua Barat: Tiga kabupaten masuk endemis tinggi malaria - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Papua Health Office: Three regencies enter high malaria endemicity - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: West Papua Province Health Office reports 8,234 confirmed malaria cases from January–August 2026, with three of seven regencies in high endemicity: Manokwari (3,702 cases; API 11.14 per 1,000), Teluk Wondama (2,063; API 29.97), and Manokwari Selatan (1,204; API 21.3). The other regencies—Teluk Bintuni (632; API 3.86), Kaimana (366; API 4.14), Fakfak (248; API 1.44)—are moderate. Authorities are coordinating cross-regional control strategies, including border areas with Sorong Selatan (Papua Barat Daya) to curb transmission, given mobility in Kamundan and Kalitami. Pegunungan Arfak remains an elimination area. Nationwide, Indonesia recorded 706,297 malaria cases in 2025, up ~30% from 2024, with six Papua provinces contributing about 674,046 cases. Achieving the national malaria elimination target for 2030 requires intensified cross-provincial cooperation across Papua regions.

triage.headline_ja: 西パプア州保健局：3県が高度マラリア流行地域に分類
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは当該地域の既知の風土病だが、全国的に症例数が前年比約30%増加しており、流行拡大の兆候として経過観察が望ましい。
triage.notes: マラリアはパプア地域の既存の風土病であり、IHR通知基準には該当しない。ただしインドネシア全国で2025年の症例数が前年比約30%増加しており、特にパプア6州が全体の大半を占める点は継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Перечислены страны с риском заражения оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: List of countries at risk of monkeypox infection.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox infections are reported worldwide. As of 9 November 2026, WHO data show Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Angola, Kenya and Cameroon leading in cases, with earlier large foci in DRC, Uganda and Sierra Leone. Other countries reporting cases include Spain, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy and Thailand; in 2026 also Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador, Singapore, Norway, Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania, among others. For travelers, risk hinges on behavior; minimal risk if avoiding close contact with an infected person, higher caution for immunocompromised individuals, pregnant women and young children. A man returning from Barcelona was diagnosed at Domodedovskaya Hospital in Russia—the fourth such case there in the past month. Symptoms include fever, systemic illness, enlarged lymph nodes, then a rash. The disease is rare and particularly dangerous for those with weak immunity; officials note transmission requires very close contact.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘（エムポックス）感染リスクのある国々が列挙される
triage.triage_reason: 既知のエムポックス（サル痘）流行状況をまとめた一般情報記事であり、新規の異常事態や急増を示す具体的データはないが、DRC・ガーナ・タイなど対象国での継続的な症例報告があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア語の一般向け旅行注意喚起記事で、WHOデータを引用しつつ複数国の既存の流行状況を概説している。DRC・ウガンダ・シエラレオネは『以前からの大規模感染地』、マダガスカル・DRC・アンゴラ・ケニア・カメルーンは『症例数で上位』、タイ・ガーナは『症例報告あり』とされる。具体的な症例数・重症度・公的機関の反応については記事内に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Cacar Api pada Pasien Ginjal, Risiko Infeksi Bisa Meningkat hingga 8 Kali Lipat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be Vigilant for Smallpox in Kidney Patients, Infection Risk Can Increase Up to Eightfold.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, chronic kidney disease (CKD) patients in Indonesia face heightened risk of herpes zoster (shingles). An observational study of health insurance data shows hemodialysis patients have 35% higher risk than those without kidney impairment, while kidney transplant recipients face more than eightfold higher risk. Shingles results from reactivation of the varicella-zoster virus, which remains dormant after chickenpox and can reactivate when immunity wanes. In CKD patients, complications extend beyond skin symptoms to postherpetic neuralgia lasting months or years, and possible vision, hearing, and balance problems if the face or nerves are involved. Personal stories underscore pain, disability, and psychosocial impact. Indonesia’s burden of CKD is about 10.3% per Global Kidney Health Atlas 2023. Vaccination may reduce risk but requires physician consultation due to individual health factors; awareness is urged ahead of National Health Day on 12 November.

triage.headline_ja: 腎疾患患者における帯状疱疹に注意、感染リスクは最大8倍に増加する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 個人の基礎疾患（慢性腎臓病）に伴う帯状疱疹（水痘帯状疱疹ウイルスの再活性化）に関する啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は慢性腎臓病患者における帯状疱疹リスクに関する医学啓発情報であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: MS deve enfrentar alta da dengue em 2027 e lidera incidência de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health to Face a Dengue Surge in 2027 and Leads in Chikungunya Incidence
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces a Dengue surge in 2027 with an estimated 860,000 probable Dengue cases nationwide, 80% uncertainty (560,000–1.6 million), April peak ~40,000. Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Sergipe, Acre, and Minas Gerais expected increases; others stable or declining. This follows a growing Chikungunya concern, with more than 90,000 probable Chikungunya cases forecast next season; Brazil recorded 127,000 in 2024–2025 and 76,000 in 2025–2026. Mato Grosso do Sul has the highest Chikungunya incidence; trends also rising in Northeast states, parts of the South (three states), São Paulo, and Mato Grosso. Dengue and Chikungunya are transmitted by Aedes aegypti, causing fever and body pains; Chikungunya can cause intense, persistent joint pain. El Niño super event considered but not sole predictor; planning should emphasize short-term forecasts and vector-control to eliminate breeding sites such as standing water; seek medical care for symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、2027年にデング熱急増に直面、チクングニア熱罹患率で首位
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱・チクングニア熱の季節性流行予測であり、毎年発生する既知の媒介感染症であるため異常性は低いが、大規模な症例数予測と継続的な蚊媒介曝露のリスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル保健当局による2027年シーズンの予測モデルに基づく報告であり、既存の季節性流行パターンの延長線上にある。新規性・異常性は認められないが、大規模な症例数予測のため動向を継続注視する。

article.articleHeadline: 新北新增登革熱本土病例　感染源待釐清
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Taipei reports additional locally transmitted dengue fever cases; source of infection under investigation.
article.articleSummary: New Taipei City, Taiwan – On 2026-11-09 the Taiwan CDC reported one locally acquired dengue case and a Vietnam-derived imported cluster of two cases. The local patient is a woman in her 40s from Xinzhuang District who developed fever and fatigue in late October; no overseas travel; infection source under investigation; household contacts asymptomatic. The imported cluster involves two adults (40s–60s), a male and a female, who travelled with a tour to Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam in late October and were diagnosed after returning. Public health actions include larval source cleanup and chemical control at residences and activity sites, with monitoring through 2026-12-06. Year to date: 245 dengue cases, 18 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 13, Changhua 2, Pingtung 2, New Taipei 1) and 227 imported. Major origins: Vietnam 69, Philippines 35, Indonesia 31. Global context: 2.51 million cases by September, Americas ~69%; guidance emphasizes vector control, protective measures for travelers, and NS1 rapid testing to aid early diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: 新北市でデング熱の国内感染例が新たに発生、感染源は調査中
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性デング熱の定期サーベイランス報告であり、症例数も例年規模で地域的異常や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。対象国は主題として扱われていない。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の渡航先として言及されているのみで、記事の主題となる発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 新北爆本土登革熱！40多歲女多次就醫才確診 富國島旅遊團也有2人染疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Taipei City reports a local dengue fever outbreak! A woman in her 40s was diagnosed only after multiple medical visits, and two people in a Phu Quoc Island tour group were infected.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever outbreak in New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District, Taiwan: one local case in a woman in her 40s, onset in late October and confirmed in early November; infection source under investigation and household contacts asymptomatic. Two imported cases linked to a Phu Quoc Island tour group—both adults aged roughly 40s–60s—who contracted dengue abroad and returned with symptoms. Local authorities intensified vector control around the patient’s residence and frequented areas, conducted water-source cleanup, spraying, and ongoing monitoring of other tour members through December 6. Nationally, Taiwan reports 245 dengue cases in 2026, 18 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 13; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1) and 227 imported; top import origins: Vietnam (69), the Philippines (35), Indonesia (31). Globally, dengue surpasses 2.51 million cases as of September; Asia shows Bangladesh ~150k, Malaysia ~81k, with Vietnam ~167k and Cambodia ~120k. Public health advice includes eliminating standing water, wearing protective clothing, and using DEET/Picaridin/IR3535 repellents; seek prompt medical care for fever and report travel history (TOCC).

triage.headline_ja: 新北市で本土感染デング熱が発生！40代女性が複数回受診後に確診、フーコック島ツアー参加者2名も感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内での季節性デング熱の局地的発生であり、対象国リストに該当する国が主題となっていないため、トリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 台湾（New Taipei City、Xinzhuang District）での局地的デング熱発生。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の起源国として統計上言及されているのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めない。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱再爆本土病例！新北新莊40多歲女確診　越南旅遊團2人中招｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever sees more locally transmitted cases! Woman in her 40s in Xinzhuang, New Taipei City diagnosed; two people in a Vietnamese tour group infected.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever shows local transmission in New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District, with a woman in her 40s diagnosed in early November after October fever onset; she had no travel abroad during incubation, and the infection source is under investigation; household contacts are asymptomatic, and authorities have intensified environmental cleaning, vector control, and disinfection around residence and activity areas. Two individuals in a Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam tour group tested positive after returning in late October; ages range 40s–60s, and the group is being tracked through December 6. Nationally this year, Taiwan has 245 dengue cases, including 18 locally acquired and 227 imported infections, with overseas cases mainly from Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia. Public health guidance urges post-rain checks, elimination of standing water, wearing light-colored long sleeves and pants outdoors, and using DEET, picaridin, or IR3535 repellents; seek care for fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, or rash; NS1 rapid tests available; hotline 1922.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾でデング熱の国内感染が再発！新北市新荘区の40代女性が感染確定、ベトナム旅行団からも2人感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における散発的な国内感染例と輸入例の報告であり、現時点で深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、ベクター媒介感染症として継続的な監視が必要。対象国（ベトナム、フィリピン、インドネシア）は輸入感染源として言及されているのみで、発生国である台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 発生地域は台湾であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていない。ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入感染症例の渡航先として言及されているのみで、これらの国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: O constante risco da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Constant Risk of Dengue Fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-09, projections by Fiocruz, FGV and partners estimate about 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027 in Brazil, with a range of 560,000 to 1.6 million and a peak near 40,000 in April. After a record 2024 (>6 million cases and 6,000 deaths), 2026 has 368 dengue deaths to date. Increases are expected in Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, Acre and Minas Gerais. Aedes aegypti transmits dengue, Zika, and chikungunya; chikungunya is projected at over 90,000 probable cases, rising in the Northeast, South, São Paulo and Center-West. Vaccination efforts include Qdenga (two-dose) for 10–14-year-olds; a Butantan single-dose vaccine, approved late 2025, was suspended June 8, 2026 after 42 serious adverse events, causality unestablished. Wolbachia deployments reduced cases in Niterói and Campo Grande but are incomplete. Public participation—eliminating standing water and seeking care at first fever—remains essential, alongside vigilant surveillance and evidence-based vaccine decisions.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の絶え間ないリスク
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱・チクングニア熱の2027年予測及びワクチン安全性懸念に関する論説記事であり、突発的な異常事態ではなく季節性・地域流行パターンの延長と判断されるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は2027年のデング熱予測やブタンタン製ワクチンの安全性懸念（42件の重篤副反応による接種停止）に関する論説であり、速報的な異常発生ではなく、既知の季節性流行の分析・提言記事である。

article.articleHeadline: مباحثات صينية أمريكية في بكين لتعزيز التعاون في مكافحة الإنفلونزا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese-American talks in Beijing to boost cooperation in the fight against influenza.
article.articleSummary: Beijing hosted talks between the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and the Chinese CDC to bolster cooperation against influenza. The U.S. delegation, seven specialists, reviewed projects at the Chinese CDC in Changping and discussed implementation efficiency and shared technical issues, aiming to sustain coordinated responses to seasonal influenza viruses and strengthen health security. The engagement traces a four-decade partnership, beginning in the late 1970s and culminating in a Beijing office opened in 2003 to deepen ties with Chinese health institutions. Technical coordination on influenza surveillance began in 1978, with strategic agreements in 1989 offering technical and financial support, including sample and expertise exchange. In 2004, cooperation expanded to enhance China’s influenza surveillance network and later broadened to seasonal influenza, avian influenza, and other virulent strains. The collaboration aligns with WHO's GISRS network across 130+ countries, enabling data and sample sharing to update vaccines and preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ対策協力強化のため北京で中米協議

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu triggers imported poultry from Minnesota -- DA
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-09, the Philippines' Department of Agriculture imposed a temporary ban on poultry imports from Minnesota, USA after confirmed bird flu (H5N1 HPAI) outbreaks in Wright, Big Stone, Kandiyohi, Otter Tail, Becker, Ravalli, and Benton counties. The import ban covers domestic and wild birds and products (meat, day-old chicks, eggs, semen) and suspends processing/evaluation of SPSICs, revoking all approved SPSICs for Minnesota. In-transit shipments may proceed if slaughtered/processed by Aug 18. Veterinary quarantine will seize poultry exports bound for the Philippines at major ports, except for heat-treated products. The DA cites rapid HPAI spread necessitating broader restrictions; a 2016 agreement with the US allows statewide bans only if three or more counties are infected in a state. Separately, imports from Germany and Peru can resume after declaring HPAI-free; regionalization policies remain, with past restrictions on Germany (2020) and Peru (2022).

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザによりミネソタ産家禽の輸入が制限 -- フィリピン農務省
triage.triage_reason: 米国ミネソタ州の家禽における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)発生を受けフィリピンが輸入禁止措置を取った事例であり、ヒトへの感染拡大は報告されていないが、貿易制限や家禽業界への影響があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本イベントの感染症自体は米国ミネソタ州の家禽で発生しており、対象国リストに米国は含まれない。フィリピンは輸入規制措置を講じた国として言及されているため、貿易対応の文脈でverified_locationsに含めた。ヒトへの感染報告はなく、家禽（動物）における事例。

article.articleHeadline: 「富國島旅行團」爆登革熱！台中2人發病 南投、新北都有團員
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phu Quoc Island tour group dengue fever outbreak! Two cases in Taichung; tour members in Nantou and New Taipei as well.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-09, Taiwan's CDC reports 1 locally acquired dengue case in New Taipei City's Xinzhuang District: a 44-year-old woman with fever, fatigue, headache, and rash since Oct 26; laboratory-confirmed dengue; infection source under investigation; household contacts asymptomatic. Last week, 10 imported dengue cases, including 2 from a Taichung-based tour group that visited Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam; the group’s 11 other members reside in Nantou and New Taipei and require monitoring through Dec 6. Nationally this year total 245 confirmed dengue cases: 18 locally acquired (Kaohsiung 13; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1) and 227 imported (Vietnam 69; Philippines 35; Indonesia 31). With the northeast monsoon bringing rain, dengue risk remains high; residents should eliminate breeding sites, use repellents, wear long sleeves/pants, and seek care if fever with travel history occurs.

triage.headline_ja: 「富国島ツアー団」でデング熱爆発的発生！台中で2人発病、南投・新北にも団員あり
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのデング熱症例（輸入例・局地感染）が報告されているが、重症例や死亡の報告はなく、季節性の通常監視報告の範囲内であるため、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾（台北市・台中市・南投県など）での局地的・輸入性デング熱症例を報告しており、ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の渡航先として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生を示すものではないため、対象国リストには該当なしと判断した。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 遊富國島返台2人染登革熱　疾管署匡列13人監測、新北再增1本土
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people who visited Phu Quoc Island contracted dengue fever after returning to Taiwan; Taiwan CDC has identified 13 people for monitoring, and New Taipei City reports one more locally transmitted case.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports dengue fever cases: two imported cases from a Phu Quoc trip and a local case in New Taipei Xinzhuang. The imported patients—man and woman in their 40s–60s—developed fever, headache, nausea and muscle pain after returning from Phu Quoc in late October; diagnoses are confirmed. The domestic case is a 44-year-old woman with onset Oct 26 and no overseas travel during the incubation period; infection source is under investigation; three cohabitants are asymptomatic. Taiwan CDC has identified 13 people under monitoring (Taichung 10, Nantou 2, New Taipei 1) through Dec 6. Nationwide, 245 dengue cases this year: 18 local (Kaohsiung 13) and 227 imported (Vietnam 69, Philippines 35, Indonesia 31). Vector-control measures include fogging and removal of breeding sites within 50 meters of homes; northeast monsoon rainfall persists. Guidance: wear light clothing, apply DEET/Picaridin/IR3535 repellents, seek prompt care for fever or rash and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 遊富国島(フーコック島)から台湾に帰国した2人がデング熱に感染　疾病管制署が13人を経過観察、新北市でさらに1件の本土感染例
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における通常のデング熱サーベイランス報告であり、症例数も少なく（年間245例）、既存のベクター対策で管理されている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内のデング熱発生状況（輸入症例・本土症例）であり、ベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入感染症例の渡航先として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生イベントではないため対象外とした。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 富國島13人團8日遊2人確診登革熱　同團11人持續監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phu Quoc Island 13-person tour: two diagnosed with dengue fever on day 8; 11 others in the group remain under continuous monitoring.
article.articleSummary: As of November 9, 2026, Taiwan CDC reported 2 dengue fever cases imported from abroad and 1 locally acquired case. The imported cluster involves a Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam, 8‑day tour group of 13 Taichung residents; 11 other members reside in Taichung, Nantou, and New Taipei. The two cluster cases are a man and a woman aged 40s–60s, not cohabiting; three cohabitants are asymptomatic, with monitoring through December 6. The domestic case is a New Taipei City Xinzhuang District woman in her 40s with fever and fatigue; infection source under investigation. Nationally, 245 dengue cases this year include 18 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 13; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1) and 227 imported (mainly Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia). Public health measures emphasize vector control and advising travelers to dengue-endemic areas to use protection and seek care if fever develops, informing travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 富国島8日間ツアー参加者13人中2人がデング熱確診、同行者11人を継続監視
triage.triage_reason: 台湾CDCによる輸入例・国内伝播例の通常のデング熱サーベイランス報告であり、重症例や異常な拡大は認められず、既存の対策で管理可能な事案である。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾国内のデング熱サーベイランス（輸入例・国内伝播例）に関する定期報告。輸入クラスターの感染地はベトナム・富国島であり、フィリピン・インドネシアは国全体の輸入例集計で言及されているのみで具体的な発生事案ではないため除外。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 新北爆本土登革熱！40多歲女多次就醫才確診　富國島旅遊團也有2人染疫
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Taipei City reports a local dengue fever outbreak; a woman in her forties was diagnosed only after multiple doctor visits, and two people in a Phu Quoc Island tour group were infected.
article.articleSummary: New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District reports a locally acquired dengue fever case: a woman in her 40s fell ill in late October and was diagnosed in early November after multiple medical visits; the infection source is under investigation, and she did not travel abroad during incubation. Two imported cases tied to a Phu Quoc Island tour were diagnosed after returning to Taiwan (one man, one woman; ages 40s–60s); health authorities will monitor the rest of the tour group through December 6. Taiwan’s CDC reports 2026 totals of 245 dengue cases, including 18 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 13; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1) and 227 imported (Vietnam 69; Philippines 35; Indonesia 31). Globally, dengue exceeded 2.5 million by September; Asia’s outbreaks include Bangladesh and Malaysia. Preventive measures: remove standing water, wear light clothing, use approved repellents (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535), and seek prompt medical care with travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 新北市で国内感染デング熱発生！40代女性が複数回受診後に確診、富国島(フーコック島)旅行団からも2人感染

triage.notes: 台湾(New Taipei City)の国内感染デング熱が記事の主題。対象国リストに台湾は含まれないため台湾自体は記載せず、ベトナム(富国島)での感染源が明示されている輸入症例のみ対象国として記載。フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の統計数字としてのみ言及され、具体的な発生状況の記述がないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 富國島旅遊團爆登革熱群聚！2人返台確診 疾管署：赴東南亞須多注意
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phu Quoc Island tour group dengue fever cluster outbreak! Two returnees to Taiwan diagnosed. Taiwan CDC: Exercise more caution when traveling to Southeast Asia.
article.articleSummary: As of November 9, 2026, Taiwan reports a dengue cluster linked to Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam, with two returnees diagnosed after a late October 8-day tour. A 13-member group comprises Taichung (10), Nantou (2), and New Taipei (1). One domestic case in New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District, a woman in her 40s, had onset in late Oct and was confirmed in early Nov; no overseas travel history, infection source under investigation. Ten imported cases last week include the two tour members; authorities are conducting vector-control around residences and venues and monitoring 11 other members plus 3 cohabitants through Dec 6. National totals stand at 245 dengue cases this year, with 18 locally transmitted and 227 imported. Globally, dengue exceeded 2.5 million cases through Sep 2026, concentrated in the Americas. Travellers to Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia should use repellents and seek care if fever; NS1 testing may aid diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: フーコック島旅行ツアーでデング熱クラスター発生！台湾帰国者2名が確定診断、疾病管制署：東南アジア渡航時は注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 台湾におけるベトナム（フーコック島）関連の輸入デング熱クラスターで、国内感染例も1例発生しているが、全体として重篤性や急速な国際拡大の証拠は限定的であり、既存の媒介動物対策で管理可能とみられるため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Gita Karmakar: The nurse Jalpaiguri knew as Polio Didimoni
article.articleSummary: Gita Karmakar, known as Polio Didimoni, served Jalpaiguri’s Danguajhar tea garden area in north-west West Bengal from 1983 as an auxiliary nurse midwife, later field nurse. She covered 12–14 km daily, mostly by bicycle, running clinics, promoting hospital births (about 100 per year), weighing children, monitoring nutrition, and maintaining the vaccine cold chain while teaching about tuberculosis, thalassemia and reproductive health. She became a familiar figure during polio campaigns, earning the nickname Polio Didimoni. After a 2008 road accident left 40% disability, she hired a cycle-rickshaw to continue visiting patients, paying about 200 rupees daily. In January 2021 she was promoted to Health Supervisor at Belakoba Rural Hospital, guiding 33 ASHA workers across four health centres. She retired on 31 January 2026, had been nominated for the National Florence Nightingale Award, and on 12 May 2026 received the award from the President at Rashtrapati Bhavan, New Delhi, marking International Nurses Day.

triage.headline_ja: ギタ・カルマカール:ジャルパイグリが『ポリオ・ディディモニ』と呼んだ看護師
