triage.notes: 疾患名にTuberculosisとPoliomyelitisが付与されているが、これは記事中の看護師の活動歴に言及されているのみで、実際の感染症発生・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Trâu, bò chết hàng loạt chưa rõ nguyên nhân ở xã miền núi Nghệ An
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buffalo and Cattle Die in Large Numbers from Unknown Causes in a Mountainous Commune in Nghệ An Province.
article.articleSummary: Unknown-cause cattle losses continue in the mountainous Hữu Kiệm commune of Nghệ An Province, Vietnam. By noon on 9 November 2026, 48 head of cattle and buffalo belonging to 17 households had died, with over 10 additional deaths reported that day. Local veterinary authorities, with the commune’s agricultural association, have visited affected areas to implement control measures and advise farmers on prevention. The Nghệ An Department of Livestock and Veterinary Services has collected samples for laboratory testing to determine the cause, with results expected to guide response actions. Officials note this is the first known incident of unknown-cause cattle deaths in the province, and there are no confirmed reports of similar cases elsewhere. Surveillance and coordinated prevention efforts continue to mitigate losses and protect livestock livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: ゲアン省の山間部コミューンで原因不明の水牛・牛の大量死
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の家畜大量死事例であり、検査結果待ちの段階。人への感染報告はなく、病原体も特定されていないため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 現時点では家畜（牛・水牛）の死亡のみで、人への健康影響は報告されていない。原因究明のための検査結果待ちであり、感染症か否か不明なため、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, almeno 30 ippopotami uccisi dall'antrace: allarme nel Parco nazionale di Virunga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, at least 30 hippos killed by anthrax: alarm in Virunga National Park.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax outbreak in Virunga National Park, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has killed at least 30 hippopotamuses. The infections were first detected in September and confirmed by laboratory analyses, with cases concentrated around Ishango and along the Semliki River. Bacillus anthracis is the causative agent; the bacterium forms spores that can persist in the environment for years, complicating elimination. This event follows a prior outbreak within roughly a year that caused about 65 hippo deaths. Park authorities report no new cases in the past two weeks but continue active surveillance, safe carcass handling, and secure disposal to protect wildlife and human health. Drought is noted as a contributing factor, though recent rains are seen as improving the situation. The outbreak poses a zoonotic risk, and local communities are urged not to touch or consume infected carcasses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、炭疽により少なくともカバ30頭が死亡：ヴィルンガ国立公園で警戒
triage.triage_reason: ヴィルンガ国立公園でカバの炭疽アウトブレイクが再発し人獣共通感染のリスクが指摘されているが、現時点で人への感染例は報告されておらず、情報が限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（カバ）の大量死が主体で人への感染例は確認されていないが、炭疽菌の環境残存性とゾーノーシスリスクから地域住民への注意喚起がなされている。前回のアウトブレイク（約65頭死亡）から1年以内の再発であり、継続的なサーベイランスが必要。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ നിപ വീണ്ടും ആവർത്തിക്കും; മുന്നറിയിപ്പുമായി മുൻ ആരോഗ്യവകുപ്പ് സെക്രട്ടറി | Nipah will Repeat in Kerala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nipah will recur in Kerala; Former Health Department Secretary issues a warning.
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus is expected to recur in Kerala, says former Health Department Secretary Rajeev Sadanandan. He estimates up to 50% of flying-fox fruit bats (Pteropus spp.) could carry Nipah, and that dense population with increasing human–animal contact heightens spillover risk. Bats can transmit without dying, allowing ongoing spread; earlier studies found about 22% of bats infected, supporting annual Nipah cases beyond Kozhikode. Nipah is not confined to one district; in 2019 Idukki reported a case. Kerala’s transparent reporting has drawn attention, while some regions may underreport. In 2018, recognizing the outbreak’s spread took about 18 days; mortality could reach 70–100%. Malabar projections suggested up to 254 cases with preparations for 300 patients, hampered by PPE shortages. Two lessons: strengthen disease surveillance and hospital infection control; and ensure Nipah testing for youths with brain-related symptoms, as gaps led to about 13 related infections.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でニパウイルスが再発する可能性；元保健局長官が警告
triage.triage_reason: 元保健局長官による将来的なニパウイルス再発リスクについての警告記事であり、現在進行中の新規発生報告ではないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は過去（2018年・2019年）のニパウイルス流行データに基づく将来的な再発リスクに関する専門家の見解・警告であり、現在の具体的な新規症例報告ではない。コウモリの保有率（最大50%推定）や過去の致死率（70-100%）、医療体制の課題（PPE不足等）が言及されているが、現時点での確定症例数は不明。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : " Sans paix, nous ne pouvons pas arrêter Ebola " : L'OMS alerte sur les conséquences dramatiques de l'insécurité pour la riposte anti-Ebola [MBOTE] https://mbote.cd/a-la-une/rdc-sans-paix-nous-ne-pouvons-pas-arreter-ebola-loms-alerte-sur-les-consequences-dramatiques-de-linsecurite-pour-la-riposte-anti-ebola/208583/
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: "Without peace, we cannot stop Ebola": WHO warns of the dramatic consequences of insecurity for the Ebola response [MBOTE]
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo faces an Ebola outbreak where insecurity directly hampers the response. The World Health Organization warns that without lasting peace, the effort to stop Ebola faces dramatic consequences. The article highlights the critical link between security conditions and outbreak control in the DRC, noting that progress against Ebola depends on establishing stability to enable effective public health actions. Published 9 November 2026, the report emphasizes that conflict and insecurity undermine containment efforts and pose ongoing risks to affected communities. The message from WHO underscores the need for political and security solutions as prerequisites for a successful Ebola response in the region.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：「平和なくしてエボラは止められない」―WHOが治安悪化のエボラ対応への深刻な影響を警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準上重大な公衆衛生イベントであり、治安悪化による対応阻害は国際的拡大リスクと管理可能性の懸念を伴うためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOの警告に焦点を当てており、具体的な症例数や地域の詳細は記載されていないが、既知のDRCエボラ流行の継続とその対応への治安悪化の影響が主題。

article.articleHeadline: 永康越籍男 泰國旅遊染疫 | 中華日報|中華新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vietnamese man in Yongkang infected during trip to Thailand
article.articleSummary: Vietnamese man in Yongkang District, Tainan, has been confirmed as Taiwan’s 18th imported dengue fever case this year. The patient, in his twenties, traveled to Thailand on a corporate trip October 17–21, developed fever, myalgia and rash after returning, and waited five days before seeking medical care. A dengue NS1 rapid test was positive, and a subsequent antibody test confirmed infection. He remained in Hsinchu County after returning and did not enter the Tainan community. Nationally, as of November 9, Taiwan reports 245 dengue cases: 227 imported and 18 locally; imported cases are dominant, with Vietnam the leading source, followed by the Philippines and Indonesia. Health authorities warn that viremic travelers can seed local transmission and that NS1 negativity does not rule out infection. Emphasize travel history inquiries and elimination of standing water to reduce spread.

triage.headline_ja: 永康在住のベトナム人男性、タイ旅行中にデング熱感染
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱症例の一つであり、地域社会への伝播は確認されていない。既存の年次サーベイランス報告の範囲内で、異常性や緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bogotá, ¿paraíso roedor? Las señales de una plaga que estaría ganando terreno en la capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bogotá, rodent paradise? Signs of a pest infestation that could be gaining ground in the capital.
article.articleSummary: November 9, 2026: Bogotá faces a rodent infestation as rats and mice proliferate across the city, inhabiting waste zones and subterranean spaces, prompting health and economic concerns. Citizens and officials report increased sightings, with impacts in local commerce in areas such as the Roma neighborhood in Kennedy and other sectors. Leptospirosis is highlighted as a potential rodent-borne disease transmitted via contaminated environments; the District Health Secretariat notes rodent-related illnesses commonly present as febrile syndromes that mimic other diseases, urging medical consultation if fever follows exposure to rodents or their excreta. Urban transformation, inadequate waste management, aging infrastructure, and leaky sewers may push rodents toward settlements. Critical districts include Chapinero, Usaquén, Suba, Bosa, Engativá, and Kennedy. The issue is framed as shared responsibility under Directive 004 of 2024 among district agencies; mitigation requires waste control, infrastructure maintenance, and preventive health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ボゴタは「ネズミの楽園」？ 首都で勢力を拡大しているとみられる害獣発生の兆候
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコロンビア・ボゴタにおけるネズミの大量発生と衛生上の懸念を扱ったものであり、具体的なレプトスピラ症の症例報告ではない。また発生国コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はボゴタ（コロンビア）におけるネズミ害とそれに伴うレプトスピラ症リスクについての一般的な公衆衛生注意喚起記事であり、具体的な感染症症例数や流行の報告はない。フィリピンや米国の地名はBluedotのロケーションタグに含まれるが、記事内容とは無関係と判断し除外。コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Région Sud/Rumonge : La menace de la maladie à virus Ebola est bien réelle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Region/Rumonge: The threat of Ebola virus disease is very real.
article.articleSummary: Rumonge, Burundi faces a real threat of Ebola virus disease as clandestine entries along Lake Tanganyika risk cross-border introduction from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Six entry points were identified in Kigwena, Gatete, Rumonge, Kizuka and Minago, where nocturnal crossings by small pirogues bypass medical controls. During an Oct 28, 2026 workshop led by Edouard Ndayikengurukiye of the Public Health Emergency Operations Center, participants were briefed on transmission, Ebola symptoms, and the disease’s global and African footprint, plus Burundi’s prevention efforts. Three suspected cases in Rumonge underwent laboratory testing, all negative. Health workers asked for personal protective equipment, a request approved with the reminder that community health workers should not touch Ebola patients. A multisector mobilization—administrative authorities, health workers, religious groups, and media—was urged to ensure medical screening for all entrants and to improve information dissemination; some residents report a lack of Ebola information.

triage.headline_ja: 南部地域/ルモンゲ：エボラウイルス病の脅威は現実のものである
triage.triage_reason: ブルンジ・ルモンゲ地域でコンゴ民主共和国からの越境感染リスクが高く、疑い例の検査や防護具要請など対策が進行中であり、WPRO基準の複数該当と行政・医療機関の関心の高まりが確認されるため。
triage.notes: ブルンジ（対象国リスト外）での疑い例は全て陰性。記事の主題はDRCからの越境リスクであり、DRCでのエボラ発生を前提とした内容のためDRCを含めた。ブルンジ自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում մայիսից ի վեր ավելի քան 5 հազար մարդ է մահացել էբոլայից
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 5,000 people have died from Ebola since May.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has resulted in 5,323 deaths among 10,920 confirmed cases, a case fatality rate of 48.7%. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 69.7% of all confirmed cases. The outbreak began in May in the DRC and in Uganda. Uganda declared the outbreak over on July 28, with the World Health Organization confirming this status on August 25. Data come from the Public Health National Institute under the DRC Ministry of Health. All figures cited are confirmed cases reported to date; no details on transmission sources or laboratory confirmation beyond case counts are provided in the report. Updates reflect the current situation as of 2026-11-09.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで5月以降、エボラにより5,000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.7%の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、DRCで10,920例・5,323死亡という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、IHR基準にも複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダは既に流行終息が宣言されており(2026-07-28、WHO確認8-25)、現在の主要発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Super El Niño coloca MS entre estados com alta para dengue e chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Super El Niño puts Mato Grosso do Sul among states with high risk for dengue and chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Super El Niño could raise dengue and chikungunya risk in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with MS forecast to have high transmission in 2027. In 2026, MS recorded 2,325 confirmed dengue cases and 3,872 probable, plus one confirmed dengue death and another under investigation; Bonito reported an 11-year-old boy’s death. Corumbá leads with 788 confirmed dengue; other municipalities include Costa Rica (197), Dourados (160), Santa Rita do Pardo (141). Chikungunya shows MS with the country’s highest incidence, with 31 deaths in early 2026; October saw 902 probable cases, up 136% from September. Year-to-date chikungunya: 12,890 probable cases; incidence 440.7/100k; a death under investigation in Naviraí. For 2027, projections anticipate >90,000 national chikungunya cases and ~860,000 probable dengue cases (range 560k–1.6M), with a dengue peak around 40,000 in April. Projections come from the IMDC/Mosqlimate InfoDengue ensemble of 22 models. In April 2026, MS received 20,000 doses of a chikungunya vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーエルニーニョによりマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州はデング熱・チクングニア熱の高リスク州に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・マト・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱が国内最高の罹患率を記録し死亡例も多数発生、2027年にはさらなる大流行が予測されており、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心（ワクチン配布等の政府対応）が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事中の『Costa Rica』はコスタリカ国ではなくマト・グロッソ・ド・スル州内の自治体名であるため対象国として扱っていない。デング・チクングニアはブラジルの風土病であり季節性流行の予測記事だが、記録的な症例数・死亡者数・2027年の大規模流行予測から注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 富國島旅行團爆登革熱群聚！2人發病、11人監測至12／6
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cluster erupts in Phu Quoc Island tour group! 2 cases, 11 people monitored through December 6.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever cases linked to an imported cluster from a late-October Phu Quoc Island tour in Vietnam were confirmed in Taiwan on 2026-11-09. The two patients, tour group members, developed illness after returning and were lab-confirmed; the group includes 11 other members living in Taichung, Nantou, and New Taipei, with three cohabitants under health surveillance through 2026-12-06. Separately, a locally acquired dengue case was reported in New Taipei City, Xinzhuang District—a woman in her 40s—who developed fever and fatigue in late October and was confirmed in early November; the infection source remains under investigation, with all cohabitants asymptomatic. Public health teams intensified vector control near affected homes and continue monitoring the group and contacts through 2026-12-06. Authorities warn that northeast monsoon rains sustain a high dengue risk and urge removal of standing water and continued anti-mosquito measures.

triage.headline_ja: 富国島旅行団でデング熱クラスター発生！2人発症、11人を12月6日まで経過観察
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・フークオック島への旅行者由来の輸入デング熱クラスターに加え、台湾新北市で地域内感染例も確認されており、媒介蚊対策の継続と地域社会での感染拡大監視が必要なためピックアップと判断。
triage.notes: 台湾（発生地域に含まれるが対象国リスト外）での輸入例および地域内感染例であり、感染源はベトナム・フークオック島への旅行とされるため、同国を発生国として記録。症例数は少なく重症例の報告はないが、季節的な媒介蚊対策継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Exportações brasileiras de frango crescem em outubro, mesmo com Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazilian chicken exports grow in October, despite Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian chicken exports reached 512,800 tonnes in October 2026, with US$994.1 million in revenue—the highest monthly volume this year, up 2.3% from October 2025 and 14.9% in value. January–October totals rose to 4.9 million tonnes and US$9.7 billion, up 12.7% and 20.4%, respectively. UAE was October’s top destination at 53,200 tonnes (+29.8%), followed by Saudi Arabia (47,900, +30.6%), China (46,800), Japan (38,700, +30.4%), and South Africa (30,100, -44.1%). For January–October, China remained the leading market with 467,700 tonnes, up 104.3% year over year. Paraná led October shipments (205,700), followed by Santa Catarina (113,400), Rio Grande do Sul (66,100), São Paulo (31,000), and Goiás (24,400). ABPA president Ricardo Santin crediting sanitary regionalization agreements for containing restrictions to protocol areas and maintaining export flows amid Newcastle disease concerns.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの鶏肉輸出、ニューカッスル病の懸念下でも10月に増加
triage.triage_reason: 記事は鶏肉輸出統計を主題とした経済記事であり、ニューカッスル病の発生状況や公衆衛生上の影響についての具体的情報はない。衛生区域化協定により輸出への影響が限定的とされている。
triage.notes: 記事はニューカッスル病そのものの発生詳細（感染規模・地域・対応措置等）を報じておらず、農産物輸出の経済統計記事。動物衛生当局による情報を要継続監視だが、現時点でシグナルとしての重要度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 美韓爆高致病性禽流感　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US and South Korea report outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza; Hong Kong temporarily suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, the United States and South Korea reported regional outbreaks of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI): H5N9 in Yeoncheon County, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea, and H5N1 in several U.S. counties (Dickey in North Dakota; Roseau in Minnesota; Cedar in Nebraska; Greeley in Kansas; Hanson in South Dakota; Clinton in Illinois). Hong Kong’s Food and Environmental Hygiene Department immediately suspended imports of poultry meat and poultry products, including eggs, from these areas. The Centre has contacted Korean and U.S. authorities and will monitor updates from the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE), adjusting measures as the outbreaks evolve. HK import data show shipments from Korea and the U.S.: in the first nine months of 2026, about 80 tonnes chilled poultry meat and 11.48 million eggs from Korea; about 33,270 tonnes frozen/chilled poultry meat and 92.33 million eggs from the United States.

triage.headline_ja: 米国と韓国で高病原性鳥インフルエンザが発生、香港が家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 発生地は米国・韓国の家禽であり、対象国（中国含む）では発生していない。香港は輸入停止措置を取ったのみで、ヒトへの感染報告もないため監視対象外とする。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽（動物）における高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（H5N9・H5N1）の発生であり、ヒト感染事例の報告はない。発生国は米国・韓国で、対象国リストに含まれない。香港（中国）は輸入停止措置の実施主体であり、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Comparison of stool examination, urine rapid diagnostic test (RDT), and stool PCR for diagnosing Opisthorchis viverrini infection
article.articleSummary: In a northern Thai correctional facility where Opisthorchis viverrini and Haplorchis taichui are co-endemic and residents had avoided raw fish for at least one month, 239 men were evaluated using single stool specimens (Kato-Katz and PBS-ethyl acetate concentration) with ITS2-PCR as the reference standard. PCR detected O. viverrini in 6.7% (16/239). Urine rapid diagnostic testing (OV-RDT) was positive in 77.0% (124/161) of participants with valid urine. Against PCR, OV-RDT sensitivity was 75.0% (95% CI 42.8–94.5) and specificity 22.8% (95% CI 16.3–30.4); likelihood ratios near one, and band intensity did not distinguish PCR status. Specificity remained low under composite references and among those with no helminths detected (21.3%). Taenia spp. were found in 12.1% but were not associated with OV-RDT positivity. Conclusion: OV-RDT positivity poorly reflects molecular infection in this low-prevalence, co-endemic setting, underscoring the need for confirmatory testing before using OV-RDT results for prevalence estimates or treatment decisions.

triage.headline_ja: タイ肝吸虫(Opisthorchis viverrini)感染診断における便検査、尿迅速診断検査(RDT)、便PCRの比較
triage.triage_reason: 診断法の性能評価に関する研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 疾患名はCoccidioidomycosisと記載されているが、記事内容はタイ北部の矯正施設におけるタイ肝吸虫(Opisthorchis viverrini)の診断検査法比較研究であり、疾患分類にずれがある。アウトブレイク情報ではなく学術研究論文のため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: 泰國M痘主流病毒株轉為Ib型　當局示警症狀多元未必有皮疹
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's mpox dominant strain has shifted to type Ib; authorities warn that symptoms are diverse and may not include a rash.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Thailand's mpox (monkeypox) epidemiology has shifted: Clade Ib is now the dominant circulating lineage, replacing the prior global predominance of Clade IIb since 2022. Thailand's Disease Control Department warns that mpox presents with diverse symptoms and may not include a skin rash. Clinicians should elicit thorough history; some patients show buttock abscesses, sore throat, mucosal inflammation, or severe anal pain, which can mimic respiratory infections or tonsillitis. Laboratory confirmation indicates Clade Ib is prevalent; mortality for Clade Ib is under 0.5%, but immunocompromised individuals or those with comorbidities can develop serious complications without proper treatment. Transmission is by direct/close contact with lesions, blisters, or mucosal lesions, and may include sexual transmission. Cases are scattered across Thailand's cities, tourist areas, and high-density locales, with no community transmission yet; most patients are men aged 18–49; risk factors include sexual contact, attendance at gatherings, and shared housing.

triage.headline_ja: タイのM痘（サル痘）主流株がIb型に移行、当局は症状が多様で必ずしも発疹を伴わないと警告
triage.triage_reason: タイでMpox Clade Ib（PHEIC関連の重症クレード）が主流株となったことは異常かつ国際的拡大懸念があり、IHR基準で複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Clade Ibは従来主にアフリカ（DRC等）で流行していた系統であり、タイでの主流化は国際的拡大のシグナルとして注視が必要。性的接触を含む人-人感染の可能性が指摘されており、流行しやすさの基準にも該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Konqoda vəba epidemiyası: Yoluxanların sayı 60 mini ötdü
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo plague epidemic: the number of infections has surpassed 60,000.
article.articleSummary: Plague epidemic in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 60,000 infections since the start of the year. The outbreak, reported by RFI and cited by Oxu.Az, is primarily affecting Upper Lomami, North Kivu, Tanganyika, and South Kivu provinces, with authorities warning of possible spread toward the Congo River. In response, the DRC and neighboring Republic of the Congo are initiating border vaccination campaigns, aiming to vaccinate up to 2 million people in the coming weeks, including vaccination in western and northern DRC and in southern Republic of the Congo, as well as in Kinshasa. The epidemic coincides with an Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC, complicating control efforts. The article notes plague as a dangerous infection transmitted via contaminated food or water.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国のペスト流行：感染者数が6万人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で感染者6万人超のペスト流行が継続し、エボラ出血熱の同時流行と国境を越えたワクチン接種対応が必要とされているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部のペスト流行とエボラ出血熱同時流行について述べている。隣国コンゴ共和国（Republic of Congo）も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Manila logs over 4,000 dengue cases from Jan. 1 to Nov. 9 | Inquirer News Manila 4,000 dengue cases
article.articleSummary: Manila reports 35 new dengue cases on Monday, Nov 9, bringing the total dengue count to 4,769 from Jan. 1 to Nov. 9, according to the Manila Health Department (MHD). Dengue remains the top-cumulative W.I.L.D. disease in EDCS-IS as of 7 a.m. on Nov. 9. On the same day, 29 new influenza-like illness (ILI) and 9 severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) cases were logged. From Jan. 1 to Nov. 9, Manila’s totals include ILI 3,009; leptospirosis 1,664; SARI 631; COVID-19 115; typhoid fever 91; and cholera 4. No new cases of cholera, typhoid fever, confirmed COVID-19 or leptospirosis were reported on Monday. MHD’s W.I.L.D. surveillance covers waterborne diseases, influenza, leptospirosis and dengue, and also tracks ILI, SARI and confirmed COVID-19. Residents are urged to prevent water accumulation, keep surroundings clean, drink clean water, and seek medical attention if symptoms appear during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: マニラ、1月1日から11月9日までにデング熱症例4,000件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: デング熱を含む複数疾患の定例サーベイランス報告であり、季節性の範囲内と見られるが、継続的な症例数の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 雨季における複数の媒介・水系感染症の定例統計報告。重症度や異常増加の明確な記載はなく、マニラ保健局による通常のサーベイランス発表と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch cúm và sốt xuất huyết ở Hải Phòng tuần qua: Tiếp tục tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza outbreak and dengue fever in Hai Phong last week: continuing to rise.
article.articleSummary: Influenza and dengue fever continue to rise in Hai Phong. For the week of 27 Oct–2 Nov 2026, Hai Phong reported 930 influenza cases, up 131 from the prior week, with no deaths; year-to-date total 4,655 cases, up 892 vs 2025, and a four-week average near 600. The five districts with the highest influenza totals are Le Chan (320), An Bien (243), Mao Dien (142), An Hai (137), and Hong Bang (131). Dengue fever: week 44 recorded 61 cases, up 3 from week 43; year-to-date 670 infections, 604 confirmed, down 93 from 2025, with no deaths. Four-week dengue average is 60.25 and incidence 14 per 100,000. Thirteen new outbreaks were reported this week, bringing total outbreaks to 126, with 17 active. At Viet Tiep Hospital, influenza A admissions rose sharply in late October, including cases with comorbidities and some requiring ventilation; vaccination and preventive measures urged.

triage.headline_ja: ハイフォンのインフルエンザ・デング熱流行、先週も増加続く
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザとデング熱の症例増加が報告されているが、死亡者なく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示唆されていないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: インフルエンザA型の重症例（人工呼吸管理を要する基礎疾患合併例）が一部報告されており、医療逼迫の兆候に注意。死亡例はなし。続報での重症度・地理的拡大の有無を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : en RDC, dans l'épicentre de l'épidémie, le lancement des premiers essais de traitements fait renaître l'espoir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In the DRC, in the epicenter of the outbreak, the launch of the first treatment trials rekindles hope.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-09, Ebola is spreading in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia identified as the epicenter. The launch of the first treatment trials tests the effectiveness of several vaccines and medicines. Clinical studies aim to protect local populations from transmission and improve outcomes amid the outbreak. Researchers are evaluating multiple therapeutic options to inform the public health response and help curb the spread. Specific case counts or fatalities are not provided in the excerpt, but the trials represent an early effort to deploy vaccines and treatments in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国、流行の震源地で初の治療試験開始が希望をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の重大な公衆衛生イベントに該当し、DRC東部での継続的な流行と国際的な治療試験実施は国際的関心・拡大リスクを伴うためフルRRAに進めるべき。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事中に記載なし。治療試験開始は流行が継続中であることを示唆し、既知のエボラ流行国での新展開のため既存のリスク評価の更新が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Grippe ou nouveau Covid-19 ? L'OMS alerte sur le variant PJ.2.1 détecté dans 19 pays - La Presse de Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza or new COVID-19? WHO warns about the PJ.2.1 variant detected in 19 countries - La Presse de Tunisie.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, the World Health Organization warns that distinguishing infection with the SARS-CoV-2 PJ.2.1 variant from a cold or seasonal flu based on symptoms alone is unreliable. PJ.2.1, first detected in June 2026, has been confirmed in at least 19 countries, including the United States, China, France, Sweden, Spain, and Singapore, signaling ongoing international surveillance. Because respiratory illnesses present with nearly identical clinical pictures, biological testing is often essential to confirm the pathogen and to inform treatment and public health measures. The WHO reiterates the need for laboratory confirmation when the infection’s identity affects clinical management or public health protocols, highlighting the diagnostic challenge posed by overlapping symptoms among COVID-19, influenza, and other respiratory illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザか新型コロナか？WHOが19カ国で検出された変異株PJ.2.1について警告 - ラ・プレス・ド・チュニジー
triage.triage_reason: WHOが新型変異株PJ.2.1の国際的な拡大（19カ国で確認）を警告しており、WPRO基準（持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当し、社会的関心（報道）も高いため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによるPJ.2.1変異株の国際監視に関するもので、重症度や臨床的影響の詳細情報は不明。対象国リストのうち中国のみがサマリー中で言及されているため、verified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Método que reduziu dengue em Campo Grande enfrenta entraves para expansão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Method that reduced dengue in Campo Grande faces obstacles to expansion.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Campo Grande, Brazil, dropped 63.2% in 2024 in areas with stable Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti, per a Fiocruz study published December 2025. The Wolbachia method began in December 2020, expanded across Campo Grande by 2023 with over 100 million mosquitoes released, and now operates in 16 Brazilian municipalities, reaching about 16 million people. Federal investments total about R$117 million. Expansion faces financial and regulatory hurdles, though the government plans to extend the strategy to 54 additional municipalities from 2027, potentially benefiting 7.2 million more residents. Two biofactories can produce up to 340 million Wolbachia-infected mosquito eggs weekly. Self-sustaining after roughly two years at about 60% coverage, requiring early releases to affect upcoming dengue seasons. Projections warn dengue could rise 98.4% in the Central-West between Sept 2026 and Jan 2027, with Mato Grosso do Sul among six states with rising notifications. The method complements, not replaces, traditional vector control.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデでデング熱を減らした手法、拡大に障壁
triage.triage_reason: デング熱対策（ウォルバキア法）の成果と拡大課題に関する報道であり、新規の異常な公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 将来的なデング熱の季節的増加予測（2026-2027年、中西部地域で98.4%増の可能性）に言及があるが、現時点では対策手法とその課題に関する内容であり、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Super El Niño acende alerta para dengue e chikungunya em MS - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Super El Niño raises alert for dengue and chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: In Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, 2026 saw 31 chikungunya deaths and one dengue death, with 12,890 probable chikungunya cases—the highest national tally. October chikungunya records rose 136% compared with September. About 130 researchers from eight countries contributed to projections predicting increases in dengue and chikungunya for 2027 in Mato Grosso do Sul, signaling heightened risk for the state. A potential super El Niño could foster proliferation of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, the vector for both diseases, though the exact effects remain uncertain. The findings emphasize that public health authorities must address the 2026 toll while monitoring evolving forecasts for 2027, as MS is specifically singled out as likely to experience worsening transmission of both dengue and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーエルニーニョがマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でのデング熱・チクングニア熱への警戒を高める
triage.triage_reason: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱による31人の死亡と1万2千例超の症例が報告され、10月は前月比136%増加。エルニーニョによる蚊媒介感染症のさらなる悪化が予測されており、WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルの風土病で季節性流行だが、死亡者数の多さと増加率の高さ、及び今後の悪化予測から注視が必要。渡航制限や国際的拡大への言及は記事内になし。

article.articleHeadline: Фейк: туристы массово заражаются неизвестным вирусом во Вьетнаме
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fake: Tourists Massively Infected by an Unknown Virus in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: False claim of mass infection among Russian tourists in Nha Trang, Vietnam, due to an unknown virus. No confirmed outbreak; reports cited fever and cough but tour operators and insurers denied increased patient flow. Rospotrebnadzor sent a data request to Vietnam's Ministry of Health, but that does not confirm any outbreak or novel pathogen. Media sources (TASS citing RTS, EuroIns) stated no mass complaints or diagnostic failures. Seasonal influenza remains at normal seasonal levels. Medical diagnoses reported include tonsillitis, bronchitis, laryngotracheobronchitis, pneumonia; no cases of unknown virus. Alleged infection source—dirty hotel air conditioners—was speculation by tourists and not substantiated. No information of imported/exported cases. Overall, the article debunks the rumor of mass infection; no evidence of unknown virus or diagnostic challenges observed.

triage.headline_ja: フェイク：ベトナムでロシア人観光客が未知のウイルスに大量感染しているという情報
triage.triage_reason: 記事自体が「未知のウイルス大量感染」という噂を否定するデバンク記事であり、季節性インフルエンザも通常レベルで異常な公衆衛生事象は確認されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は観光客間の『未知のウイルス大量感染』という噂を否定する内容。確認された症例は季節性疾患（扁桃炎、気管支炎等）であり、アウトブレイクの証拠なし。Russiaは対象国リストに含まれず、Vietnamも噂の発生場所であって実際の感染確認国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada DBD dan Leptospirosis Saat Peralihan Musim di Jateng, Ini Wilayah yang Rawan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beware of Dengue Fever and Leptospirosis During the Seasonal Transition in Central Java: These Are the High-Risk Areas.
article.articleSummary: As of November 9, 2026, Central Java's health authorities warn of rising dengue fever (DBD) and leptospirosis as the dry-to-wet season transitions. Dinkes Jateng Head Zulfachmi Wahab urged heightened readiness for an outbreak surge. Dengue uniformly spreads across 35 districts and cities, with the highest risk in urban areas where dense housing accelerates Aedes aegypti breeding. Leptospirosis cases cluster in coastal Pantura districts such as Demak and Pekalongan, linked to puddled floodwater and urine-contaminated environments. 2025 saw 6,226 dengue cases and 54 deaths; 2024 had 17,636 cases and 217 deaths. The five districts with the most dengue were Semarang, Tegal, Pati, Jepara, and Demak. The Ministry of Health records 45,171 suspected dengue cases in Central Java from January–October 2026, ranking third nationally after West Java and East Java.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目、中部ジャワでデング熱とレプトスピラ症に注意 - 危険地域はこちら
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・レプトスピラ症は中部ジャワの季節性既知疾患であり、毎年の定期的な公衆衛生注意喚起の範囲内。死亡例の継続はあるが新規性・異常性に乏しく、フルRRAへの即時移行基準には満たない。
triage.notes: 季節の変わり目（乾季→雨季）に毎年恒例で出される地方保健局の注意喚起記事。デング熱は45,171件の疑い例（2026年1-10月、全国3位）、レプトスピラ症は沿岸部のPantura地域（Demak, Pekalonganなど）に集中。2024年は217人の死者を記録しているが、これは既知の風土病の季節的増加パターンであり、突発的な異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Plus de 60.000 cas de choléra enregistrés en RDC fin octobre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 60,000 cholera cases recorded in the DRC by the end of October.
article.articleSummary: More than 60,000 cholera cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) by the end of October, with about 1,800 deaths since the start of 2026, according to WHO data reported in early November. In response to the spread, the DRC and the Republic of the Congo launched a cross-border vaccination campaign on 3 November, aiming to immunize up to 2 million people in the coming weeks. Priority areas include the western and northern DRC and the southern Republic of the Congo, with Kinshasa also targeted as surveillance is strengthened. The intervention occurs amid a challenging health context, as the DRC is concurrently facing an Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で10月末までにコレラ症例60,000件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: 死者約1,800人・症例6万件以上という大規模流行であり、国境を越えたワクチン接種対応やエボラ流行との同時発生など公衆衛生上深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴うためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)とコンゴ共和国(Republic of Congo)の国境を越えたコレラ対応を報じているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみ含まれるため、Republic of Congoは対象外。またDRCでは同時にエボラ流行も発生しており、複合的な公衆衛生危機として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de ébola ultrapassa os 10.000 casos. Taxa de mortalidade perto dos 50%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic surpasses 10,000 cases. Mortality rate near 50%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to claim lives, driven by Bundibugyo virus. As of the latest weekly tally, 10,699 cases and 5,202 deaths have been confirmed, yielding a mortality rate near 50%. Most infections remain concentrated in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with transmission ongoing. Cases continue to rise each week, underscoring ongoing transmission. The surge is described as the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record and is approaching the deadliest episode of the disease, the West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016. Two new vaccines are being studied to protect against Bundibugyo virus, signaling progress toward preventive options for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が1万人の症例を超える。致死率は50%近くに
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、症例数1万件超という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、史上2番目の大規模流行とされ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRCでの流行のみが言及されており、Angolaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン開発の進展も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Rondonópolis conquista prêmio inédito com campanha de combate à dengue - Prefeitura Municipal de Rondonópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rondonópolis City Hall wins unprecedented prize with a dengue-control campaign - Rondonópolis Municipal City Hall
article.articleSummary: On November 6, 2026, the City Hall of Rondonópolis, Mato Grosso, Brazil, won an unprecedented Cria do Mato prize in the Government Bodies category for a dengue-control campaign. The 2nd edition of the awards, held in Campo Grande, MS, attracted 262 submissions from 82 advertisers across Mato Grosso and Mato Grosso do Sul. The winning campaign was developed by Soul Propaganda in partnership with Rocky Filmes and Rondonópolis’ Gabinete de Comunicação Social. The municipality surpassed large state governments and major city halls. Representing the city, Clayton Rezende highlighted the win as evidence of strong interior advertising with a modern, aggressive, and creative approach that maintains responsibility. Mayor Cláudio Ferreira praised the campaign’s role in integrated actions, noting expressive reductions in dengue cases in 2026, as reported by the press.

triage.headline_ja: ロンドノーポリス市役所、デング対策キャンペーンで史上初の受賞 - ロンドノーポリス市役所
triage.triage_reason: 記事はデング熱の発生状況を報じるものではなく、デング対策キャンペーンの広告賞受賞に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング症例の増加や流行を報じるものではなく、自治体の広告キャンペーン受賞についての報道であり、むしろ2026年のデング症例減少が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: 泰国M痘主流病毒株 转为Ib型 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand's Mpox predominant viral strain shifts to Type Ib | China Press
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports mpox (Monkeypox) Clade Ib as the predominant circulating strain. The Department of Disease Control (DDC) said recent lab tests show Clade Ib now dominates in Thailand. Mpox can present with diverse symptoms, and some patients may experience tonsillitis-like symptoms or, in some cases, no skin rash at all. Authorities warn clinicians to stay vigilant. The Standard cited Public Health Ministry officials noting patients with non-classic manifestations, including buttock abscesses, sore throat, mucosal inflammation, and severe anal pain, which can be misdiagnosed as respiratory infection or tonsillitis. WHO data and epidemiological surveillance indicate mpox symptoms vary by lesion site, with rashes, vesicles, or ulcers appearing on skin and mucous membranes in areas such as genital, anal, oral, and facial regions.

triage.headline_ja: タイのM痘（エムポックス）主流株がIb型に転換
triage.triage_reason: タイでMpox Clade Ib（より重症度・伝播性が懸念される株）が主流株に転換したとの公式発表であり、非定型症状による誤診リスクも指摘されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準共に複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Clade IbはWHOが2024年にPHEICを宣言した株であり、性的接触を含むヒト-ヒト感染が指摘されている。非定型症状（臀部膿瘍、咽頭痛、肛門痛等）による誤診リスクが公衆衛生上の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում մայիսից ի վեր ավելի քան 5 հազար մարդ է մահացել էբոլայից
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 5,000 people have died of Ebola since May.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 5,300 deaths and 10,920 confirmed cases, with a case-fatality rate of 48.7%, per the National Institute of Public Health under the DRC Health Ministry. The epicenter remains Ituri Province, which accounts for 69.7% of cumulative cases. The outbreak began in May in the DRC and also in Uganda. Uganda declared its outbreak over on July 28, and the World Health Organization confirmed this on August 25. These figures reflect confirmed cases reported by national authorities; the article does not provide further details on transmission sources, symptoms, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ(DRC)で5月以降エボラにより5000人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5,300人以上の死亡者・致死率48.7%という大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: ウガンダの流行は2026年7月28日に終息宣言済み（WHOが8月25日に確認）であり、記事の主題は依然継続中のDRCでの大規模流行であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Sapos e lagartos usam o calor como arma contra infecções - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Toads and lizards use heat as a weapon against infections - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers from the University of São Paulo (USP) and the Universidade Estadual Paulista (Unesp) report that toads and lizards employ behavioral fever to fight bacterial infections. In environments with greater thermal variation, these amphibians and reptiles increase body temperature more when exposed to pathogens, with amphibians showing stronger fever responses than reptiles. The study observed higher temperature rises in animals facing bacterial challenges, indicating heat as a natural defense mechanism. However, the strategy has limits: dehydration risk for amphibians and reptiles already living near its thermal tolerance boundary. Findings published in Proceedings of the Royal Society B highlight that heat-based defenses depend on environmental conditions. This work underscores the role of behavioral thermoregulation in wildlife immunity and cautions about potential trade-offs with hydration and thermal stress in varying climates.

triage.headline_ja: ヒキガエルとトカゲは感染症に対する武器として熱を利用する - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: 両生類・爬虫類の行動性発熱に関する学術研究であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベントではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物の体温調節に関する基礎研究であり、ヒトまたは動物の疾病発生事例の報告ではない。公衆衛生上の感染症シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Reportan nueve casos más de dengue en Oaxaca - El Imparcial de Oaxaca
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nine more dengue cases reported in Oaxaca
article.articleSummary: Nine more dengue cases were reported in Oaxaca, Mexico, during epidemiological week 43, bringing the state’s total to 80 cases and two deaths. This level remains far below 2025’s 219 cases and three deaths in the same period; after high transmission in 2024, Oaxaca saw a marked decline starting in 2025 that continues into 2026. To further reduce dengue, Oaxaca’s Health Services (SSO) announced a worldwide biocontrol strategy using Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes. The initiative, a collaboration with Universidad Autónoma de Yucatán and supported by the National Center for Prevention and Control of Diseases (CENAPRECE), will release Wolbachia egg capsules to block virus transmission, potentially cutting dengue transmission by up to 80%. Endorsed by WHO and PAHO, it is part of the National Dengue Prevention Plan and is already deployed in Yucatán, Campeche, Baja California Sur, as well as Australia, Brazil, and Indonesia. Preventive measures—repellent, screens, cleaning, and removing standing water—remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: オアハカで新たにデング熱9例を報告
triage.triage_reason: メキシコ・オアハカ州のデング熱症例は前年を大きく下回る水準で減少傾向にあり、対象国でもないため見送り。
triage.notes: ブラジル・インドネシア・オーストラリアはWolbachia蚊による媒介制御戦略の既存導入例として言及されているのみで、記事の主題であるデング熱発生はメキシコ・オアハカ州のものであり対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Banyak Rumah Indekos, Penyebaran HIV di Kota Bandung Tinggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many Boarding Houses, HIV Transmission in Bandung City Is High.
article.articleSummary: Bandung City faces high HIV transmission risk, linked to numerous boarding houses where students reside. Mayor Muhammad Farhan acknowledged elevated risk, noting 62% of Bandung’s students come from outside the city and live in indekos. Authorities estimate 90,000–100,000 boarding accommodations in Bandung, complicating oversight. As of 9 November 2026, confirmed HIV/AIDS cases in Bandung exceed 10,000, with 10,777 patients on treatment, distributed across the city. The rise reflects broader screening and detection rather than a focal hotspot. To support care, Bandung has expanded HIV testing and treatment to 80 puskesmas and 36 hospitals/clinics, with government-subsidized antiretroviral therapy. The city is intensifying prevention messaging by engaging private universities and promoting awareness of risk-related lifestyles.

triage.headline_ja: 下宿が多く、バンドン市でのHIV感染拡大が顕著
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の流行性感染症であり、本記事は地域の慢性的な感染状況と対策拡充を報じる内容で、突発的な異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: HIV/AIDSは既知の慢性感染症で、感染拡大は検査拡充による検出増加が主因と記事内で説明されている。市当局は検査・治療体制を拡充済みで、外部支援の必要性も明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Sampi Campinas: Escolas e postos de saúde recebem inspeções contra dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sampi Campinas: Schools and health posts undergo anti-dengue inspections.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, Brazil: The Dengue Brigade, created June 2024, has conducted more than 2,000 inspections of schools, health centers, and other public buildings to locate and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites. About 220 municipal employees participate, aiming to make dengue prevention a permanent routine within public offices. Inspections, typically weekly, focus on identifying standing water and conditions favorable to mosquito reproduction, with simple fixes carried out by staff on-site rather than waiting for external teams. The program operates under Municipal Decree 23.300/2024 and involves diverse sectors, including education, health services, social assistance, the Municipal Guard, and Public Services. The 2,000 inspections figure reflects cumulative records since the brigade's creation, not the number of buildings surveyed. No dengue cases or outbreak details are reported; the emphasis is proactive vector control to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: サンピ・カンピーナス：学校と保健所がデング熱対策の査察を受ける
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、予防的なベクター対策活動を伝える内容であり、IHR・WPRO基準いずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は自治体によるデング熱予防のための定期的な検査活動（ブラジル・カンピーナス市）を報じたもので、症例数やアウトブレイクの発生については言及がない。

article.articleHeadline: Karnataka: Stagnant Water In BC Road-Addahole Highway Drains Sparks Mosquito Breeding Fears
article.articleSummary: Stagnant water in concrete drains along the BC Road-Addahole stretch of the Mangaluru-Bengaluru National Highway in Karnataka has raised the risk of mosquito-borne diseases. Residents allege water fails to flow through sections despite lakhs of rupees spent on drainage, with stagnation reported at Surikumeru, Mani, Bollukallu, Perne and Budoli. The health department is conducting awareness campaigns to prevent mosquito breeding, but locals question who will fix the drains. They urge the National Highways Authority to inspect and clear mud, debris, and ensure proper drainage. If design or construction flaws are to blame, corrective action is needed. KNR company, responsible for the drains, stated mud accumulation after completion could cause the issue and promised immediate cleaning and arrangements to allow rainwater runoff to reduce mosquito breeding.

triage.headline_ja: カルナタカ州：BC道路-アダホレ国道の排水溝に水が滞留、蚊の発生懸念広がる
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生ではなく、排水不良による蚊の発生リスクに関するインフラ・環境上の懸念記事であり、具体的な疾患発生や症例報告がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性疾患の発生ではなく、排水溝の滞留水による蚊の繁殖リスクという予防的・環境衛生上の懸念を報じたもの。実際の症例や疾患発生の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: IPVDF recebe escola rural em atividade sobre prevenção da raiva e carrapatos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IPVDF hosts rural school in an activity on rabies and tick prevention
article.articleSummary: Rabies and tick prevention education was conducted by IPVDF (Centro Estadual de Diagnóstico e Pesquisa em Saúde Animal Desidério Finamor) for teachers and students at Escola Municipal de Educação Infantil Flor da Terra in Eldorado do Sul, a rural-settlement area in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. On Friday, November 6, IPVDF veterinarians Rovaina Doyle and Carla Rodenbusch led an age-appropriate program focusing on rabies risks and prevention and the tick life cycle in pets and livestock. Students aged five to six learned about bats and ticks, disease transmission risks, and the importance of vaccinating animals against rabies. Activities included observing parasites under a microscope, a rabies-themed story, and distributing folders, coloring sheets, stickers, and educational games. IPVDF outreach since 2018 promotes sanitary education, preventive health, and responsible animal care; bookings at (51) 3481-3711 or the institute website.

triage.headline_ja: IPVDF、狂犬病とダニ予防に関する活動に農村部の学校を迎える
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生事例ではなく、狂犬病・ダニ予防に関する教育啓発活動の紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・リオグランデドスル州での教育啓発イベントの報告であり、実際の狂犬病症例報告ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Trump sons-linked firm landed nearly $40M in federal contracts to screen for Ebola
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-09, XpresTest, the biosecurity unit of XWELL, was awarded nearly $40 million in U.S. government contracts to screen for Ebola at several airports and to respond to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola has killed more than 5,000 this year. The awards—$20 million under the State Department’s America First Global Health Strategy and $18.8 million from the CDC—mark sevenfold growth from the company’s prior federal contracting. XpresTest has extensive airport COVID-19 screening experience but no Ebola or international biosecurity experience; CEO Ezra Ernst called the Congo assignment risky and unproven. Critics, including former USAID official Jeremy Konyndyk, questioned awarding a major Africa program to a firm with no Africa track record. The Trump sons are passive minority investors via American Ventures in Dominari Holdings.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ家の息子らと関係のある企業が、エボラ出血熱スクリーニングで約4000万ドルの連邦契約を獲得
triage.triage_reason: 記事本体は政治・契約関連の内容だが、コンゴ民主共和国で今年5000人以上がエボラ出血熱で死亡しているとの記述があり、重症度・流行可能性・外部支援の必要性（WPRO基準）および社会的関心（政府・報道）の双方が確認できるためフルRRAでの検証が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米政府契約（Trump関連企業への受注）に関する政治報道であり、エボラ出血熱の疫学的詳細（発生地域内訳、症例定義、WHO公式統計との整合性）は記載されていない。「5000人以上死亡」という数値は独自ソースであり、WHO/CDC等の公式発表との照合が必要。COVID-19は過去の空港スクリーニング実績として言及されているのみで、今回のアウトブレイクとは直接関係しない。

article.articleHeadline: حملة تطعيم في البرازيل لفيروس "كوفيد-19"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 vaccination campaign in Brazil
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 vaccination campaign in Brazil reports sixth weekly rise in cases across all five regions, the broadest spread recently, with positive tests rising for the ninth week in labs. Data as of 8 November 2026 from the Ministry of Health and Fiocruz. Despite rising infections, overall severity remains low nationally; hospitalizations for acute respiratory syndrome are declining. The Health Ministry classifies COVID-19 activity as low risk in all states, though regional warning signals persist. Week 43 data through Oct 31, corrected to state level, show rising trend and co-circulation with other respiratory viruses, complicating diagnosis. Rhinovirus accounts for 50.1% of positive results among severe cases, RSV 10.1%, SARS-CoV-2 8.5%; influenza A/B less frequent. Deaths by virus: rhinovirus 43%, COVID-19 24.1%. Children under one have the highest rates of severe illness; adults 65+ bear most deaths. Vaccination remains the most effective protection; boosters for elderly and immunocompromised are urged; masks indoors advised.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新型コロナウイルス感染症（COVID-19）のワクチン接種キャンペーン
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土でCOVID-19等呼吸器感染症の症例増加が報告されているが、保健省は全州でリスクを「低」と分類しており、重症度・医療逼迫の深刻化は確認されていないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 複数呼吸器ウイルス（ライノウイルス、RSV、COVID-19等）の共流行により診断が複雑化しているが、全国的に低リスクと分類されており、季節性の流行動向として続報を注視する段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : réouverture du centre de santé d'Ania après une fermeture liée à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Reopening of the Ania health center after a closure related to Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, the Ania Reference Health Center, in Aru territory, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, reopened after a 21-day closure caused by Ebola virus disease contaminations among healthcare workers. Decontamination and completion of the contact-tracing follow-up allowed resumption, subject to technical validation of infection prevention and control (IPC) measures by specialist teams. The reopening hinges on strict adherence to national guidelines, including enhanced hygiene, routine handwashing, proper use of personal protective equipment, and safe biomedical waste management. The note also calls for strengthened triage and epidemiological surveillance, immediate isolation and rapid notification of any suspected Ebola case to health authorities. It urges refresher trainings for health staff on prevention protocols, early warning signs, and appropriate response to suspicion. The aim is a progressive, safe return to primary care services while safeguarding patients, staff, and the community.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラに関連した閉鎖後、アニア保健センターが再開 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で医療従事者を含むエボラ感染により保健施設が21日間閉鎖されていた事案の続報であり、進行中のエボラアウトブレイクに関する重要な公衆衛生情報としてフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応に関する施設再開の続報。医療従事者間の感染歴があり、進行中のアウトブレイク状況の一部として注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限については記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ébola : l'OMS s'inquiète des attaques armées contre les structures sanitaires dans les zones touchées par l'épidémie | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: WHO expresses concern about armed attacks on health facilities in areas affected by the outbreak | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (North Kivu) is under intensified threat from armed attacks on health facilities in Beni and the Mabalako health zone (Nov 5–6). A treatment center in Beni was attacked on 6 November; an arson attempt was blocked by police. In Mabalako, three health centers were burned on 5–6 November, with patient deaths reported. Violence is forcing residents, including Ebola contacts, to flee and is disrupting outbreak response activities, which were suspended on 6 November. The World Health Organization confirms staff safety but warns that violence hampers access to patients and elevates transmission risk. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called for peace to enable containment, stating that without peace, Ebola control cannot be achieved.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOが流行地域での医療施設への武装攻撃に懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのエボラ出血熱流行下、医療施設への武装攻撃により対応活動が中断し、感染拡大リスクが高まっているため、IHR・WPRO基準双方に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 武装勢力による医療施設攻撃により、接触者の追跡・治療アクセスが阻害され、WHO事務局長も『平和なくして制圧なし』と警告。対応活動の中断が感染再燃リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 韓國漣川郡及美國部分地區爆禽流感 本港即時暫停進口禽肉禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza outbreaks in Yeoncheon County, South Korea, and parts of the United States; Hong Kong immediately suspends imports of poultry meat and poultry products.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-09, the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) notified highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N9 in Yeoncheon County, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea, and highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 outbreaks in parts of the United States. In response, the Hong Kong Centre for Food Safety (CFS) issued immediate suspensions on imports of poultry meat and poultry products from the affected areas and is coordinating with Korean and U.S. authorities. The CFS will monitor OIE updates and adjust measures as outbreaks evolve. Hong Kong’s import data show that in the first nine months of the year it imported about 80 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and 11.48 million eggs from Korea; and about 33,270 tonnes of chilled/frozen poultry meat and 92.33 million eggs from the United States. Following Denmark’s Slagelse area H5N1 outbreak, the CFS suspended imports from that region, noting roughly 390 tonnes of chilled Danish poultry meat imported in H1 year."

triage.headline_ja: 韓国漣川郡及び米国の一部地域で鳥インフルエンザ発生、香港は家きん肉・家きん製品の輸入を即時停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家きん）における高病原性鳥インフルエンザの発生であり、ヒト感染例の報告はない。対象国（香港/中国含む）は輸入停止措置を取る側であり、発生国（韓国・米国・デンマーク）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 本事案は家きん（動物）における鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う貿易上の対応（香港による輸入停止）であり、ヒトへの感染は報告されていない。発生国は韓国・米国・デンマークであり、対象国リスト（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しないため、verified_locationsは空とした。香港自体は輸入停止措置を取る側であり、発生地域ではないため中国としても計上していない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde repassa R$ 524 mil para conter casos de sarampo no Amazonas - Diário de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health transfers R$ 524,000 to contain measles cases in Amazonas - Diário de Notícias
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health authorized a one-time transfer of 524,000 reais to bolster measles vaccination, surveillance, and transmission blocking in Amazonas municipalities Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, and Tabatinga. Funds from the National Health Fund go to municipal health funds, with recipients required to prove use via the Annual Management Report. On November 7, a joint measles vaccination mobilization was conducted in border areas with Peru and Colombia, including São Paulo de Olivença, to curb regional spread. As of November 9, 2026, Brazil remains free of endemic measles since 2024, but 65 imported cases have been confirmed for 2026, 21 of them in Amazonas. The distribution in Amazonas is Tabatinga (9), Benjamin Constant (6), São Paulo de Olivença (4), and Atalaia do Norte (2). The program emphasizes active case finding, surveillance, and vaccination blockade in priority tri-border zones.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州の麻疹症例抑制のため52万4000レアルを交付 - Diário de Notícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾナス州で国境地域（ペルー・コロンビア）からの輸入麻疹症例が継続発生し、政府が緊急資金を投入してワクチン接種・サーベイランス強化を実施しており、越境拡大リスクと行政的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアとの三国国境地帯での麻疹拡大防止策が中心。ブラジルは2024年以降麻疹排除国の地位を維持しているが、2026年に65件の輸入症例（うちアマゾナス州21件）が確認されている。ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Avian Flu and Salmonella Coinfection Linked to Unexpectedly Low Poultry
article.articleSummary: Two Jharkhand, eastern India, commercial farms reported an April 2024 outbreak of concurrent H5N1 avian influenza and Salmonella pullorum infection in Rhode Island Red chickens. Across Farm A (1,197 birds) and Farm B (5,000 birds), only the RI Reds were affected; other breeds (Kadaknath, White Leghorn, Sonali, broilers, ducks) remained unaffected. Overall mortality was 5.60% (Farm A 4.18% = 136 deaths; Farm B 1.40% = 211 deaths). Mortality peaked between days 6–10 and ended by day 14. Clinical signs included mild respiratory distress, coughing, sneezing, and profuse whitish diarrhea. Postmortems were inconclusive; initial suspicion favored pullorum disease. Laboratory confirmation detected Salmonella pullorum antibodies via rapid serum agglutination and bacterial culture identifying Salmonella pullorum, with gram-negative, non-spore-forming bacilli and characteristic biochemical profiles. The report notes an unexpectedly low mortality pattern associated with this coinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザとサルモネラの共感染が予想外に低い家禽死亡率と関連
triage.triage_reason: インドの養鶏場における家禽（ニワトリ）のH5N1とサルモネラ・プルロラムの共感染事例に関する学術的報告であり、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 2024年4月にジャールカンド州の養鶏場で発生した事例の学術的分析報告。影響カテゴリも動物(animals)のみでヒト感染事例の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 富國島旅行團2人確診登革熱　衛福部緊急監測同團11人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people in a Phú Quốc Island tour group diagnosed with dengue fever; the Ministry of Health and Welfare is urgently monitoring 11 people in the same group.
article.articleSummary: Two dengue fever cases in Taiwan form a cluster linked to a Phú Quốc Island tour group from October; the two patients are among 10 group members, with the tour group including travelers from Taichung City (including the two), Nantou County, and New Taipei City. After returning from Phú Quốc Island, Vietnam in October, they developed fever, headache, nausea, and muscle pain before confirmation. Local health authorities have implemented preventive measures in affected residences and are tracking 11 other tour members, plus three household contacts of the confirmed cases; monitoring runs through December 6. Separately, from November 2–8, Taiwan reported 10 imported dengue cases, including two cluster cases arising from the same trip. A separate local case has been recorded in New Taipei City's Xinzhuang District: a woman in her 40s who developed symptoms in late October and was diagnosed in early November; infection source under investigation, with no recent overseas travel.

triage.headline_ja: 富国島旅行団2名がデング熱確定診断　衛生福利部が同行者11名を緊急監視
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのベトナム（富国島）渡航者クラスターに加え、渡航歴のない新北市での局地症例があり感染源調査中であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 感染源はベトナム・富国島への渡航に関連するクラスターと見られる。台湾（新北市）は対象国リストに含まれないため、新北市の局地症例（渡航歴なし）は記録上重要だが地域リストには反映できない。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : la riposte contre Ebola ciblée dans les zones prioritaires de Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: targeted Ebola response in Beni's priority zones - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is the focus in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the Beni health zone identified as the outbreak epicenter. A provincial coordination meeting on November 9, 2026, recommended concentrating response efforts in priority (hot) health areas within Beni, which comprises 26 health areas, including Bundji, Kanzuli-nzuli, Butsili, Mabolio, Mukulya, and Malepe. Authorities urged daily monitoring and investigation into drivers of resurgence to tailor interventions. Communications on risk and community engagement (CREC) face field difficulties, with emphasis on dialogue with communities. Morgue capacity constraints were acknowledged, with palliative measures under consideration. The government also invoked service minimum requirements in North-Kivu public administrations, to be implemented this week. The article highlights the Ebola outbreak in eastern DRC and ongoing efforts to curb transmission across Beni.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニの優先地域に絞ったエボラ対応 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の再燃（resurgence）が報告され、死体安置所容量不足や行政最低限業務体制の発動など深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は地域メディア（ACP）によるもので、州レベルの対応会議の内容が中心。再燃（resurgence）の文言があり、既存アウトブレイクの継続・悪化を示唆。モルグ容量不足や行政最低限業務体制発動など、公衆衛生システムへの負荷が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Trịnh Tường, Bát Xát tập huấn phòng, chống dịch bệnh trên động vật
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trịnh Tường and Bát Xát hold training on the prevention and control of animal diseases.
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, Lao Cai Province's Department of Plant Protection, Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services organized trainings on preventing and controlling animal diseases in Trịnh Tường and Bát Xát communes, attracting 60 participants (30 per site). In Trịnh Tường, attendees included agency representatives, party secretaries, village leaders, and livestock/veterinary workers; they received updates on livestock disease status, signs of serious infectious diseases in cattle and poultry, transmission risks, and biosecurity measures (sanitation, disinfection, vaccination, safe husbandry). In Bát Xát, 30 participants from the Commune Service Center and 25 villages learned herd management, vaccination, hygiene, reporting, and outbreak response, with emphasis on timely reporting and avoiding concealment or unsafe transport/slaughter of suspect animals. In 2026, Trịnh Tường vaccinated about 1,900 doses, mainly against rabies and foot-and-mouth disease. The trainings aim to strengthen local capacity for disease surveillance and rapid response, supporting sustainable livestock development in the region.

triage.headline_ja: トリン・トゥオン、バット・サットで動物疾病予防・防除研修を開催
triage.triage_reason: 実際の疾病発生報告ではなく、動物疾病予防に関する研修活動の紹介記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は家畜疾病（狂犬病・口蹄疫）の予防研修活動の報告であり、実際の発生・流行事例の報告ではない。ワクチン接種実績への言及はあるが、アウトブレイクの発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: SAFETYNET Expands Field Epidemiology Training and Disease Surveillance
article.articleSummary: SAFETYNET, a Philippines-based NGO supporting applied epidemiology since 2009, expanded operations in India from March 2018 to December 2024, partnering under CDC's Global Health Security Agenda to build field epidemiology capacity. By 2024 it supported 28 training cohorts across India, assisting over 110 outbreak investigations, more than 70 surveillance evaluations, and 14 epidemiological research studies. The three-tier program—frontline (3 months), intermediate (12–18 months), and advanced (24 months)—was delivered through MoHFW-approved MoUs with NCDC, ICMR-NIE Chennai, NIHFW, NIPHTR Mumbai, WHO India, and others; trainees worked in New Delhi, Mumbai, and Chennai, with 124 districts in eight states reached for frontline training. During COVID-19, 98% of active trainees and 86% of alumni engaged in emergency response (cluster investigations, screening, contact tracing, containment). Outcomes included mass gathering surveillance, heat-related fatality autopsy protocols, a national COVID-19 facility preparedness tool, and writing workshops yielding 64 manuscripts and 180 conference abstracts; four grants were secured.

triage.headline_ja: SAFETYNET、インドにおけるフィールド疫学トレーニングと疾病サーベイランスを拡大
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19対応実績を含むフィールド疫学トレーニング事業の活動報告であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2018年〜2024年にかけてのフィールド疫学トレーニングプログラムの成果報告であり、現在のアウトブレイクイベントではないため対象国の感染症発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: 台增1例本土登革熱　新莊40多歲女性中鏢　感染源待釐清
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Taiwan reports 1 new locally transmitted dengue fever case; a woman in her 40s from Xinzhuang District, New Taipei City contracted dengue fever; source of infection under investigation.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports 1 new locally acquired dengue fever case in New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District: a woman in her 40s developed fever and fatigue in late October and was confirmed in early November; no overseas travel; infection source under investigation; cohabitants asymptomatic; authorities conducted breeding-site elimination and chemical control, with intensified public education. Last week (11/2–11/8) recorded 10 imported dengue cases, including a Vietnam-based cluster of two tour members (40s–60s) who visited Phu Quoc Island and returned with fever and dengue symptoms; group monitoring continues through 12/6. Year to date, Taiwan has 245 dengue cases: 18 locally transmitted (Kaohsiung 13, Changhua 2, Pingtung 2, New Taipei 1) and 227 imported; sources principally Vietnam 69, Philippines 35, Indonesia 31. Globally, dengue exceeded 2.51 million cases by September, with the Americas accounting for about 69%; Cambodia and Vietnam remain high, though recent trends are downward.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾で新たな本土感染デング熱1例確認　新荘区40代女性感染、感染源調査中
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での散発的な本土感染デング熱1例であり、重篤性・国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、ベクター媒介性疾患であり継続的な監視が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事中でベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の感染源国として具体的に言及されており、これらの国での登革熱流行が確認されているため verified_locations に含めた。カンボジアも言及があるが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nhận biết sớm các triệu chứng của bệnh sởi để chủ động phòng dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early Identification of Measles Symptoms to Proactively Prevent Outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks are increasing in Vietnam. The virus is highly contagious and spreads primarily via droplets and aerosols, and can remain airborne or on surfaces for up to two hours after an infected person leaves. A single case can infect about 20 others, and transmission occurs from roughly four days before rash onset to four days after. Early symptoms mimic influenza: high fever (39–40°C), cough, runny nose, red eyes, and fatigue; Koplik spots on the inner cheeks may appear 1–2 days before rash. The rash typically appears 3–5 days after fever starts, begins behind the ears/forehead, then spreads downward, lasting about a week with a mottled finish. Complications include pneumonia, ear infections, diarrhea, corneal ulcers, and in severe cases encephalitis or death. There is no specific antiviral therapy; management is supportive. Vaccination with two measles doses is recommended; isolate patients, use masks, inform schools and contacts, and verify immunization status.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹の症状を早期に認識し、積極的に流行を予防する
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで麻疹の増加傾向が報告されているが、本記事は症状啓発・予防啓発が主眼であり、具体的な患者数・地域拡大・重症例データが不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は医学啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数や発生状況の詳細データが欠如している。麻疹の増加傾向自体は記載されているが、規模や重症度の情報がないため、PICKUPには至らない。続報で感染者数・地域拡大状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC condemns attack amid Ebola outbreak in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo remains the epicenter of the multi-country Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, with Africa CDC reporting 10,668 confirmed cases and 5,198 deaths. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and has expanded from three health zones to 67 across eight provinces. Amid the response, an overnight attack in Cantine-Aloya, Beni territory, North Kivu Province, reportedly by the Allied Democratic Forces, destroyed health facilities and forced hundreds with confirmed or suspected Ebola infection to flee, threatening patient care, contact tracing, and disease surveillance. Africa CDC condemns the violence and calls for a corridor of peace, protection of civilians, patients, health workers, and facilities, and safe, sustained access to affected communities. It reiterates solidarity with the DRC authorities and partners, emphasizing continued support to strengthen surveillance and protect communities during this dangerous phase of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行下での襲撃を非難
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%の大規模エボラ流行（1万例超、死者5千人超）が複数州に拡大し、さらに武装勢力による保健施設攻撃で対応が阻害されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する重大な公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: 複数国にまたがる流行（multi-country outbreak）とされているが、記事本文で具体的に言及される国はDRCのみ。武装勢力による攻撃で接触者追跡・監視体制が脅かされており、今後の拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde repassa R$ 524 mil para conter casos de sarampo no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department transfers R$ 524 thousand to contain measles cases in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, Brazil's Health Ministry authorized a single payment of 524,000 reais from the National Health Fund to strengthen measles vaccination, surveillance, and transmission-blocking in three Amazonas municipalities: Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, and Tabatinga. Funds will be transferred to municipal health funds, with each entity required to document use via its Annual Management Report, per an ordinance in the Diário Oficial da União. A vaccination mobilization on 7 November targeted the Brazil–Peru–Colombia triple-border, including São Paulo de Olivença, to bolster protection amid measles spread in the Americas. Brazil remains free from endemic measles circulation since 2024. In 2026, 65 imported cases were confirmed nationwide; 21 in Amazonas, with Tabatinga (9), Benjamin Constant (6), São Paulo de Olivença (4), and Atalaia do Norte (2) among the affected towns.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州の麻疹症例抑制のため52万4千レアルを交付
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルー・コロンビア三国国境地帯での麻疹輸入症例の増加と政府による緊急資金投入が確認されており、地域的拡大リスクと公衆衛生対応の必要性からフルリスク評価が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: ブラジルは2024年以降、麻疹の地域内流行がない状態を維持しているが、2026年に65件の輸入症例（うちアマゾナス州21件）が確認されている。ペルー・コロンビアとの三国国境地帯での感染拡大リスクに対応するため、政府がワクチン接種・サーベイランス強化のため資金を交付。ペルー・コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Hang me: Bangladesh minister takes blame as another blames Yunus after measles kills 1,200 kids
article.articleSummary: A measles outbreak in Bangladesh has killed about 1,200 people, primarily children, with 1,284 total deaths (1,179 suspected, 105 laboratory-confirmed) and 1,359 new suspected cases plus 81 new confirmed infections reported by the DGHS through November 9, 2026. The outbreak began in March and persists despite an emergency nationwide vaccination campaign launched by the BNP-led government, amid a political blame game with Muhammad Yunus’ interim regime over failure to conduct a scheduled vaccination drive and maintain emergency vaccine stocks. Health Minister Sardar Md Sakhawat Hossain personally accepted responsibility, saying “Hang me.” He noted vaccines are mostly from Germany, Japan, Australia, the UK, South Korea and Indonesia (8% from India), tested and approved by WHO and supplied via UNICEF. Most infections are in unvaccinated children, many under six months. The last mass immunisation was in 2020; 2025 measles vaccination rate for 12-month-olds dropped to 59.6%.

triage.headline_ja: 「私を絞首刑にしてくれ」：麻疹で1200人の子どもが死亡、バングラデシュの閣僚が責任を認める中、ユヌス氏への批判も
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹により1,200人以上（主に子ども）が死亡する大規模アウトブレイクで、予防接種率の低下とワクチン供給の失敗が背景にあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: アウトブレイク発生国はバングラデシュであり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事中のインド・インドネシア等はワクチン供給元として言及されているのみで発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí conquista reconhecimento internacional com Selo Prata da OMS pela eliminação da transmissão vertical da Hepatite B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí Earns International Recognition With WHO Silver Seal for the Elimination of Vertical Transmission of Hepatitis B.
article.articleSummary: Piauí earned the World Health Organization (WHO) Silver Seal for elimination of vertical transmission of Hepatitis B, the first entity in the state to receive the recognition, acknowledged by WHO, PAHO and Brazil’s Ministry of Health. The certificate will be awarded in December in Brasília. Evaluation assessed newborn Hepatitis B vaccination within 30 days, pentavalent vaccine coverage, and prenatal follow-up. Using 2024–2025 data, the state surpassed the 85% vaccination target for the third dose of pentavalent in children under 1 year and for Hepatitis B vaccination in neonates up to 30 days old. Amelia Costa, SES epidemiology coordinator, notes that while the Silver Seal is achieved, the goal remains to attain Gold and full elimination. Cristiana Rocha emphasizes positive results and plans to extend recognition to other health areas.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、B型肝炎の母子感染排除でWHOシルバーシールの国際的表彰を獲得
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生上の成果・表彰に関する記事であり、疾病の発生やアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はB型肝炎の母子感染排除達成を称える表彰内容であり、新規感染や流行事例の報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、内容が成果報告のため発生国としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, HIV and climate change top SADC health talks | The Witness
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, SADC health ministers convene in Durban for a five-day meeting to coordinate responses to regional health challenges, including infectious disease threats, climate impacts and declining development assistance. Key items include the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, strengthened cross-border disease surveillance, early warning systems and coordinated responses. HIV/AIDS programmes and prevention technologies are discussed alongside malaria, with progress toward epidemic control and the 95-95-95 targets. Climate change and El Niño 2026–27 are examined for impacts on food security, malnutrition and water, with measures to protect vulnerable communities and maintain essential health services. Proposals aim to expand regional vaccine, medicine and diagnostics production and establish the SADC Pharmaceutical Pooled Procurement Services to improve affordability and supply security. Sustainable health financing is addressed as aid declines, and SADC Malaria Day is commemorated on 13 November. SADC has 16 member states, including DRC and South Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、HIV、気候変動がSADC保健会議の主要議題に

triage.notes: 本記事はSADC地域保健会議の報告であり、DRCのエボラ流行自体についての新規情報は含まれていない。南アフリカは会議開催地であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 90 Ribu Tempat Kos di Bandung Diduga Sarang Penularan HIV/AIDS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 90,000 Boarding Houses in Bandung Allegedly Serve as Breeding Grounds for HIV/AIDS Transmission
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia — The Bandung City Government and the Bandung AIDS Handling Commission (KPA) expand HIV/AIDS prevention into university communities due to a large number of students living in boarding houses. Mayor and KPA chair Muhammad Farhan notes about 90,000–100,000 kos units citywide, with around 62% of private university students coming from outside the region and residing in kos. The strategy centers on an integrated communication platform, developed with universities and the National Narcotics Agency (BNN), to educate students on risk behaviors linked to HIV transmission. Cumulative confirmed HIV/AIDS cases in Bandung total 10,777. Officials say the apparent growth reflects expanded screening rather than necessarily a surge in transmission, likening it to melting iceberg. Voluntary, confidential HIV screening is available at 80 puskesmas, with treatment at 36 facilities (puskesmas and referral hospitals). Farhan notes personal quarterly self-screening; ARV services are in place.

triage.headline_ja: バンドン市の下宿施設9万軒がHIV/AIDS感染の温床と疑われる
triage.triage_reason: HIV/AIDSは既知の流行性感染症であり、本記事は既存の予防・啓発施策の拡大を報じるもので、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 累計症例数の増加はスクリーニング拡大によるものとされ、急性の流行拡大を示す内容ではない。地方自治体レベルの啓発活動に関する記事。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox e a nova dinâmica das ISTs: Boletim Epidemiológico do INI/Fiocruz revela raio-x das notificações | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox and the New Dynamics of STIs: INI/Fiocruz Epidemiological Bulletin Reveals the X-ray of Notifications | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro again raises mpox alert as INI/Fiocruz releases a new epidemiological bulletin analyzing institute-reported diseases. The first-half 2026 panorama shows mpox notifications and a historical comparison to 2022, the year mpox emerged among the institute’s top 10 notifiable conditions. The report highlights an express change in the profile of sexually transmitted infections cared for at INI, driven by its inclusion in the sentinel surveillance network. A long-running series from 2017 through 2025 traces fluctuations in TB, syphilis, and arboviruses, marking the chikungunya era before the recent dengue peak, and documents the investigation of a suspected case of high-severity hemorrhagic fever. The complete bulletin, including the notification rankings and detailed historical analysis, is published in SEVS 2026.1.

triage.headline_ja: MpoxとSTIの新たな動態：INI/フィオクルス疫学速報が届出状況のX線写真を公開
triage.triage_reason: 研究所の疫学報告書であり、過去データの振り返りが中心で新規の急性アウトブレイクを示すものではないが、重症出血熱疑い例の調査など情報不足な点があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロのINI/フィオクルス研究所による疫学速報の紹介であり、mpox・梅毒・結核・チクングニア熱・デング熱に関する過去データの分析が中心。重症出血熱の疑い例についての記述があるが詳細不明で、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 三毒株同时流行！感染过一次，换一种毒株，可能还会中招，叠加降温，流感会更"嚣张"吗？
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are circulating simultaneously! If you've already been infected, a different strain could still strike you. As temperatures drop, will the flu be more aggressive?
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are circulating in China as of 2026-11-09: Influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2), and B Victoria lineage. There is no cross-protection between strains; infection with one does not guard against others. Among positive samples, 65.4% are H1N1 and 34.6% B Victoria; B Yamagata lineage has not been detected since 2020, and WHO has removed it from vaccine components, making vaccines three-valent. Influenza-like illness rate in southern sentinel hospitals is 4.8%, higher than last week; northern areas remain low but rising. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention; protection lasts about 6–8 months, and matching circulating strains is key. Three-valent vaccines cover H1N1, H3N2, and B Victoria; subunit and nasal-spray vaccines exist but differences in protection are modest. Nasal spray is for 3–17-year-old healthy individuals. Vaccinate in Sept–Oct; high-risk groups prioritized. Early antiviral treatment within 48 hours is advised for mild cases and high-risk patients; seek care for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 3種類のインフルエンザ株が同時流行！一度感染しても別の株に感染する可能性があり、気温低下も重なってインフルエンザはより猛威を振るうのか？
triage.triage_reason: 中国における季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1・H3N2・B/Victoria）の通常の流行状況とワクチン接種に関する公衆衛生広報記事であり、異常な重症化や国際的拡大の兆候は見られない。
