article.articleHeadline: После нападения медведя на человека в поселке Ямала ищут бешенство
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies testing underway after a bear attack on a man in the Yamala settlement.
article.articleSummary: Rabies testing is underway after a bear attack on a man in Urengoy settlement, Purovsky District, Yamalo-Nenets Autonomous Okrug (YaNAO). Local veterinary services are conducting measures to prevent spread and eliminate foci of rabies, a standard response after animal attacks. Officials note that rabies reservoirs are wild carnivores. The attack occurred last week at the industrial base of the Federal State Budgetary Institution Ob-Irtyshvodput. A separate nighttime incident occurred in Ratte village in Krasnoselkupsky District, where the victim survived after a confrontation with a wild animal. No laboratory confirmation of rabies has been reported yet; investigations and monitoring are ongoing. The situation highlights risks posed by wild carnivores in the region and the need for rapid veterinary response after encounters.

article.articleHeadline: Saúde libera R$ 524 mil para reforçar combate ao sarampo no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health releases R$ 524 thousand to bolster the fight against measles in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Amazonas, Brazil: The Ministry of Health authorizes a one-time transfer of R$524,000 from the National Health Fund to three Amazonas municipalities—Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, and Tabatinga—for intensified vaccination, epidemiological surveillance, and transmission blocking. The funds, to be accounted via the Annual Management Report, follow a vaccination drive held on Saturday near the Brazil-Peru-Colombia tri-border region, also including São Paulo de Olivença. Brazil remains non-endemic since 2024, but 65 imported measles cases have been confirmed in 2026, with Amazonas reporting 21 cases: Tabatinga 9, Benjamin Constant 6, São Paulo de Olivença 4, Atalaia do Norte 2, all near Peru/Colombia borders. Measures include active case finding, surveillance, and targeted vaccination in ports, riverine communities, and indigenous territories.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州での麻疹対策強化のため52.4万レアルを拠出

triage.notes: 記事サマリーではペルー・コロンビアも国境地帯として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アマゾナス州（Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, Tabatinga, São Paulo de Olivença）の国境地域での輸入症例による麻疹再興が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Vinho de patauá provoca surto de Chagas e deixa uma pessoa morta no Pará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patauá palm wine triggers Chagas disease outbreak and leaves one person dead in Pará.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-09, seven Chagas disease cases linked to patauá palm wine in Óbidos, Pará, have been confirmed, with one death and two hospitalizations. An ICU patient at Hospital Menino Jesus, Oriximiná; another at Hospital Santa Casa de Óbidos; two more hospitalized with limited details; four remain stable at home. Vigilância Sanitária and Adepará report 31 drinkers from a 21 September gathering in Fuzil and Liberdade near PA-429. Twenty-four exposed individuals are under surveillance and will undergo repeat serology in Belém, even if initial tests were negative; five travelers are monitored (two to Manaus, three to Oriximiná). Symptoms include high fever, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal and body pains, and facial leg swelling. The Vila Liberdade production site was sealed; hygiene issues were found, with requirements for barriers and triple washing with blanching. Chagas is caused by Trypanosoma cruzi and often transmitted orally in the Amazon via contaminated fruits.

triage.headline_ja: パタウア椰子酒がシャーガス病の集団発生を引き起こし、パラ州で1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: パラ州オビドスで経口感染によるシャーガス病の局地的クラスター（7例、死亡1例）が確認されたが、発生源は特定・封鎖済みでヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは低く、国際的拡大の兆候もないため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 経口感染（パタウア椰子酒の汚染）によるシャーガス病の局地的アウトブレイク。発生源（Vila Liberdade生産施設）は封鎖済みで、保健当局が曝露者24名の血清検査フォローアップを実施中。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低く、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: ഇടവിട്ടുള്ള മഴ: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിക്കെതിരെ അതീവ ജാഗ്രത വേണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intermittent rain: extreme caution needed against Dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Intermittent rainfall in Kerala’s Kozhikode district raises the risk of dengue fever and other mosquito-borne diseases. The Health Department warns residents that post-rain water accumulation in and around homes creates Aedes breeding sites, with eggs maturing in water-filled containers such as plastic vessels, bottles, tins, discarded tires, buckets, and other water-holding receptacles. Weekly vector-control efforts should identify and destroy these sources, including flushing and scrubbing containers. As part of a weekly Dry Day program, cleanup drives are to be held on Fridays in schools, Saturdays in government and private offices and institutions, and Sundays in homes. If fever with severe body pains, headache, or eye pain (retro-orbital) occurs, dengue should be suspected and prompt medical care sought rather than self-medication. Prevention is a shared responsibility; wear covered clothing, use repellents, and maintain mosquito-free surroundings.

triage.headline_ja: 断続的な降雨：デング熱に対する厳重な警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な注意喚起・予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行拡大や重症例急増を示す情報はなく、通常の公衆衛生対策の範囲内である。
triage.notes: ケララ州コーリコード地区での季節性デング熱予防啓発記事。具体的な症例数や異常な増加傾向の記載はなく、ルーチンの公衆衛生対策（週次防除活動）に関する報道。

article.articleHeadline: Fern Extract Produces Silver Nanoparticles That Eliminate Disease-Carrying
article.articleSummary: Biogenic silver nanoparticles were synthesized by reducing silver nitrate with aqueous leaf extract of Adiantum latifolium collected from Thiruvananthapuram district, Kerala, India. Formation confirmed by surface plasmon resonance at 414 nm; X-ray diffraction matched FCC structure (JCPDS 04-0783); FTIR indicated phytochemicals such as flavones, terpenoids, reducing sugars capping the particles. The nanoparticles exhibited potent larvicidal activity against third-instar Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus within a 3-hour exposure. Beyond vector control, the extract and nanoparticles showed antibacterial activity against Gram-positive and Gram-negative pathogens and antifungal activity against Aspergillus niger and Candida albicans. Safety tests on non-target aquatic organisms and human red blood cells showed negligible toxicity. Context: dengue affects about 3.9 billion people at risk with ~390 million infections annually, and Aedes spp. are primary vectors; rising insecticide resistance drives search for plant-based, eco-friendly alternatives.

triage.headline_ja: シダ抽出物が病気を媒介する蚊の幼虫を駆除する銀ナノ粒子を生成

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz aponta aumento de casos graves de Covid-19 em Mato Grosso - Só Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz notes an increase in severe COVID-19 cases in Mato Grosso - Só Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Mato Grosso shows severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) activity at alert or risk level with a six-week rising trend, driven mainly by SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19), according to Fiocruz's InfoGripe data for the last week of October. Similar increases in severe cases are noted in the Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. While COVID-19 remains the primary driver of the uptick in Mato Grosso, national severe COVID-19 incidence remains low. The Fiocruz bulletin also records rising respiratory infections from metapneumovirus and rhinovirus in various regions. In Mato Grosso, coronavirus is identified as the main cause of the SARI rise. Infants under two years show the highest SARI incidence, while adults 65+ have the greatest mortality. Among young children, severe cases are linked mainly to rhinovirus, respiratory syncytial virus, and metapneumovirus.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、マットグロッソ州で新型コロナウイルスの重症例増加を指摘 - Só Notícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でSARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）の季節性上昇がCOVID-19を主因として報告されているが、全国的な重症COVID-19発生率は低く、異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は明確でない。

article.articleHeadline: 快新聞／越南富國島旅遊團爆「登革熱群聚」　疾管署示警：赴東南亞應防疫 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Dengue Fever Cluster Detected in a Phu Quoc Island Tour Group, Vietnam; Taiwan CDC Warns: Travelers to Southeast Asia Should Take Preventive Measures - Ming Shi News Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a locally acquired dengue fever case in New Taipei City (Xinzhuang District): a woman in her 40s with fever and fatigue, onset in late October and laboratory-confirmed in November; no overseas travel; infection source under investigation; household contacts asymptomatic. In the same period, a Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam travel-group produced two imported dengue cases (male and female, aged 40s–60s) who developed fever, headache, nausea and muscle pain after returning in late October and were diagnosed subsequently. Public health measures include breeding-site clearance and chemical control, with health authorities monitoring the group through December 6. Year-to-date Taiwan totals: 245 dengue cases (18 local: Kaohsiung 13; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1; 227 imported). Main imported sources: Vietnam 69, the Philippines 35, Indonesia 31. Globally, 2.51+ million cases by September; Americas ~69%. Travelers to Southeast Asia should use protective measures (DEET, Picaridin, IR-3535) and seek care for fever, reporting travel. Hotline 1922.

triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の通常の季節性デング熱サーベイランス報告であり、重症例や死亡の報告はないが、ベトナム渡航者クラスターや国内感染源不明例があり、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 'Hang me, this is my failure': Bangladesh health minister takes blame as measles outbreak claims 1,200 lives- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh grapples with a protracted measles outbreak, reporting 1,284 deaths (1,179 suspected, 105 lab-confirmed) since April 10, with 2.4 lakh suspected cases and 24,523 confirmed infections. In the latest 24 hours, 1,359 suspected cases and 81 laboratory-confirmed infections were recorded; two suspected deaths were added, as 214,000 suspected patients have been admitted and more than 200,000 discharged. The outbreak began in March, about 15 days after the BNP took office in February, prompting an emergency nationwide vaccination drive launched in April with WHO, UNICEF and Gavi support. Last mass vaccination occurred in 2020; 2024’s planned nationwide campaign was delayed. Vaccination coverage for 12-month-olds stood at 59.6% in 2025; vaccines were largely from Germany, Japan, Australia, UK, South Korea and Indonesia, with 8% from India, all WHO-tested and UNICEF-supplied. Health Minister Sardar Md Sakhawat Hossain took personal responsibility, saying, 'Hang me. This is my failure.'

article.articleHeadline: An Ebola erkrankter Schweizerin geht es besser - aber ihr Fall gibt Experten Rätsel auf
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Swiss woman ill with Ebola is doing better, but her case baffles experts.
article.articleSummary: 42-year-old Swiss woman, Ebola virus disease, is improving after evacuation from Nigeria, treated at Geneva University Hospital; her husband, evacuated with her and initially isolated in Zurich, has been released but remains in quarantine. The patient is Ugandan-born and married to a Swiss diplomat; she developed Ebola symptoms after returning from a trip to Uganda in October, marking Nigeria’s first Ebola case in 12 years. The outbreak epicenter is eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo near the Uganda border, with over 10,000 infections and more than 5,000 deaths, potentially the largest on record. Uganda reports about 20 cases since May, most imported from Congo, with no new Ugandan cases since July. WHO and Africa CDC are investigating, including a link at Entebbe airport. Lab findings show related viruses in the Kenyan and Swiss cases, raising questions about transmission routes, including a fingerprint-scanner exposure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラに感染したスイス人女性は回復傾向だが、その症例は専門家を困惑させている
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部を震源とする過去最大規模のエボラ流行（感染者1万人超、死亡5千人超）がウガンダ・ナイジェリア・ケニア・スイスへ拡大しており、感染経路不明の輸入症例も発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部を震源とする大規模エボラ流行とその国際的波及（ウガンダ、ナイジェリア、ケニア、スイス）を扱っているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリア・スイスは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。感染経路（指紋スキャナー曝露の可能性）が未解明である点も専門家の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Một công nhân và một học sinh ở Tây Ninh dương tính với não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A worker and a student in Tay Ninh tested positive for meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal disease cases (Neisseria meningitidis, serogroup B) were reported in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, with lab confirmation by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City. Case 1 is a 53-year-old male factory worker from Binh Hiep and Hau Nghia communes; fever and seizures began on 3 November, diagnosed on 6 November. Case 2 is a 7-year-old boy from Duc Hue commune; symptoms began 3 November and diagnosed on 8 November. Close contacts received antibiotic prophylaxis and are under surveillance. Authorities will enhance surveillance, early detection, and public health measures, including hygiene and ventilation, plus communication campaigns. Separately, 29 workers at a Can Giuoc company reported suspected food poisoning after a 7 November lunch (436 meals); all treated and discharged by 19:00. Southern Vietnam shows rising meningococcal activity, including 5 cases in Ho Chi Minh City with 1 death; ongoing monitoring warranted.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省の労働者1名と学生1名が髄膜炎菌(ナイセリア・メニンギティディス)陽性
triage.triage_reason: タイニン省で髄膜炎菌感染症2例が確認され、南部ベトナムでは症例増加傾向(ホーチミン市で死亡例含む5例)が報告されており、当局が監視強化・予防投薬など対応を開始しているため。
triage.notes: 南部ベトナム(ホーチミン市含む)で髄膜炎菌感染症の症例増加傾向が指摘されており、地域的な流行拡大の可能性に注意が必要。濃厚接触者には予防投薬と経過観察が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 也是去富國島！2台人確診登革熱 同團11人持續監測
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Also heading to Phu Quoc Island! Two people from Taiwan diagnosed with dengue fever; 11 people in the same tour group are under ongoing monitoring.
article.articleSummary: By 9 November 2026, Taiwan’s CDC reported two imported dengue fever cases in Taichung City residents linked to an 8-day Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam tour, with 11 other tour members from Taichung, Nantou, and New Taipei under monitoring through 6 December. A separate domestic dengue case was reported in New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District, a woman in her 40s, with symptom onset in late October and confirmation in early November; infection source under investigation, with cohabiting contacts asymptomatic. Nationally this year totals 245 dengue-confirmed cases, including 18 locally acquired (Kaohsiung 13; Changhua 2; Pingtung 2; New Taipei 1) and 227 imported cases, mainly from Vietnam, the Philippines, and Indonesia. Public health measures include vector-control and environmental cleanup, plus ongoing monitoring of the tour group. Travelers to dengue-endemic areas should use protective measures and seek medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: またも富国島へ！台湾人2名がデング熱と診断、同じツアー団の11人が経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における輸入デング熱症例の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも認められないため、ルーチンの公衆衛生対応として見送り。
triage.notes: 台湾CDCが輸入症例（主にベトナム・フィリピン・インドネシアからの渡航関連）と国内発生例（高雄・彰化・屏東・新北）を定例報告。今回の記事はフーコック島（ベトナム）ツアー参加者2名の輸入症例と、新北市での国内感染疑い1例について。重症例・死亡の報告はなく、媒介蚊対策と経過観察が実施されている。フィリピン・インドネシアは輸入症例の出身地として言及されているのみで具体的な発生イベントではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Maharashtra to install 300 Truenat Quattro machines for TB diagnosis
article.articleSummary: Maharashtra will install 300 Truenat Quattro machines across the state to speed TB diagnosis, including drug-resistant cases, under a ₹41.92-crore project under the National TB Elimination Programme. Machines will be placed at primary health centres, rural hospitals and district facilities over 21 months. A tripartite MoU binds BPCL Foundation, HITES-HLL Infra Tech Services Ltd, and the joint director of health services (TB and leprosy). Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis said the initiative would bring modern diagnostics to remote areas. The WHO-approved, portable, battery-operated devices detect TB and rifampicin-resistant TB in about an hour, even in limited infrastructure. Health workers will be trained, with deployment monitored digitally via the Nikshay platform. The project aims for 9.36 lakh tests annually, identifying about 1.12 lakh TB patients and 4,680 rifampicin-resistant TB cases each year, potentially reducing delays and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: マハーラーシュトラ州、結核診断のためにTruenat Quattro機器300台を設置へ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核診断機器導入という保健システム強化策の報道であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核対策プログラムにおける診断機器の導入計画の発表であり、感染症アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する地域があっても verified_locations には含めない（ルーチンの保健政策ニュースのため）。

article.articleHeadline: Rainfall triggers fever surge fears in Chittoor, Annamayya districts
article.articleSummary: Chittoor and Annamayya districts in Andhra Pradesh are intensifying surveillance for viral fevers, dengue, malaria, and scrub typhus as intermittent rains and humidity boost mosquito breeding. Stagnant water in residential areas, plots, roadside ditches, and wet fields underpins the outbreak trigger. Dengue is a growing concern in Chittoor, which reported 112 dengue cases in August, up 53% from 73 a year earlier; officials caution that weekly figures require verification but a rise is suspected. Authorities track daily clinic visits, blood test results, diagnoses, and hospital admissions. Field teams will conduct door-to-door checks, mosquito-control drives, and public-awareness campaigns, while municipalities clear drains and remove stagnant water, inspect construction sites, and maintain public spaces. Key Chittoor zones include Chittoor city, Neeva river banks, GD Nellore, Karveti Nagaram, Nagari, Nindra, Palamaner, Kuppam, Bangarupalem, Baireddipalle; Annamayya zones include Madanapalle, Piler, Kalikiri, Vayalpadu, Punganur, Thamballapalle.

triage.headline_ja: 降雨によりチットール県・アンナマヤ県で熱性疾患急増の懸念
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の降雨に伴うデング熱・マラリア・つつが虫病の増加であり、地元当局が通常の媒介蚊対策を実施している段階で、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められないが、動向の継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: インド・アンドラプラデーシュ州のチットール県およびアンナマヤ県における季節性の媒介蚊由来疾患（デング熱、マラリア、つつが虫病）の増加。デング熱症例数は前年比53%増（112件）だが、地元保健当局が監視・対策を主導しており、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。重症度や死亡者数に関する情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz alerta para aumento de casos de SRAG e covid-19 no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz warns of a rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome and COVID-19 cases in Brazil
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin reports a rise in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) and COVID-19 in Brazil, based on September–October 2026 data. SRAG increases concentrate in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, though overall SRAG incidence remains low in DF, SP, RJ, and SC. SRAG alert or high-risk levels are reported in Roraima, Sergipe, and Santa Catarina; Aracaju and João Pessoa capitals exhibit sustained long-term growth. In the past four weeks, rhinovirus accounted for 50.1% of SRAG-positive tests, RSV 10.1%, and COVID-19 8.5%. Among respiratory-virus deaths in this period, rhinovirus accounted for 43% and COVID-19 24.1%. Hospitalizations for SRAG are highest in children up to 2 years, while mortality peaks in those 65 years and older.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz、ブラジルにおける重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）とCOVID-19の症例増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: 季節性呼吸器感染症（SRAG/COVID-19/RSV）の増加報告であり、既知の病原体による季節的傾向の範囲内と見られるが、一部地域でアラート/高リスクレベルとされており継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体（COVID-19、RSV、ライノウイルス）による季節性SRAG増加の公衆衛生機関（Fiocruz）報告。新規病原体や異常な流行パターンは示唆されていないが、高齢者の死亡率上昇や一部州でのアラートレベルには留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa : 53 structures sanitaires privées s'engagent à renforcer le dépistage - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: 53 private health facilities commit to strengthening screening - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, Ebola response efforts in Mambasa, Ituri Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, saw 53 private health facilities commit to strengthening screening and rapid referral for suspected cases. The facilities agreed to implement a triage system—even without dedicated rooms—to take temperatures and ensure handwashing on arrival, with the aim of early detection and reducing prolonged stays before transfer to Ebola Treatment Centers (CTEs). Managers also pledged to apply the case definitions more consistently to refine referrals and to reinforce protection of mattresses in their premises as part of infection prevention. Field challenges include some patients refusing transfer to specialized centers, preferring other clinics. Dr. Yunga Abedi emphasized a collective effort with private structures and the population, calling for broad social adherence to defeat the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサのエボラ出血熱：民間医療施設53か所がスクリーニング強化を約束
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応に関する記事であり、致死率の高い疾患かつヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるため、既存アウトブレイクの継続・拡大動向の確認目的でフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ治療センター(CTE)への紹介体制強化など既存アウトブレイク対応の進捗報告であり、新規発生の報告ではない可能性が高い。感染拡大状況や症例数など詳細情報は記事内に記載がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 300 animais são imunizados contra raiva em Paulista
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 300 animals are vaccinated against rabies in Paulista.
article.articleSummary: More than 300 domestic animals (dogs and cats) received care on Saturday, November 7, 2026, in Paulista, Recife Metropolitan Region, during a mass vaccination drive offering free consultations, exams, and anti-rabies vaccination at the Paratibe Veterinary Screening Center. The event yielded 79 consultations, 227 rabies vaccine doses administered, 17 hemograms, and 4 biochemical tests. The drive aims to reach pet owners who cannot travel to the center on weekdays, complementing regular services. A 25-member team of veterinarians, assistants, and SEMMA technicians provided care, with acaricidal treatment given when needed. In addition to vaccines and exams, the drive included the distribution of gifts and various items donated by partner companies. The campaign underscores ongoing rabies prevention efforts in the municipality and the region, with emphasis on accessibility and preventive care.

triage.headline_ja: パウリスタで300頭以上の動物が狂犬病予防接種を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 通常の狂犬病予防接種キャンペーンの報告であり、感染症の発生や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的なワクチン接種活動の紹介であり、狂犬病の症例発生や感染拡大を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: (Multimédia) La Chine et l'Afrique renforcent leur coopération dans la lutte contre les maladies infectieuses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: (Multimedia) China and Africa strengthen their cooperation in the fight against infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: During 6–7 November 2026 in Guangzhou, the first China–Africa Forum on Public Health announced a joint initiative by the Chinese CDC and Africa CDC to strengthen cooperation against infectious diseases, boosting prevention, surveillance, and outbreak response through shared expertise, technical support, and local training. The partnership covers Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo and expanded malaria and schistosomiasis control, including practical lab capacity building at the DRC’s INRB that improved diagnostic sensitivity and specificity. Malaria programs yield major gains: Comoros achieved near-elimination with 2017 deaths zero; in Tanzania, rapid, community-based screening cut infections from 36.88% to 5.38% in pilots and influenced WHO scaling to Burkina Faso, Senegal, and Zambia. Zimbabwe’s schistosomiasis efforts started in 2020, with 2023 training of 50 technicians and surveys of 399 households across 14 villages (1,358 samples). Li Shizhu highlights shared elimination experiences; Deng Huihong stresses mutual learning.

triage.headline_ja: (マルチメディア)中国とアフリカ、感染症対策での協力を強化
triage.triage_reason: これは中国・アフリカCDC間の公衆衛生協力に関する会議・取り組みの報道であり、新規の異常な感染症アウトブレイクの発生情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・アフリカ間の公衆衛生協力フォーラムに関する報告で、エボラ・マラリア・住血吸虫症対策の成果を紹介する内容。新規アウトブレイクの探知シグナルではなく、対象国リスト外のコモロ・タンザニア・ブルキナファソ・セネガルは除外。DRC、ジンバブエ、ザンビアは対象国リストに含まれ記事の主題国として言及されているため記載。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: British man being treated for Ebola in Congo is being evacuated to the UK
article.articleSummary: British man evacuated from Congo Ebola outbreak to the U.K.; first British patient evacuated from the current outbreak and third person to test positive to return to Europe. He will be taken to the Royal Free Hospital in London, home to a high-level isolation unit used during the 2014–2015 West Africa Ebola outbreak. The Foreign Office has activated infectious-disease procedures; public risk is low. The Congo outbreak has infected about 10,600 people and killed more than 5,100, spreading to 67 health zones across eight provinces since May. France confirmed a June Ebola case in a doctor who returned from Congo and has recovered; a Swiss woman evacuated to Geneva after suspected infection in Uganda, with her diplomat husband held in isolation in Zurich. Dr. Damien Tully of LSHTM noted healthcare workers remain at risk despite protections.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療中の英国人男性、英国へ退避搬送
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)のエボラ流行は約10,600人感染・5,100人超死亡と規模が大きく、既に英国・フランス・スイスへ患者が国際搬送されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事主題はコンゴ(DRC)で進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、英国・フランス・スイス・ウガンダは帰国/渡航した患者の関連地として言及されているのみで、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外した。致死率・拡大規模・国際搬送事例から高いリスクが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue : un rugbyman de 23 ans meurt de la maladie contractée au Vietnam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: a 23-year-old rugby player dies from dengue contracted in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever made headlines after 23-year-old rugby player Mathis Blondeau died in Vietnam on October 27, 2026, after contracting dengue during a Southeast Asia gap year. Dengue is mosquito-borne and has four serotypes (DEN-1 to DEN-4). The disease is expanding globally, with WHO reporting over 15 million cases and more than 10,000 deaths in 2024. Severe dengue accounts for about 1% of cases and can involve plasma leakage, organ hypoperfusion, pleural/peritoneal effusions, respiratory distress, and hemorrhage, especially in young children or on secondary infection. Warning signs—abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, effusions, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, or agitation—appear 3–7 days after onset and require urgent care. A vaccine, Qdenga, approved in the EU in 2022, has age- and history-based recommendations. For travel to Vietnam, vaccination is considered based on traveler age, local dengue epidemiology, and stay length. Qdenga requires two doses three months apart, ideally between outbreaks, and protection against severe dengue can reach about 95% depending on serotype and prior infection status.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：ベトナムで感染した23歳のラグビー選手が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで既知の流行病であるデング熱による個別の渡航者死亡例を報じた記事であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス人旅行者個人の死亡例を中心とした健康啓発記事であり、ベトナム国内での新規アウトブレイクやデング熱流行状況の変化を示す情報は含まれていない。デング熱自体は東南アジアで周知の地方流行病。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Singkawang Catat Satu Anak Meninggal akibat DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Singkawang Health Office records one child dead from dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, one child died from dengue fever in Singkawang, West Kalimantan, Indonesia after one day of treatment at RSU Vincentius Singkawang; the patient had dengue shock syndrome. The health office conducted epidemiological investigations at home and at the school. School-area fogging occurred; home fogging was postponed. Preliminary observations show poor sanitation and standing water near the home, creating Aedes aegypti breeding sites. So far, this is the only dengue-related fatality reported in Singkawang during the period. Authorities warn about the pancaroba seasonal shift from hot to rainy, which may accelerate mosquito breeding. They urge 5M vector-control (PSN): drain, cover, bury, monitor larvae, and protect against bites with repellents or nets. Fogging targets adults, not larvae; community action is essential. Seek care promptly for fever, joint pain, back-of-eye pain, nausea, or red spots.

triage.headline_ja: シンカワン保健局、デング熱で子供1人死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡例であり、地域内での異例な拡大や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、デング熱はインドネシアで季節性・地方流行性の疾患であるため通常対応の範囲内と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで季節性に発生する風土病であり、地元保健局が通常のベクター対策（フォギング、PSN）を実施している。単一の死亡例であり、WHO通知相当の基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue second time: Doctor reveals why it can be more severe and shares warning signs to watch for
article.articleSummary: Dengue can be more severe on a second infection, says Mumbai infectious-disease specialist Dr. Harshad Limaye. India has all four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); prior infection provides serotype-specific immunity but not protection against others. In a second infection with a different type, antibodies from the first illness can enhance viral entry into immune cells (antibody-dependent enhancement, ADE), potentially raising viral load and severity, though not all second infections become severe. Severe dengue may involve plasma leakage that can accumulate fluid in the lungs or abdomen, leading to dengue shock syndrome. A falling fever does not signal recovery; watch for persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, rapid breathing, bleeding from gums or nose, fatigue or restlessness, and reduced urination. Prevention includes removing stagnant water around homes, workplaces, and construction sites, plus seeking immediate medical care if dengue symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の2回目感染:医師が重症化しやすい理由と注意すべき警告サインを解説
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報じるものではなく、デング熱の病態・重症化メカニズムに関する一般的な医学解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事例や症例数の報告ではなく、デング熱再感染時の重症化メカニズム（ADE）に関する啓発・解説記事であり、具体的な地域での流行状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uele : le gouverneur de province en mission de sensibilisation contre Ebola à Yambenda - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper Uele Province: the provincial governor on a mission to raise awareness about Ebola in Yambenda - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola awareness drive led by Haut-Uele Governor Jean Bakomito in Yambenda, Isiro, 9 November 2026. The governor conducted an on-the-ground outreach in Bavabazowa groupement, Wamba territory, to reinforce the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response following alerts from provincial elected officials and traditional chiefs about the situation in Yambenda. He urged residents not to vandalize ambulances, Ebola treatment centers (CTEs), or other response infrastructure. He pledged to strengthen the response by mobilizing additional physicians to ensure better patient care and to curb transmission. He also announced the construction of a hospital center and a school in Yambenda, aligning with the president's quinquennial education priority. On security, Bakomito cautioned the public to stay vigilant and not engage in destabilizing activities. The report does not mention confirmed cases or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州：知事がヤンベンダでエボラ出血熱に関する啓発活動を実施 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱に関するIHR基準が2つ以上該当し、治療センターや救急車への妨害、医師動員の必要性など継続的な感染拡大・対応強化が示唆されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべき案件と判断。
triage.notes: 記事は確定症例数や死亡者数を明記していないが、治療センター（CTE）や救急車への破壊行為への懸念、医師増員の必要性など、継続的なエボラ対応が行われていることを示唆している。DRCのオートウエレ州における既存のエボラ流行対応の一環とみられ、続報での症例数・感染拡大状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle reforça a importância da biosseguridade nas granjas avícolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease underscores the importance of biosecurity in poultry farms.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, underscores the need for rigorous biosecurity in poultry farms. Highly contagious, Newcastle disease is caused by a virus that attacks birds, causing respiratory, digestive, and neurological symptoms and can lead to high mortality. On 25 October, the Ministry of Agriculture reported a focus at an avian facility in Coronel Freitas, within a previously delineated sanitary restriction area. The response stresses routine biosecurity—controlling access of people, vehicles, and materials; cleaning, disinfection; and continuous monitoring across sheds and flocks—rather than reactive measures. Pest control, notably of Alphitobius diaperinus (lesser mealworm), is highlighted as a key component; Ourofino Saúde Animal’s Colosso Pulverization is cited for environmental control and should be applied when barns are empty. Biosecurity must be tailored to each property and integrated as ongoing risk management, not a single solution.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病が養鶏場におけるバイオセキュリティの重要性を再確認させる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州での家禽ニューカッスル病発生に関する記事で、既に衛生制限区域内での管理下にあり、内容も日常的なバイオセキュリティ対策の重要性を説く解説記事であるため、公衆衛生上の新規シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽（鳥類）のニューカッスル病に関するもので、ヒトへの感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは極めて低い。既存の衛生制限区域内での対応であり、新規発生というより既存事例に基づくバイオセキュリティ啓発記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância em Saúde inicia coleta de dados sobre infestação do mosquito da dengue em Coronel Fabriciano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Health Surveillance Begins Data Collection on Aedes aegypti Infestation in Coronel Fabriciano
article.articleSummary: Dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya surveillance begins in Coronel Fabriciano as Health Surveillance teams start the second LIRAa (Levantamento Rápido de Índices para Aedes aegypti) survey of 2026, visiting about 1,740 properties from November 9–13 to identify Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Block selection is randomized by a system of the State Health Secretariat and the Ministry of Health. Under the Ovitrampa program, Coronel Fabriciano conducts two LIRAa surveys annually; the January survey recorded a 3.4% infestation index, with the current November round to update the picture. Residents are urged to permit entry for the inspectors and to contribute by spending at least 10 minutes daily cleaning yards, gardens, and other areas, and removing containers that hold standing water. Health Surveillance Manager Vânia Tavares stresses community participation, noting elevated risk during hot, dry spells followed by rains and the need to reduce mosquito hotspots to prevent arboviral illnesses.

triage.headline_ja: 保健監視局、コロネル・ファブリシアーノでデング熱媒介蚊の生息状況調査データ収集を開始
triage.triage_reason: これは定例のAedes aegypti蚊生息状況調査（LIRAa）に関する予防的・行政的な記事であり、実際の症例急増やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）の予防目的の定期的な幼虫調査（LIRAa）について述べており、具体的な感染症例数や流行状況の報告はない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、感染症イベントとしての実質的な内容がないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện 2 ca mắc não mô cầu ở Tây Ninh, có một học sinh 7 tuổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two meningococcal meningitis cases detected in Tay Ninh, including a 7-year-old student.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal meningitis cases (Neisseria meningitidis group B) were confirmed in Tay Ninh, Vietnam, involving a 53-year-old male worker from Binh Hiep and a 7-year-old student from Duc Hue. The adult began fever and seizures on 3 November, was hospitalized and isolated, with Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City confirming group B meningococcus on 6 November. Two coworkers sharing the patient’s room also developed fever and cough and were hospitalized for monitoring and testing. The student’s fever started 3 November, with seizures, and was confirmed on 8 November. Contacts in both settings received antibiotic prophylaxis under medical guidance; some exposed individuals show symptoms. Health authorities will enhance community and healthcare surveillance, promote personal and environmental hygiene, and encourage vaccination. They stress that antibiotics for prophylaxis must be prescribed, and vaccination is a key preventive measure, as meningococcal disease can progress rapidly to meningitis or septicemia.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎2例を確認、うち1例は7歳の学生
triage.triage_reason: 小規模な散発事例（2例）で接触者への予防投与・サーベイランス強化が行われているが、現時点で大規模な拡大や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: タイニン省（Tây Ninh）はBluedotの発生地域リストに明示されていないが、記事主題の発生地であるためVietnamとして計上。髄膜炎菌B群による散発例で、接触者に抗菌薬予防投与とモニタリングが実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 富國島旅行團2人確診登革熱　衛福部緊急監測同團11人 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people in a Phu Quoc Island tour group diagnosed with dengue fever; MOHW urgently monitors 11 others in the same group.
article.articleSummary: Two new domestic dengue fever cluster cases were announced in Taiwan on 9 November 2026, tied to a Phu Quoc Island, Vietnam tour group in October. The two confirmed cases—a man and a woman aged about 40–60—developed fever, headache, nausea, and myalgia after returning and were laboratory-confirmed. Local health authorities have implemented control measures and are tracing 11 other group members; monitoring runs through 6 December 2026. Separately, 10 imported dengue cases were reported from 2–8 November, including two from the overseas cluster travel group (the same tour). The tour group’s participants include about 10 residents in Taichung City (including the two confirmed), 2 in Nantou County, and 1 in New Taipei City. In New Taipei City’s Xinzhuang District, a locally acquired dengue case was identified in a woman in her 40s with late-October symptoms; infection source is under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: フーコック島旅行団の2人が登革熱と確診、衛生福利部が同団11人を緊急監視
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内での輸入性デング熱クラスター及び感染源不明の自然感染例が報告されているが、重症例や広域拡大の兆候はなく、現時点ではIHR基準の該当は乏しい。地域内伝播の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内でのデング熱症例監視（輸入例およびニュータイペイ市新荘区での自然感染疑い例）。ベトナム・フーコック島は旅行先として言及されているのみで、ベトナム国内の流行状況自体は記述されていないため、対象国リストに該当する検証済み発生地域はなし。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : les rebelles avancent, Ebola dépasse 5 300 morts et Kinshasa mise sur la Tanzanie - Cameroun24.net infos actus news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Rebels advance, Ebola surpasses 5,300 deaths and Kinshasa bets on Tanzania - Cameroun24.net news updates
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,300 deaths, with 10,920 confirmed cases and 5,323 deaths per the national health institute; cholera exceeds 60,000 cases since January. In South Kivu, FRN rebels captured Bitale, Bulambika and Kalonge on November 7, threatening the Bukavu–Kisangani corridor near Kahuzi-Biega National Park. Central African Republic fears cross-border spillover. The FRN reportedly led by former president Joseph Kabila was condemned in absentia in September 2025 to death for treason, war crimes, and collaboration with M23, and faces U.S. sanctions. Economically, Kinshasa secured 45 hectares at Kwala near Dar es-Salaam for a dry port to receive, store, process and clear minerals and other goods; construction is expected to start in 2027, part of closer Tanzania–DRC ties to access the Indian Ocean.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：反政府勢力が進軍、エボラ出血熱の死者が5,300人を超え、キンシャサはタンザニアに期待
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が5,300人以上の死者・10,920症例に達し、さらにコレラも6万例超と深刻化。加えて武装勢力の進軍により医療アクセスが脅かされ、中央アフリカ共和国への越境拡大懸念もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラとコレラの二重流行に加え、南キブ州での武装勢力(FRN、旧大統領カビラ氏主導とされる)の進軍による人道・保健アクセスへの脅威を報じている。タンザニア・ソマリア・中央アフリカ共和国・オーストラリアは対象国リスト外または記事の主題国でないため除外した。続報でのコレラ・エボラの拡大状況および渡航制限の有無を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: कात्रज चिड़ियाघर में बीमारियों की होगी जांच, संक्रमण रोकने पर जोर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Disease screenings at Katraj Zoo, with a focus on preventing infections.
article.articleSummary: Three-year One Health research project in Pune at Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park (Katraj) aims to detect and prevent zoonotic infections shared among animals, humans, and the environment. Led by ICMR with partners NIV, Bharati Vidyapeeth, and the Rajiv Gandhi Zoological Park, the initiative includes five Indian zoos, such as Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Guwahati. Following a 5 November workshop, the study will conduct regular health surveys of animals and routine medical checks of staff, with samples collected as needed. NIV will analyze collected specimens for viral and other infectious agents, while environmental assessments of zoo premises will identify transmission risk factors. The goal is early identification of infectious disease threats and prevention of outbreaks through integrated surveillance of animals, humans, and the environment."

triage.headline_ja: カトラジ動物園で病気の検査実施、感染予防に重点
triage.triage_reason: 実際のNipahウイルス感染事例の報告ではなく、動物園における人獣共通感染症の予防的サーベイランス研究プロジェクトの開始を伝える記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事はNipahウイルスの実際の発生事例ではなく、ICMR主導のOne Healthプロジェクトとして複数の動物園（プネー、デリー、チェンナイ、グワハティ）で人獣共通感染症の予防的監視体制を構築する取り組みを報告している。具体的な感染症例の発生は言及されていないため、対象国（インド）であってもシグナルとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: UPA de Divinópolis retoma uso obrigatório de máscaras após surto de covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis Emergency Care Unit Resumes Mandatory Mask Use After COVID-19 Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis, Brazil, UPA Padre Roberto Emergency Care Unit reports 54 confirmed COVID-19 cases among patients and staff from Oct 18 to early Nov 2026, prompting a return to mandatory mask use across all unit areas. The policy, along with physical distancing and frequent hand hygiene with alcohol gel, aims to curb transmission in this high-traffic health facility. Non-compliance with biosafety protocols may incur legal consequences, including potential infractions of sanitary preventive measures under Brazilian Penal Code Article 268 (detention 1 month to 1 year plus fines) and, in cases of hostility toward staff, possible desacato under Article 331 (6 months to 2 years), with outcomes dependent on individual assessment. Triage and flow procedures require masks at reception, use of waiting-room corridors, and limited accompanying persons; security may intervene in exceptional conflicts.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノポリス緊急医療ユニット、COVID-19アウトブレイク後にマスク着用義務を再開
triage.triage_reason: 単一医療施設内でのローカルなCOVID-19集団感染であり、既知の疾患・既存対策範囲内で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、単一医療施設内（54例）の局所的アウトブレイクで地域限定的対応（マスク義務化）がとられている事例。

article.articleHeadline: FBI Investigates Doc's Death; Measles Cases Top 5,000; Can Flu Shot Fight Cancer?
article.articleSummary: Measles in the United States totals 5,182 cases this year, per the CDC, with the Pan American Health Organization to meet to decide whether the U.S. has lost measles elimination status. The Ebola outbreak in Congo persists, now with 10,879 confirmed cases and 5,302 deaths, underscoring ongoing transmission. Lidl US has issued a Class I recall of gelato due to risk of Listeria monocytogenes contamination. The brief highlights ongoing infectious-disease concerns and vaccination considerations tied to measles status and public-health surveillance, alongside a foodborne outbreak signal for Listeria. No laboratory confirmation details or infection sources are provided beyond the figures. Publication date: 2026-11-09.

triage.headline_ja: FBI、医師の死を捜査；麻疹症例が5,000人を突破；インフルエンザワクチンはがんと闘えるか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが1万人超の感染・5千人超の死亡という深刻な規模で継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は複数トピック（米国麻疹、コンゴのエボラ、米国内Listeriaリコール）を含むニュースまとめ。対象国リストに該当するのはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラのみで、米国の麻疹・Listeriaは対象国外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Período chuvoso exige atenção para evitar casos de chikungunya no DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season calls for vigilance to prevent chikungunya cases in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vigilance rises in Brazil's Federal District (DF) as the rainy season increases Aedes aegypti breeding. Nearby Goiás and Mato Grosso do Sul report higher virus circulation and outbreaks. In 2026, through week 43 (end of October), DF recorded 403 suspected chikungunya cases among residents; 266 were probable and 210 laboratory-confirmed, with no deaths and an incidence of 4.1 per 100,000. Preventive actions focus on eliminating standing water in backyards and containers, keeping tanks and cisterns closed, cleaning gutters and drains, and maintaining clean indoor/outdoor spaces. Protective measures include repellents, long sleeves, screens on doors/windows, and mosquito nets, especially during daytime when Aedes aegypti is most active. Early care is advised for mild symptoms; seek care at a UBS (DF has 170 UBS); if symptoms worsen (persistent vomiting, bleeding, dizziness, altered consciousness), at an UPA or hospital. Historically, 2016 saw the highest probable cases (765) and incidence (29.76/100k).

triage.headline_ja: 雨季の到来により、連邦直轄区（ブラジリア）でのチクングニア熱症例を防ぐための注意喚起が必要
triage.triage_reason: 雨季に伴うチクングニア熱の季節的な注意喚起記事であり、死亡例なし・重症例の明示もないため緊急性は低いが、周辺州での感染拡大報告があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル連邦直轄区（DF）における季節性の予防啓発を主眼としており、周辺のゴイアス州・マトグロッソドスル州での感染拡大傾向が言及されているが、具体的な重症度や死亡者数の増加は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Rio realiza levantamento de índice de infestação do Aedes aegypti - Prefeitura da Cidade do Rio de Janeiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro conducts survey of Aedes aegypti infestation index - City Hall of Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro's Municipal Health Secretariat launches the third LIRAa rapid index survey of 2026, the last before summer and the peak for Aedes aegypti, the vector of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The survey maps infestation risk by neighborhood to guide prevention and control actions. Health surveillance agents visit properties to identify breeding sites and the main container types; the collected data, along with lab analyses, yield the IP (percent of properties with larvae or pupae) and the ITR (infestation by container type). The effort aims to strengthen actions before summer and requires strong community participation to eliminate breeding sites. The SMS also runs SVS na Rua, a continuous program of inspections and container elimination. By Oct 31, 2026, 10,298,972 property visits and 1,391,840 containers treated/eliminated; 2025 totals: 12,297,072 visits and 1,684,674 containers treated/eliminated. For inquiries, Central 1746.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、ネッタイシマカ生息指数調査を実施 - リオデジャネイロ市役所
triage.triage_reason: これは季節前の定例的な蚊媒介感染症予防・サーベイランス活動の報告であり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の記載はない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱媒介蚊（ネッタイシマカ）の定期調査・予防活動を報告するものであり、ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とする。症例数や流行状況の記載もなく、行政の日常的な公衆衛生活動の広報記事。

article.articleHeadline: " Il était solaire " : Mathis, jeune rugbyman du Finistère, est mort de la dengue au Vietnam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "He was sunny": Mathis, a young rugby player from Finistère, died of dengue fever in Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: 23-year-old Mathis Blondeau, originally from Quimper in Finistère, France, died in Vietnam on 27 October 2026 from dengue fever while on a gap year during studies at INSEEC Lyon. A former player and captain for Rugby Club Quimpérois, he progressed through the club's youth ranks and appeared for the senior team as scrum-half. He also represented Brittany and held a license with Rhône Sportif Rugby in Villeurbanne during his studies in Lyon. His death prompted numerous tributes, including a public homage at the derby between Quimper and Concarneau, with family and teammates recalling his sunny personality, leadership, seriousness, and ambition. The Quimper club and friends planned further attendance at his funeral, highlighting the close ties within his rugby communities. No details on symptoms or infection source are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 「彼は太陽のような人だった」：フィニステール県出身の若きラグビー選手マティスが、ベトナムでデング熱により死亡
triage.triage_reason: フランス人個人旅行者の単発死亡例を報じる人物記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常拡大や集団発生を示す情報がなく、社会的関心も個人の追悼に限定される。
triage.notes: ベトナムでのデング熱感染は個人の渡航中の罹患事例であり、ベトナム国内での流行拡大や公衆衛生上の懸念を示す記述はない。記事は個人の追悼・人物像に焦点を当てたものであり、感染症サーベイランスの観点でのシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: I take responsibility for child deaths from measles: Health Minister
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh Health Minister Sardar Md Sakhawat Husain took responsibility for measles deaths, saying the failure lies with him, not the government. At Bangladesh Shishu Hospital and Institute, during the inauguration of a four-storey building, he acknowledged 1,200 children died of measles in seven months. He defended vaccine quality, rejecting claims vaccines were sourced from India and noting only 8% were imported from India; the rest came from Germany, Japan, Australia, the United Kingdom, South Korea and Indonesia. He asserted the vaccines used are WHO-tested and approved, and supplied by UNICEF, with Gavi and WHO recognized. He added that 65% of measles patients are malnourished and that almost none of the current cases had been vaccinated, with many under six months. He warned that if vaccines had been procured from a private body other than UNICEF, people would not have spared him.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹による子どもの死亡、私に責任がある：保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の大規模な子ども死亡（7か月で1200人）が報告されているが、これはバングラデシュで発生している事象であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、ブラジル、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド）には該当しない。記事中のインドネシア・インドはワクチン供給元として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。
triage.notes: 事象発生国はバングラデシュであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。インドネシア・インド・日本・オーストラリア・ドイツ・韓国・英国はワクチン供給元として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện một công nhân và một học sinh ở Tây Ninh dương tính với não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One worker and one student in Tay Ninh test positive for meningococcus.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) serogroup B cases confirmed in Tay Ninh Province, Vietnam, as of 9 November 2026. Case 1: a 53-year-old male factory worker from Bình Hiệp, employed in Hậu Nghĩa; fever and seizures began 3 November; lab confirmation of serogroup B meningococcus on 6 November by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City. Case 2: a 7-year-old male student from Đức Huệ; onset 3 November with fever and seizures; confirmed on 8 November by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City. Close contacts, including two roommates for Case 1 and other exposed individuals, were given antibiotic prophylaxis; symptomatic contacts were hospitalized for evaluation. Health authorities initiated contact tracing, 10-day health monitoring after last exposure, and strengthened surveillance, health facility vigilance, and hygiene/environmental measures. The article does not mention fatalities; ongoing monitoring for new suspected cases is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省で工場労働者1名と学生1名が髄膜炎菌に陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・タイニン省で髄膜炎菌（血清群B）による散発的な2症例が確認されたが、死亡例や広域拡大の情報はなく、現時点では接触者管理・監視体制が機能している。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 2症例は異なる地域（Bình HiệpとĐức Huệ）の工場労働者と学生で、濃厚接触者への抗生剤予防投与・10日間の健康観察が実施されている。死亡例なし、現時点で地域的集団発生の証拠は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Prevenção intensificada contra a doença de Newcastle garante segurança no consumo de aves e ovos no DF -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intensified prevention against Newcastle disease ensures safety in the consumption of poultry and eggs in the Federal District -- District Policy is now PDNews, news about Policy and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease prevention in the Federal District (Distrito Federal), Brazil, has intensified through enhanced sanitary surveillance and prevention efforts to safeguard poultry and eggs. Seagri-DF (Secretariat of Agriculture, Supply and Rural Development) emphasizes stronger guidance during inspections across commercialoperations and small-scale farms, reinforced biosafety, and ready-to-respond technical teams in line with Official Veterinary Service protocols and national Newcastle disease and Avian Influenza norms. The intensified measures follow a Newcastle disease focus at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, which led to zoosanitary emergency declarations in four municipalities there. Producers are advised to maintain up-to-date vaccination, secure housing, deter wild birds from water and feed, and control access and sanitation. Consumers should check for sanitary inspection seals and practice standard handling. Reporting suspected cases: Defesa Agropecuária da Seagri-DF at [email protected] or (61) 99154-1539.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区でのニューカッスル病対策強化、家禽・卵の消費の安全を確保
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽におけるニューカッスル病の予防強化に関する行政広報記事であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はニューカッスル病（家禽病）に関する動物衛生当局の予防啓発が主題であり、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。サンタカタリーナ州での商業七面鳥農場での発生を受けた措置であり、連邦直轄区（DF）は予防強化の文脈で言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: KSSP calls for better coordination among govt. departments, local bodies to curb spread of infectious diseases in Malappuram
article.articleSummary: Malappuram district in Kerala faces ongoing threats from waterborne diseases like Shigella and hepatitis and a mosquito-borne dengue outbreak, with fatalities reported in the district. The Kerala Sasthra Sahithya Parishad (KSSP) district health sub-committee urges unified coordination among government departments, local self-government bodies, Health and Food Safety departments, Education sector, hotel/restaurant associations, and civil society to curb spread and improve prevention. It cautions that the actual number of people affected by waterborne diseases in Nilambur, Wandoor, Pookkottumpadam, Elamkulam, and other areas may exceed official figures. The meeting called for strict enforcement of health card requirements for food handlers and criticized unscientific practices in issuing and checking cards. It urges the district panchayat and local bodies to prepare an action plan to consolidate agencies for stronger disease surveillance and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: KSSP、マラップラムにおける感染症拡大防止のため政府部門・地方自治体間の連携強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州マラップラム県における水系感染症(赤痢・肝炎)とデング熱の継続的流行で死亡例も報告されているが、既知の地域的・季節性の問題であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 死亡者数や感染者数の具体的な規模が不明であり、国内の地域保健問題としての性質が強い。続報で規模拡大や公的統計との乖離が確認されればRRAへの格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Roraima registra 543 casos de dengue em 2026; veja cuidados essenciais para evitar a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Roraima records 543 dengue cases in 2026; see essential precautions to prevent the disease.
article.articleSummary: Roraima, Brazil, reports 543 dengue cases from January to mid-October 2026, according to CGVS, a 51.3% rise from 359 cases in all of 2025. Dengue, Zika, and chikungunya are transmitted by Aedes aegypti, with El Niño possibly altering rainfall and temperatures and thus transmission dynamics. Preventive measures emphasize eliminating standing water in containers (bottles, buckets, tires), cleaning plant pots, keeping water tanks sealed, clearing gutters and drains, proper waste disposal, protecting pools, and checking yards for hidden containers. Use registered repellents and install screens on doors and windows to limit mosquito entry. Dengue symptoms include high fever, headache, body and joint pains, retro-orbital pain, red skin spots, and fatigue; seek health care and avoid self-medication. Severe warning signs are intense abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, dizziness, fainting, or breathing difficulties. Avoid aspirin and NSAIDs; maintain hydration per health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ロライマ州、2026年のデング熱症例が543件に到達；予防に必要な注意点
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的な増加であり、ブラジルでは毎年繰り返される通常の流行パターン。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報もない。
triage.notes: デング熱は媒介蚊(Aedes aegypti)による毎年の季節性流行で、記事は主に予防啓発を目的とした一般的な公衆衛生情報。前年比51.3%増ではあるが重症例の多発や特異な異常性の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Après l'attaque meurtrière des ADF à Cantine-Aloya à Beni, Africa CDC réclame un corridor de paix pour protéger la riposte contre Ebola et garantir un accès humanitaire sécurisé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the deadly ADF attack in Cantine-Aloya, Beni, Africa CDC calls for a peace corridor to safeguard the Ebola response and ensure safe humanitarian access.
article.articleSummary: Deadly ADF attack on Cantine-Aloya, Beni, Nord-Kivu, DRC on 5 November 2026 killed about 30 civilians, prompting Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya to call for a peace corridor to protect the Ebola response. The incident occurs during the ongoing Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo since 15 May 2026, with health facilities targeted and hundreds of patients infected or suspected infected fleeing, jeopardizing case finding, contact tracing, and surveillance. Africa CDC urges protection of civilians, patients, health workers, and health facilities and insists on safe, durable humanitarian and health access under international humanitarian law. The agency expresses solidarity with the DRC and notes cross-border spillovers, with cases reported in Kenya and Nigeria, highlighting the need for a coordinated regional response to the Ebola emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ベニのカンティーヌ・アロヤでのADFによる殺害攻撃後、アフリカCDCがエボラ対応と安全な人道アクセス確保のための平和回廊を要求
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ流行下でADFによる致死的攻撃が発生し、対応活動（症例探知・接触者追跡・サーベイランス）が危機に瀕している。さらにケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（北キブ州ベニ）でのエボラ対応中の武力攻撃が主題。ケニア・ナイジェリアへの症例拡大が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD di Polman: Dinkes Temukan 52 Orang Alami Gejala, Balita 3 Tahun Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases in Polman: Health Office Finds 52 People With Symptoms, 3-Year-Old Dies
article.articleSummary: Polman, West Sulawesi, Indonesia — Dengue fever in Polewali Mandar (Polman). As of November 9, 2026, 52 residents have exhibited clinical dengue symptoms since October 2026; five have tested positive. One death involves a 3-year-old child who was discharged from a public health clinic, relapsed with fever, and died after two days in hospital. The five positive cases have recovered. Most cases are concentrated in Tandakan, Amassangan, Binuang subdistrict. A KLB (outbreak) has not been declared; ongoing monitoring will continue for several weeks. Authorities attribute transmission to poor community cleanliness and uncovered water storage that fosters Aedes aegypti breeding. Puskesmas Binuang chief Abdul Azis notes a declining trend following vector-control measures, including source reduction and fogging. No details on imported/exported cases are provided. Keywords: dengue, outbreak monitoring, vector control, public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ポルマンのDBD（デング出血熱）症例：保健局が52人の症状者を確認、3歳児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ポルマン県で季節性デング熱のクラスターが発生し死亡例もあるが、KLB（アウトブレイク）宣言はなく局地的・減少傾向にあるため、社会的関心の高まりは不明。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドネシアで季節的に発生する風土病であり、当局はベクター対策（フォギング等）で対応中。KLB未宣言、症例数も限定的（52人中陽性5人、死亡1人）であり、現時点では局地的事案と判断。今後の拡大有無を継続観察。

article.articleHeadline: Lo que la crisis de ébola nos dice sobre Chile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What the Ebola Crisis Tells Us About Chile.
article.articleSummary: Ebola crisis, identified near the Ebola River in the Democratic Republic of Congo, shows spillover from wildlife to humans and rapid outbreaks. The current Ebola outbreak has about 11,000 cases and over 5,000 deaths (CDC 2026), the second-largest and fastest-growing. The piece notes such epidemics can spread beyond Africa through surveillance and international coordination. It highlights that most major pandemics, including HIV, SARS, influenza, and COVID-19, began with animal-to-human spillover, driven by human encroachment into ecosystems. Hantavirus linked to the MV Hondius cruise caused 13 cases and 3 deaths across 33 countries; Andes hantavirus in South America involves transmission from the wild rodent Oligoryzomys longicaudatus, with Chile reporting 57 cases and 22 deaths in week 43 (39% fatality), from Valparaíso to Aysén. Chile is expanding One Health approaches, linking Health Ministry, SAG, and universities to address hantavirus, antimicrobial resistance, and surveillance; a November 12 event at Universidad Austral de Chile.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機がチリに教えること
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はオピニオンコラムであり、DRCのエボラ流行やチリのハンタウイルス状況を背景として論じるもので、新規性のある速報情報ではない。記事の主題はチリにおけるOne Healthアプローチの紹介であり、対象国リストの国が主要当事国として扱われていない。
triage.notes: 記事はオピニオンコラムで、DRCのエボラ流行は既知の背景情報として言及されているに過ぎず、記事の主題はチリにおけるAndesハンタウイルス流行とOne Healthアプローチの紹介。チリは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance Reveals HIV-1 Drug Resistance Patterns and Risk Factors in
article.articleSummary: From 2022–2024 in Huzhou, China, a surveillance of HIV-1 antiretroviral therapy (ART) failure involving 184 patients found 81 (44.0%) with acquired drug resistance mutations. NNRTI resistance occurred in 41.8% of patients, with dominant mutations V179D/E/F, K103N, V106I/L/M, G190A/Q/S/T, and Y181C/L. NRTI resistance was present in 27.7%, most frequently M184V/I and K65R. PI resistance remained low at 1.6%. Multivariable analysis identified age, higher plasma viral load, and specific HIV-1 subtypes as independent risk factors for resistance mutations. Viral pol region sequencing, interpreted via the Stanford HIV Drug Resistance Database, underpinned these findings. The study characterizes an evolving mutational landscape among ART-experienced individuals and provides evidence to optimize personalized ART regimens and reduce onward transmission of drug-resistant HIV-1 in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 中国・湖州市におけるHIV-1薬剤耐性パターンとリスク因子に関するサーベイランス
triage.triage_reason: 学術的サーベイランス研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ART治療失敗例における薬剤耐性変異の学術的分析報告であり、アウトブレイクや新規感染事例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Warns About New COVID Variant PJ.2.1: Symptoms Resemble Cold and Flu, Testing Remains Essential | रंग बदलकर फिर लौट आया कोरोना! नए वैरिएंट PJ.2.1 ने बढ़ाई टेंशन, WHO ने दे दी सख्त वार्निंग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Color-changing coronavirus has returned again! The new variant PJ.2.1 has heightened concerns; WHO has issued a stern warning.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, the SARS-CoV-2 variant PJ.2.1 has drawn a WHO warning. Infections with PJ.2.1 may resemble common cold or influenza, with symptoms such as sore throat and prolonged fatigue, making diagnosis by symptoms alone unreliable. Diagnostic testing is the most accurate method to identify PJ.2.1 and guide patient care and public health decisions. Russian infectious disease specialist Elena Malinikova notes severe throat pain and longer-lasting fatigue as possible features, though these are not exclusive to this variant. In India, vigilance remains due to earlier COVID-19 surges and overlap with winter illnesses; individuals with fever, severe sore throat, cough, or unusual fatigue should seek medical advice and undergo testing if appropriate. WHO continues global monitoring; no confirmed new global pandemic or new wave in India at present.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスが色を変えてまた戻ってきた！新変異株PJ.2.1が緊張を高め、WHOが厳重な警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOが新変異株PJ.2.1について注意喚起しているが、インドでは新たな流行拡大やパンデミックは確認されておらず、現時点では情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる新変異株PJ.2.1への注意喚起が主題で、ロシアの専門家コメントが引用されているが発生国としての言及ではない。インドでは既存の警戒体制の延長であり、新たな流行拡大の確証はない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde do DF mantém alerta ao período chuvoso para evitar casos de chikungunya -- Política Distrital agora é PDNews, notícias sobre Política e Saúde do DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District Health Department remains on alert for the rainy season to prevent chikungunya cases -- District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya remains a concern in the Federal District as the rainy season begins, with Aedes aegypti mosquitoes increasing risk. Federal District Health Department (SES-DF) emphasizes prevention; although local chikungunya incidence is low, neighboring states Goiás and Mato Grosso do Sul report higher virus circulation and outbreaks. In Goiás, 13,317 chikungunya notifications and 11,223 laboratory confirmations this year, up 356% from the same period last year. In the Federal District, the Epidemiological Arboviruses Information through week 43 of 2026 lists 403 suspected chikungunya cases among residents: 266 probable, 210 lab-confirmed; no deaths; incidence 4.1/100,000. Preventive actions include removing standing water, covering water tanks, cleaning gutters, using repellents, wearing long sleeves, and installing screens and nets. Symptoms mirror arboviruses: fever, headache, myalgia, arthralgia; severe joint pain common. Early diagnosis and clinical follow-up are emphasized; 2016–2025 history shows fluctuations, with peaks in 2016 (765 probable) and 2023 (690).

triage.headline_ja: 連邦直轄区保健局、雨季のチクングニア熱症例を防ぐため警戒を継続
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱は近隣州(Goiás)で前年比356%増と顕著な増加が見られるが、連邦直轄区自体の発生は低水準で死亡例もなく、季節性の定期的な公衆衛生注意喚起の域を出ない。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼は連邦直轄区(Distrito Federal)だが、隣接するGoiás州でのアウトブレイク的増加(356%増)が報告されている。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: SADC health ministers convene in Durban over regional health threats
article.articleSummary: Durban, South Africa, hosts a five-day SADC health ministers meeting (Nov 9–13, 2026) to bolster regional responses to Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, climate-related health risks, and funding pressures on essential health programs. The discussions emphasize turning commitments into action, with focus on strengthening disease surveillance, early-warning systems, and cross-border coordination. Anticipated El Niño effects in 2026–27 raise concerns over food insecurity, malnutrition, water shortages, and climate-sensitive diseases, prompting plans for disaster preparedness, nutrition interventions, and resilient health systems. A key priority is expanding regional pharmaceutical manufacturing and establishing the SADC Pharmaceutical Pooled Procurement Services to improve affordability and supply security. Financing HIV/AIDS programs remains central, alongside progress toward the 95-95-95 targets, malaria control, sexual and reproductive health, nutrition, and universal health coverage. SADC Malaria Day will be commemorated on Nov 13.

triage.headline_ja: SADC保健大臣、地域の健康上の脅威を巡りダーバンで会合
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はSADC保健大臣会議の開催報告であり、DRCのエボラ流行は既知の継続事案として言及されているのみで新規の感染症発生情報や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はSADC地域保健会議の報告であり、DRCのエボラ流行自体についての新規情報（症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況等）は含まれていない。既存の危機管理枠組みの強化に関する政策的内容が中心。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 registra casos leves, sem hospitalizações graves ou óbitos na capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 reports mild cases, with no severe hospitalizations or deaths in the capital.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, capital of Rondônia, Brazil, logs 46 mild COVID-19 cases and zero deaths in epidemiological weeks 40–43 of 2026, with no severe hospitalizations or COVID-19 fatalities in the period, per Semusa. Surveillance covers respiratory viruses per the Ministry of Health, including Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI), which may require hospitalization and is linked to various pathogens including the virus causing COVID-19. The mayor Léo Moraes notes the situation is under control and transparent. Data may be updated as new lab results are added. Secretary Sandra Cardoso states the network is within capacity; ongoing monitoring continues. The Health Secretariat urges maintaining updated COVID-19 vaccination per MoH guidelines; residents can visit a Basic Health Unit (UBS) to check vaccination status. Regarding influenza, guidelines and doses are awaited for the next campaign. Seek urgent care for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19は軽症例のみ、州都で重症入院や死亡なし
triage.triage_reason: 軽症例46件・死亡ゼロで医療体制は許容範囲内であり、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当せず社会的関心も平常の公衆衛生広報レベルにとどまる。
triage.notes: 市長・保健局長とも『状況は管理下にあり透明性がある』とコメントしており、定例サーベイランス報告の域を出ない。

article.articleHeadline: Tây Ninh ghi nhận hai ca não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tây Ninh reports two meningococcal meningitis cases.
article.articleSummary: Two meningococcal meningitis cases reported in Tay Ninh, Vietnam, as of 9 November 2026. A 53-year-old male construction worker from Hau Nghia commune developed fever and seizures; Neisseria meningitidis group B was confirmed by Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City after transfer to Long An General Hospital in shock and respiratory failure. After six days, he stabilized and was weaned from ventilation. Twenty-seven co-workers are exposed; two close contacts with cough or fever were hospitalized for monitoring and given prophylactic antibiotics. The second case is a 7-year-old boy from Duc Hue commune, admitted 3 November; transferred to Children’s Hospital 1, Ho Chi Minh City with septic shock and acute kidney injury; 8 November lab confirmation of group B meningitis. It is unclear if cases are linked. Tay Ninh health authorities are conducting contact tracing and 10-day prophylaxis for close contacts. Earlier, Ca Mau reported 2 meningococcal cases with fatalities; in October, Ho Chi Minh City recorded 5 cases, including 4 students in one school, with one death. Meningococcal disease spreads via respiratory droplets and vaccines exist.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎2例を確認
triage.triage_reason: タイニン省で重症2例（敗血症性ショック・呼吸不全を伴う）が確認され、過去にもカーマウ省やホーチミン市で死亡例を含む複数クラスターが発生しており、IHR基準2項目・WPRO基準複数に該当するため。
triage.notes: 過去にカーマウ省で死亡例2件、ホーチミン市で学校クラスター（学生4例・死亡1）が報告されており、散発的ではなく複数地域での発生が継続している点に注意。接触者への予防抗菌薬投与・追跡調査が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande confirma 15º caso de raiva em morcego; saiba como se proteger
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande confirms the 15th rabies case in a bat; learn how to protect yourself.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil, confirmed the city's 15th rabies case in a bat within its urban perimeter, located in the central region. The 2026 total now stands at 15, a 36.4% increase compared with the entire previous year (11). Rabies in bats marks the highest in five years. The Municipal Zoonosis Control Center (CCZ) urges vaccination of dogs and cats as the principal preventive measure, with free campaigns underway citywide. Vaccination is mandatory nationwide; animals must be at least three months old and healthy. If recently dewormed, wait at least 10 days before vaccination. In Campo Grande, free vaccination is available at CCZ and Subea; Subea also operates a mobile clinic across neighborhoods. If a bat is found, do not touch it; isolate and contact CCZ for removal. Anyone with potential bat contact should seek immediate 24-hour medical care.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデでコウモリの狂犬病15例目を確認、予防方法について
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病症例数が過去5年で最多となり増加傾向にあるが、現時点でヒトへの感染報告はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病症例の増加で、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。地元自治体が予防接種キャンペーンで対応中であり、外部支援の必要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 18 estados e o DF têm tendência de aumento da Covid-19, apontam relatórios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eighteen states and the Federal District show a rising trend in COVID-19, according to reports.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 exhibits a rising trend in 18 Brazilian states and the Federal District, though activity remains classed as low risk and does not signal a new pandemic. Data from InfoGripe (Fiocruz) and the Health Ministry’s influenza-like illness reports cover Epidemiological Week 43 (25–31 Oct) and annual trends. By early November, 118,851 influenza-like illness cases were attributed to COVID-19; the virus accounted for 3.9% of annual SARI hospitalizations, and 8.5% of viral detections in the last four weeks (weeks 40–43). COVID-19 accounted for 24.1% of SARI deaths (3,479). Vaccination remains the principal prevention. Regional risk estimates show 75% probability of rising cases in Maranhão, Piauí, and Roraima; 95% in Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Espírito Santo, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso, Minas Gerais, Paraíba, Paraná, Pernambuco, Rio de Janeiro, Rio Grande do Sul, Rondônia, Santa Catarina and São Paulo. Genomic surveillance detected 2,199 sequences, 127 lineages; metapneumovirus and rhinovirus also rose, with rhinovirus driving mortality in young children.

triage.headline_ja: 18州と連邦直轄区でCOVID-19の増加傾向、報告書が示す
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の定期疾病サーベイランス報告であり、記事自体が「低リスク」「新たなパンデミックを示唆するものではない」と明記しているため、シグナルとしての異常性・緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: InfoGripe（Fiocruz）および保健省の定期的なインフルエンザ様疾患・SARIサーベイランスレポートに基づく季節性の増加傾向報告。記事内で明確に低リスクかつパンデミックシグナルではないと述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde repassa R$ 524 mil para sarampo em três municípios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health transfers BRL 524,000 for measles in three municipalities.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health allocated R$524,029.67 to three Amazonas municipalities—Tabatinga (R$322,135.03), Benjamin Constant (R$124,376.94), and Atalaia do Norte (R$77,517.70)—to boost measles vaccination, surveillance, and transmission blocking. The one-time funding, via Portaria GM/MS No. 12.281 signed by Minister Alexandre Padilha on 6 November and published 9 November, goes directly to municipal Fundo Nacional de Saúde accounts and must be reported in the Annual Management Report. Vaccination is open to anyone from 6 months, regardless of history, at health units and door-to-door campaigns. Eder Gatti cites border-area transmission risks, boosting efforts at ports, riverine and Indigenous areas to protect Alto Solimões and the country. Amazonas accounts for 21 of 65 imported measles cases in 2026: Tabatinga 9, Benjamin Constant 6, São Paulo de Olivença 4, Atalaia do Norte 2; two in Rio Branco. No endemic measles since 2024; 2025 Amazonas vaccination coverage was 89.7% first dose, 76% second, below national average.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、3自治体の麻疹対策に52万4千レアルを交付
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾナス州国境地域で麻疹の輸入症例が増加し、政府が緊急予算を投じて対応している点から、ワクチン接種率低下によるエピデミック化リスクと行政的関心の高さが認められる。
triage.notes: 2024年以降ブラジル国内での麻疹の地域内流行はないが、国境地域（ペルー・コロンビア方面）からの輸入症例が継続しており、ワクチン接種率が全国平均を下回る（2回目接種76%）点が感染拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Pasien Ginjal Berisiko Lebih Tinggi Terkena Cacar Api, Kenali Komplikasinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with kidney disease are at higher risk of contracting smallpox; know its complications.
article.articleSummary: Chronic kidney disease patients, especially those on dialysis or after kidney transplant, in Indonesia have a higher risk of herpes zoster (shingles) caused by reactivation of varicella-zoster virus. CKD prevalence ~10.3%, with 973 per million receiving therapy. Health system capacity remains limited: ~3.75 hemodialysis centers per million, 0.14 peritoneal dialysis centers, 0.03 kidney transplant centers per million. In an insurance-health data study, hemodialysis patients had a 35% higher risk of herpes zoster (HR 1.35, 95% CI 1.18–1.55); kidney transplant recipients had >8x risk (HR 8.46, 95% CI 5.85–12.2) vs non-CKD controls. PHN can persist for months to years; other complications include vision, hearing, balance impairment. Economic burden: 2015-2022 claims show 28/10,000 at primary care and 7/10,000 in hospitals; inpatient costs Rp2–10m, outpatient Rp100k–Rp3m. Emphasize vaccination and early symptom recognition to protect quality of life.

triage.headline_ja: 腎臓病患者は帯状疱疹（水疱瘡ウイルス再活性化）のリスクが高い、合併症を知る
triage.triage_reason: 慢性腎臓病患者における帯状疱疹リスクに関する一般的な医療情報記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクはない。
triage.notes: 水疱瘡・帯状疱疹は既知の疾患であり、本記事は特定の集団（CKD患者）における疫学的リスク解説記事。アウトブレイクや新規感染拡大の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Em meio a alta de casos de covid-19, Pará tem queda de notificações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the surge in COVID-19 cases, Pará records a drop in notifications.
article.articleSummary: Pará, Brazil, records 2,635 COVID-19 cases from January to October 2026, with October at 9 cases—the lowest monthly total and a year-long decline since June. Monthly counts: Jan 326, Feb 374, Mar 380, Apr 193, May 365, Jun 593, Jul 259, Aug 107, Sep 47, Oct 9. The year’s top municipalities are Belém (281), Santarém (275), Abaetetuba (206), Santana do Araguaia (170), and Altamira (143). Sespa reports no COVID-19 surge in Pará through October, despite a nationwide uptick in Brazil between September 25 and October 31, with 19 states showing increases. The agency notes that vaccination against COVID-19, mask use when symptomatic, hand hygiene, ventilated spaces, and isolation of suspected/confirmed cases for 24 hours after fever ends are advised, and to seek care at Basic Health Units (UBS) or Family Health Strategy (ESF) for flu-like symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19症例増加の中、パラ州では報告数が減少
triage.triage_reason: パラ州では実際にはCOVID-19症例の減少傾向が報告されており、季節性の通常変動の範囲内で、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジル全体では19州で増加傾向が見られるとの記載があるが、記事の主題はパラ州における報告数の減少であり、既知の季節性疾患（COVID-19）の通常範囲内の変動と判断される。対象国リストにBrazilは含まれるが、記事内容が深刻な公衆衛生イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: La dégradation des routes entrave la riposte contre Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: The deterioration of roads hampers the Ebola response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, faces an obstructed Ebola virus disease response as road conditions deteriorate on two major corridors—Iga-Barrière-Nizi in Djugu and Bunia-Kasenyi in Irumu—exacerbated by heavy rains since November 8. The degraded routes block access for healthcare teams and the transport of essential supplies. On Iga-Barrière-Nizi, a large truck en route over a provisional bridge on the Nizi River became stuck, completely halting passage and leaving tens of vehicles, including Ebola response convoys, stranded. In southern Irumu, floodwaters from the Kisege River washed away Kisege 1 at Kasenyi; Mont Gabaon heavy equipment is working to reopen the road to permit goods from Uganda. Local leader Kataloho Takumara urges building a longer-term solution with Kisege 1 proper, Kisege 2, and Diomi bridges and better water management. Road access is essential for care facilities, equipment delivery, and mobility of response teams.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：道路の劣化がイツリ州のエボラ対応を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、道路インフラの崩壊により医療チームや物資輸送が妨げられており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダ国境付近の物資輸送に言及しているが、アウトブレイク自体はDRCイツリ州で発生しているためウガンダは含めない。道路インフラ問題が対応能力に直接影響しており、既存のエボラ対応の継続的リスク評価対象として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: How Ghana can prepare for possible Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ghana should intensify public education, widen dissemination of information on quarantine and isolation facilities, strengthen case-management preparedness, and bolster surveillance across agencies to ready for a possible Ebola outbreak. Speaking on the 68th GMA Annual General Conference, Prof. Yorke urged moving beyond routine entry-point surveillance to enhance community-level monitoring, designate quarantine and isolation sites, and proactively allocate funds to finance response efforts. He called on the public to maintain good hygiene and observe preventive measures, and to avoid physical contact with suspected or confirmed Ebola cases, infected bodies, and contaminated objects. While commending the Ministry of Health and the Ghana Health Service, he said additional measures are needed to protect the country. The reported detection of the Bundibugyo strain in Nigeria should heighten preparedness for cross-border transmission; Ghana has announced new travel rules for arriving passengers.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナはいかにして起こりうるエボラ出血熱の流行に備えるべきか
triage.triage_reason: ガーナ国内での確定症例は報告されておらず、記事は備えと予防策に関する提言が中心。隣国ナイジェリアでの株検出も『reported detection』にとどまり確証度が低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はガーナにおけるエボラ発生への『備え』であり、ガーナ国内での確定症例は報告されていない。実際の検出地とされるナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。続報でガーナ国内での症例確認や公式声明の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil deve registrar cerca de 866 mil casos de dengue em 2027, apontam projeções
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil is expected to record around 866,000 dengue cases in 2027, projections indicate.
article.articleSummary: Brazil projects about 866,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, with an uncertainty range of 560,000 to 1.6 million; 2025 saw roughly 1.66 million. The peak is expected in April 2027, around 40,000 infections. Projections come from the InfoDengue-Mosqlimate Challenge, a collaboration of over 130 researchers across eight countries using 22 models, with Fiocruz and FGV support. The climate factor is a possible super El Niño, potentially elevating Aedes aegypti transmission, but only three models included meteorological data, leaving regional impacts uncertain; the South is deemed most at risk. Dengue risk rises in Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, Acre, and Minas Gerais; others are stable or declining.
