Chikungunya may reach about 90,000 probable cases in 2027, with vulnerability in Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Bahia, Paraíba, Sergipe, Piauí, and parts of São Paulo, Mato Grosso, and Mato Grosso do Sul. Public health guidance emphasizes bed capacity planning and eliminating standing water; seek care for fever, muscle pain, and rash.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2027年のデング熱症例数は約86万6000件になると予測
triage.triage_reason: 2027年の将来予測に関する統計的モデリング記事であり、現時点での急性アウトブレイクではないが、デング熱・チクングニア熱の恒常的流行国での継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、研究者コンソーシアムによる2027年の将来予測（モデリング研究）に関するもの。デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の疾患であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Tây Ninh ghi nhận hai ca mắc bệnh não mô cầu nhóm B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tay Ninh reports two cases of serogroup B meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Two cases of meningococcal disease, serogroup B, were reported in Tay Ninh province on 9 November 2026. Case 1 is a male born 1973, a construction worker in Hau Nghia, who developed fever on 3 November with seizures and progressed to septic shock; he was hospitalized and confirmed to have Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B by the Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City on 6 November. He is stable after ventilation. Close contacts include 16 roommates and 11 coworkers; two symptomatic contacts were hospitalized for observation. Prophylaxis was given to 76 hospital contacts. Case 2 involves a male child born 2019, student at Bình Thành School in Duc Hue, who developed fever on 3 November with seizures and was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City Pediatric Hospital 1 on 5 November; on 8 November he tested positive for serogroup B. There were 94 dormitory contacts; at school, 5 teachers, 26 classmates, and 24 dorm students. Prophylaxis provided; 10-day follow-up. Authorities call for continued contact tracing, prophylaxis, surveillance, and public health messaging.

triage.headline_ja: タイニン省で髄膜炎菌B群感染症2例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・タイニン省で髄膜炎菌B群感染症の重症例が2例報告されたが、現時点で死亡例やさらなる拡大は確認されておらず、接触者への予防投与・追跡調査が実施中であるため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 2例は敗血症性ショックやICU管理を要する重症例だが、学校・寮など濃厚接触者への予防投与と追跡調査が速やかに実施されており、現時点で地域的・国際的拡大の兆候はない。今後のクラスター化の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Tunisie: Grippe ou nouveau Covid-19 ? L'OMS alerte sur le variant PJ.2.1 détecté dans 19 pays
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tunisia: Flu or new COVID-19? The WHO warns about the PJ.2.1 variant detected in 19 countries.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1 presents with clinical signs indistinguishable from a common cold or seasonal influenza, requiring laboratory testing for accurate diagnosis. The World Health Organization warns that relying on symptoms alone is insufficient to identify the virus, and testing is essential when infection type influences treatment or public health response. Detected first in June 2026, PJ.2.1 has been confirmed in at least 19 countries, including the United States, China, France, Sweden, Spain and Singapore, signaling potential for wider global spread. Overlap of respiratory illness symptoms complicates initial clinical management. Authorities emphasize laboratory confirmation to guide treatment and public health measures. The report provides limited detail on severity or mortality; ongoing international surveillance is advised as circulation continues.

triage.headline_ja: チュニジア：インフルエンザか新型COVID-19か？WHOが19カ国で検出されたPJ.2.1変異株について警告
triage.triage_reason: WHOが新変異株PJ.2.1について19カ国での検出を警告しており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は新型COVID-19変異株PJ.2.1の国際的拡散についてのWHO警告が主題。発生地域に挙げられた米国・フランス・スペイン・シンガポール・スウェーデンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国のみ対象国リストに該当し、確認国として明記されているため含めた。重症度・致死率に関する情報は記事内で明示的に「限定的」とされており不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue: agentes vão vistoriar mais de 4 mil imóveis em Cascavel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control: agents will inspect more than 4,000 properties in Cascavel.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in Cascavel, Paraná, Brazil, runs October 9–13, 2026, with the LIRA rapid index survey targeting over 4,000 properties across 117 localities to monitor Aedes aegypti, supported by 82 dedicated agents. Cascavel reports 287 dengue cases and 9 chikungunya cases this year, mainly in the northern region. Authorities emphasize community involvement, noting that more than 40% of transmission foci are intra-domiciliary or peri-domiciliary. In parallel, the city continues Wolbachia releases and deploys 930 mosquito traps (ovitraps) for region-wide surveillance, which may reduce reliance on annual LIRA in the future. Background context cites a 2027 trend toward higher probable dengue cases in Paraná and other states, linked to El Niño, based on data from Fiocruz and Fundação Getúlio Vargas (FGV).

triage.headline_ja: デング対策：担当者がカスカベルで4,000件以上の物件を調査へ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州カスカベルにおける通常の蚊媒介疾患対策（LIRA調査、Wolbachia放出、オビトラップ設置）に関する活動報告であり、症例数も限定的で異常な増加や国際的拡大の兆候はない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。地元自治体による季節的なデング対策活動の報告であり、通常業務の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de infecciones respiratorias: Estos son los virus que están circulando y las señales de alerta que debes tomar en cuenta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in respiratory infections: These are the viruses that are circulating and the warning signs you should watch for.
article.articleSummary: Urban centers in Venezuela, notably Caracas, show concurrent circulation of multiple seasonal respiratory viruses, including Influenza A and B, SARS-CoV-2, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), Rhinovirus, and Adenovirus. Dr. Marbelys Hernández notes that distinguishing etiologies from symptoms alone is unreliable, as about 90% of early manifestations overlap (fever, cough, nasal congestion, malaise, sore throat); diagnosis relies on epidemiology and testing. To cut transmission of influenza, COVID-19, RSV, and others, recommended measures include cross-ventilation, maintaining HVAC filters and HEPA purifiers if possible, thorough hand hygiene, cough etiquette with the elbow, vaccination, and early isolation/telework when ill. Alarm signs warranting medical evaluation: dyspnea, persistent chest pain, fever >38.5°C for >48h or relapsing, altered consciousness, and cyanosis. Week 42 (Oct 18–24) reported 60,120 respiratory illness cases, with eight states, Amazonas foremost, bearing the highest burden. Influenza testing (weeks 1–42) yielded 2,998 samples with 14.9% positivity; mostly females aged 5–19, then 20–39 (52% of positives).

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器感染症の増加：現在流行しているウイルスと注意すべき警戒サインについて
triage.triage_reason: ベネズエラにおける季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、RSV等）の複数同時流行が報告されているが、重症度や異常性を示す情報はなく、季節性の範囲内と考えられるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 記事はベネズエラ（カラカス、アマゾナス州等）における季節性呼吸器感染症の流行についての一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事。発生地域にBrazilが含まれているが、記事本文はベネズエラのみを扱っており、ブラジルへの言及はないため対象国リストに該当なしと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a avançar no Brasil e acende alerta para aumento de casos graves - Jornal O+Positivo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is once again on the rise in Brazil and raises alarm over an increase in severe cases - Jornal O+Positivo
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Brazil with a six-week uptrend across 19 states, affecting a broad age range. Hospitalizations show early signs of more severe disease, per Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin, which notes increased Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) linked to SARS-CoV-2 from Oct 25–31 in Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina, though incidence remains very low in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Santa Catarina, and the Federal District. Since January 2026, Brazil has logged 118,851 reports of Covid-19–associated SRAG up to Nov 4, yet this figure underestimates total infections due to underdiagnosis and underreporting. Private labs show nine consecutive weeks of rising positivity for coronavirus. Experts, including Renato Kfouri (SBIm), attribute the wave to virus circulation cycles, driven by new variants and a larger pool of susceptible individuals; similar patterns are seen with influenza, rhinovirus, and RSV.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がブラジルで再び拡大、重症例増加への警戒が高まる - Jornal O+Positivo
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19の症例増加と一部地域での重症化(SRAG)の兆候が見られるが、全体の発生率は依然低く、季節的な流行サイクルとして説明されており、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 既知の病原体(COVID-19)の季節的再流行であり、専門家はウイルス循環サイクルによるものと説明。新規変異株への言及はあるが、特異的な異常性や国際的拡大リスクの明示はない。続報でSRAG増加の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra 46 casos leves de covid-19 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho records 46 mild cases of COVID-19 in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil, recorded 46 mild COVID-19 cases in epidemiological weeks 40–43 of 2026, with no deaths or severe hospitalizations reported in this period, according to Semusa. The data are part of ongoing respiratory virus monitoring coordinated with the Ministry of Health, which also tracks Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases that may require hospitalization and can be linked to various pathogens including SARS-CoV-2. Geisa Brasil Ribeiro, director of the Health Surveillance Department, notes continuous monitoring and potential updates as new lab results arrive. City Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso emphasizes adherence to epidemiological bulletins, while Mayor Léo Moraes stresses transparency and that the situation is under control with no elevated risk indicators. COVID-19 vaccination remains advisable per Ministry guidance; residents can visit a UBS to check vaccination status and doses. influenza vaccine guidance and doses are awaited for the next campaign. Maintain hygiene and seek care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・ヴェーリョ市、2026年にCOVID-19軽症例46件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 軽症例のみで死亡や重症入院なし、当局も「管理下にあり懸念なし」と明言しており、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない通常のサーベイランス報告。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による定例の呼吸器ウイルスサーベイランス報告。重症化・死亡例なく、当局が管理下にあると明言している。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí está entre estados com aumento de casos de Covid-19, aponta Ministério da Saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí is among the states with an increase in COVID-19 cases, according to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases are rising in Piauí, Brazil, with the state among 19 showing an uptrend based on data through Oct 25–31, 2026. In the Northeast, Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Maranhão, Paraíba and Pernambuco also report increases; broader regional and nationwide upticks in notifications are noted. The Ministry of Health records nine consecutive weeks of higher SARS-CoV-2 test positivity in private labs, yet overall risk remains low and COVID-19 activity is classified as low across states. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe Week 43 (Oct 25–31) detects rising Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases linked to metapneumovirus, rhinovirus and COVID-19, with higher incidence in young children and associations with RSV and rhinovirus; rhinovirus is noted as a major mortality factor in children. Vaccination remains the primary preventive measure; priority groups should stay up to date. In Teresina, vaccines are administered at Basic Health Units Mon–Fri (AM/PM) and at Teresina Shopping (Mon–Fri 1–6pm, Sat 10am–8pm); bring CPF or SUS card and vaccination record if available.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州、COVID-19症例増加の州に含まれると保健省が発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19・RSV・メタニューモウイルス等の呼吸器感染症の増加傾向が報告されているが、保健省は全体リスクを低いと評価しており、深刻な公衆衛生インパクトや異常性は確認されない。季節性の流行として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器系病原体（COVID-19、RSV、メタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルス）が季節性に増加しているが、保健省は全体リスクを低いと評価。小児における重症急性呼吸器感染症（SARI）の増加は注視が必要だが、現時点でシグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には達しない。

article.articleHeadline: ALERTA: Capital já tem 15 morcegos infectados pelo vírus da raiva - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ALERT: The capital already has 15 bats infected with the rabies virus - Boca do Povo News.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Campo Grande, Brazil, has confirmed 15 bats infected with rabies in 2026, all in the central region, with the year’s total surpassing 2025 by 36.4%. The rising bat rabies cases raise concern for both wildlife and human exposure. Vaccination coverage for dogs and cats remains below the target, while free anti-rabies vaccination is available annually for pets aged three months and older at CCZ and Subea. If a bat is found fallen or dead, do not touch it, keep children and other animals away, and contact CCZ. In the event of any contact with a bat, seek immediate care at a 24-hour health unit. The report underscores the need for preventive measures and rapid response to exposures. Keywords: rabies, bats, Campo Grande, vaccination, CCZ, Subea, public health.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：州都ですでに15匹のコウモリが狂犬病ウイルスに感染
triage.triage_reason: 動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病感染確認事例が増加しているが、ヒトへの感染例は報告されておらず、現時点ではフルRRAの基準には達しないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 2025年比36.4%増というコウモリの狂犬病感染数の増加が見られるが、ヒトへの感染例は報告されていない。ペットのワクチン接種率が低いことも懸念材料。続報でヒト感染例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casa de cruising entre homens fecha no Rio após aumento de casos de mpox | Janela Indiscreta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Men's cruising house closes in Rio after increase in mpox cases | Janela Indiscreta
article.articleSummary: Mpox has surged in Rio de Janeiro, prompting the temporary closure of Dédalos Bar Rio, a male cruising venue in Centro, from November 9 to 19, 2026, to reduce health risks. The closure was announced by owner Nando Dias via social media. Between September and October, Rio de Janeiro confirmed 74 mpox cases—more than seven times the 10 recorded in the same months last year—amid municipal vaccine shortages. On November 6, the Ministry of Health sent more than 2,000 doses to the state, raising Rio’s 2026 mpox immunizations to 3,500. The measure aims to curb transmission without triggering alarm given the epidemiological context. The report provides no details on infection sources or laboratory findings beyond case counts.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox感染拡大を受けリオデジャネイロの男性用クルージングバーが閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 前年同期比7倍のMpox症例増加とワクチン不足が確認され、MSMコミュニティでの性感染拡大リスクがあり、行政・メディアの関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 症例の重症度や死亡者数、感染経路の詳細は記事に記載なし。ワクチン供給は保健省により対応済みで、現時点では国際支援の必要性は低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Kasaï-Central : La CNDH alerte sur une crise sanitaire à la prison de Kananga après un décès et l'évasion de 22 mineurs | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Kasaï-Central: The CNDH warns about a health crisis at Kananga prison after a death and the escape of 22 minors | mediacongo.net.
article.articleSummary: Kananga Central Prison in Kasaï-Central, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is facing a humanitarian and health crisis, according to the National Human Rights Commission (CNDH). Insufficient food, inadequate medical care, and limited access to potable water are reported, with only one of four water pumps functioning partially, worsening hygiene and disease risk. The CNDH notes the death of a prisoner with tuberculosis amid these conditions, underscoring the need for regular anti-tuberculosis treatment and adequate nutrition. In October 2026, 22 minors escaped during Oct 8–9, raising security and protection concerns for juvenile detainees. The CNDH urges urgent action from governmental, judicial, health, and provincial authorities to ensure sufficient food, consistent medical care, and reliable water supply to prevent further deaths and deteriorating conditions at Kananga’s central prison.

triage.headline_ja: カサイ・サントラル：カナンガ刑務所で死亡事件と22人の未成年者脱走を受け、CNDHが保健衛生危機を警告
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での結核による死亡例と劣悪な衛生環境が報告されているが、感染拡大の規模や新規症例数など詳細情報が不足しており、国際的拡大の懸念も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 結核自体は新興感染症ではないが、刑務所内の過密・劣悪な衛生環境下での感染拡大リスクが懸念される。具体的な感染者数や死亡者数の推移などの続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Agentes realizam levantamento de infestação do Aedes aegypti no Rio | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agents carry out a survey of Aedes aegypti infestation in Rio de Janeiro.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro launches the third 2026 Rapid Index Survey for Aedes aegypti (LIRAa) to identify areas with the highest infestation risk and guide prevention against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya ahead of summer. Health agents inspect neighborhoods to locate larval/pupal hotspots and track breeding-site types using the Predial Index (IP) and Container Type Index (ITR). Municipal Health Secretary Rodrigo Prado deems the survey essential for targeted summer control and calls for community participation to remove breeding sites, alongside the SVS na Rua program that operates year-round. By Oct 31, 2026, 10,298,972 property inspections and 1,391,840 breeding containers eliminated or treated were recorded; 2025 saw 12,297,072 visits and 1,684,674 containers treated/eliminated. The Ministry of Health added 2,000 mpox vaccine doses to Rio, reaching 3,500 in 2026. Rio reported 218 mpox cases this year, an 84.2% decrease from 2022.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロでネッタイシマカの発生状況調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 定期的な蚊媒介感染症対策活動の報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。Mpoxワクチン接種拡大や症例数減少も通常の予防活動の範囲内。
triage.notes: 記事は季節前の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）予防のための定期調査活動と、Mpox症例の減少・ワクチン配布状況を報告する通常の公衆衛生活動であり、異常事態を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau orienta população sobre cuidados para prevenir a raiva - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesau Advises the Public on Precautions to Prevent Rabies - Boca do Povo News
article.articleSummary: Rabies circulating in bats in Campo Grande, the capital, with 15 animals testing positive in 2026; the latest in the city’s central region. The Center for Zoonoses Control (CCZ) collected the bat and confirmed infection by laboratory analysis. Public guidance emphasizes not touching bats, even if they appear dead; isolate the area, keep children and pets away, and contact CCZ for safe removal. Rabies is a viral disease that is almost always fatal after symptom onset in humans and animals; dogs and cats should be up to date on rabies vaccination. If bitten, scratched, or exposed to an animal’s saliva, wash the area with soap and water and seek health care promptly. Do not capture a fallen or unusual bat—place a container over it if possible and await CCZ. CCZ contacts: weekdays 7–17 at (67) 2020-1789 or (67) 2020-1801; after hours/weekends: (67) 2020-1794; WhatsApp (67) 99142-5701; main line (67) 3313-5000.

triage.headline_ja: Sesau、狂犬病予防について住民に注意喚起 - Boca do Povo News
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病の継続的な検出と公衆衛生啓発であり、ヒトへの感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告はなく、通常の予防広報の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 動物（コウモリ）における狂犬病陽性例と地域保健当局による予防啓発の記事であり、ヒト感染例の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde garante 25 mil doses de vacina contra mpox após aumento de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health guarantees 25,000 mpox vaccine doses after rise in cases.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reported 832 mpox cases and 1 death in 2026 as of November 6. The Ministry of Health secured about 25,000 vaccine doses, expanding an initial 20,000 by 5,000 via the PAHO Revolving Fund, with deliveries over the next three weeks. The doses reinforce a national stock already reaching nine states, including Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and the Federal District. Global vaccine shortages persist due to production by a single Danish manufacturer with limited capacity. To stretch supplies, the health ministry advised intradermal vaccination for certain groups, potentially quintuple dosing. The vaccine must be stored at −20°C and, once thawed, used within four weeks. Transmission is mainly through close contact; symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, body aches, chills, and fatigue. Vaccine deployment is not mass-based; two-dose schedule, 28 days apart, delivered at Immunization Reference Centers rather than UBS.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、症例増加を受けエムポックスワクチン2万5000回分を確保
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのエムポックス症例増加とワクチン供給不足への対応が報じられており、持続的曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性の観点で複数のWPRO基準に該当し、政府・社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ州、セアラ州等）でのエムポックス症例増加とワクチン確保状況についての報道であり、デンマークはワクチン製造国として言及されているのみで発生地域ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Risco a pets aumenta e Capital registra 15º morcego infectado com raiva
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk to pets increases and the capital records the 15th bat infected with rabies.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande’s Centro de Controle de Zoonoses (CCZ) confirmed the city’s 15th rabies-infected bat detected in the urban perimeter this year, with the specimen found in the central region, prompting an official risk alert for people and pets. The finding signals a direct danger to dogs and cats, which may hunt or approach fallen bats and transmit the virus to humans via bites, scratches, or saliva. CCZ is intensifying an annual rabies vaccination drive for dogs and cats, conducting door-to-door campaigns and operating from the Vila Ipiranga headquarters to immunize more pets. Public guidance advises not to touch fallen bats; isolate and contact CCZ for collection and laboratory analysis. Any contact requires medical attention within 24 hours for post-exposure prophylaxis. Rabies remains almost 100% fatal once symptoms appear but is preventable through vaccination and prompt care.

triage.headline_ja: ペットへのリスク増加、カンポグランデ市で狂犬病感染コウモリが15例目を記録
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病感染コウモリの検出は地域の動物衛生当局による通常の監視・対応範囲内であり、人への感染例もなく国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められないため。
triage.notes: 地方自治体（CCZ）による通常の狂犬病予防・監視活動の一環であり、人への感染例は報告されていない。年間を通じたコウモリ由来狂犬病の検出は同地域で既知のパターンと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande registra 15 morcegos com raiva e supera total de 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande records 15 bats with rabies and surpasses the 2025 total
article.articleSummary: Rabies in bats in Campo Grande, Brazil reached 15 confirmed bat rabies cases in 2026, a 36.4% rise from 11 in 2025 and the highest annual total in five years. The latest case occurred in the city’s central region. The increase highlights vaccination of dogs and cats as the main preventive measure to stop transmission between domestic animals and humans. Suspected bats—found on the ground, alive, dead, or indoors—should not be touched; isolate the area and contact the CCZ for safe removal. If bitten, scratched, or exposed to bat saliva, wash the area with soap and water immediately and seek medical care; rabies is a viral disease that is almost always fatal after symptoms appear. Vaccination for dogs and cats is available year-round at the CCZ, Avenida Senador Filinto Müller 1601, Vila Ipiranga; weekday hours are 7:00–17:00 with after-hours contacts for emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデでコウモリの狂犬病感染15件、2025年の総数を上回る
triage.triage_reason: コウモリの狂犬病感染が過去5年で最多となったが、人への感染事例は報告されておらず、地域の予防対策（ワクチン接種・CCZ対応）で管理可能とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（コウモリ）の狂犬病症例増加に関する地域保健当局の注意喚起記事であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。ブラジル・カンポグランデ市の地方衛生当局が対応しており、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Armadilhas para o mosquito e mutirão: Canoas e Nova Santa Rita seguem no combate à dengue; veja como prevenir | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquito Traps and a Mass Mobilization: Canoas and Nova Santa Rita Continue the Fight Against Dengue; See How to Prevent | abc+
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a concern in Canoas and Nova Santa Rita, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, with preparations ahead of summer. No dengue deaths have been reported to date; Canoas shows 30 confirmed cases (26 locally acquired) and 575 notifications, while Nova Santa Rita has 2 confirmed cases (1 locally acquired) and 29 notifications as of September. Most transmission risk comes from Aedes aegypti breeding sites, with ovitrampas collecting nearly 100,000 eggs in early 2026 from about 1,900 traps. Both municipalities employ controls: household visits, elimination of breeding sites, and continued mosquito surveillance. Canoas is introducing the Wolbachia method to curb dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever transmission, joining cities such as Niterói, Campo Grande, Petrolina and Belo Horizonte; deployment date not yet set. Nova Santa Rita plans a November mutirão "Vira Aí!" including a 28 November survey of 423 properties, guided by LIRAa data; Canoas IIP is 0.6% (low risk).

triage.headline_ja: 蚊のトラップと一斉清掃活動：カノアスとノヴァ・サンタ・リタはデング熱対策を継続、予防方法を紹介
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例なく感染指数(IIP)も低リスクで、通常の季節的なデング対策活動の報道であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による予防的な蚊対策（ワクチン的手法のWolbachia法導入含む）の通常運用に関する記事。死亡例ゼロ、IIP0.6%（低リスク）であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bafwasende : l'administrateur du territoire préoccupé par la fermeture des structures sanitaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bafwasende: the territorial administrator concerned about the closure of health facilities - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Bafwasende, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, remains in crisis as health facilities have been closed for two weeks following the murder of a nurse on 24 October and the 31 October attack on the Ebola Treatment Center. Territorial administrator Willy Simbiye Iwoti said authorities are seeking the return of health workers and humanitarian staff to prevent further harm to the population. Rumors accusing clinicians of contaminating water sources fueled hostility and deadly violence against staff. Measures include a period of observation for health workers and dissemination of prevention messages in places of worship, with sanctions for attacks. As of 3 November, Bafwasende had 20 confirmed Ebola cases and 10 deaths; the Tshopo Province totals 95 confirmed cases and 38 deaths since the outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: バファセンデのエボラ出血熱：地域行政官、医療施設の閉鎖を懸念 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国バファセンデでエボラ確診95例・死亡38例が継続中で、医療従事者への暴力により医療施設が閉鎖され対応能力が低下しているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 医療従事者殺害・治療センターへの攻撃により医療対応が停止している点は、感染拡大リスクと対応能力低下の両面で重大な懸念材料。地域コミュニティの不信（水源汚染の噂）も流行制御を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Tecpar implanta banco nacional de antígenos para reforçar combate à febre aftosa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tecpar establishes a national antigen bank to bolster the fight against foot-and-mouth disease
article.articleSummary: Paraná's Instituto de Tecnologia do Paraná (Tecpar), with Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture (Mapa) and Argentina's Biogénesis Bagó, established Brazil's first national antigen bank for emergency response to foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). The facility stores frozen antigens for two FMD virus serotypes, enabling production of up to 10 million vaccine doses and immediate delivery of up to 10 million doses for emergencies. Vaccines can be made available within 72 hours to the Agriculture Ministry. The bank strengthens Brazil's sanitary status as FMD-free without vaccination, recognized by the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) in 2025; Paraná has held this status since 2021. Antigen shelf life is about eight years, longer than vaccines, reducing stockpile needs. Tecpar becomes the sole public Brazilian lab maintaining an FMD antigen and vaccine bank, with ongoing international cooperation to enable technology transfer.

triage.headline_ja: テクパル、口蹄疫対策強化のため国家抗原バンクを設立
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の発生事例ではなく、ブラジルが口蹄疫清浄国としての地位を維持するための予防的な抗原バンク設立に関する内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物疾病（口蹄疫）の発生報告ではなく、ワクチン・抗原備蓄体制の強化に関する内容。また対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本件は疾病発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz prevê 866 mil casos de dengue em 2027 e alerta para efeitos do El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz forecasts 866,000 dengue cases in 2027 and warns of El Niño effects.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz projects about 866,000 probable dengue cases in Brazil for 2027, with an April peak and an 80% confidence interval of roughly 560,000 to 1.6 million; El Niño effects, not fully captured in the central estimate, could raise transmission—particularly in the Southern Region. El Niño-warmed Pacific conditions may boost Aedes aegypti reproduction. Six states are expected to see higher dengue activity: Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, Acre, and Minas Gerais. Chikungunya is also a concern, with more than 90,000 probable cases in 2027, up from about 76,000 in 2025–2026, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and causing fever and severe joint pains. The trend is notable in the Northeast, the three Southern states, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, and Mato Grosso do Sul. Prevention emphasizes eliminating water-holding containers, keeping areas clean, and seeking care for fever, body pains, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルスが2027年のデング熱症例866,000件を予測、エルニーニョの影響に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 2027年に向けたデング熱・チクングニア熱の将来予測に関する記事であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、続報・実際の症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はFiocruz（ブラジル公衆衛生研究機関）による2027年の予測モデル発表であり、実際の発生事例の報告ではない。デング熱・チクングニア熱はブラジルで毎年流行する既知の季節性疾患であり、エルニーニョによる媒介蚊増加の可能性が指摘されているが、現時点で異常な拡大は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 volta a crescer em cinco estados; veja quais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 is on the rise again in five states; see which ones.
article.articleSummary: Five Brazilian states show rising severe Covid-19 cases (SRAG linked to coronavirus) in Fiocruz InfoGripe for 25–31 October 2026. States: Mato Grosso; Distrito Federal; São Paulo; Rio de Janeiro; Santa Catarina. Incidence remains very low in DF, SP, RJ, and SC. In Mato Grosso, there is a concurrent mild rise in rhinovirus infections. The bulletin also notes circulation of rhinovirus and human metapneumovirus contributing to respiratory illnesses. Aracaju (Sergipe) and João Pessoa (Paraíba) capitals display SRAG activity at alert/risk/high risk with a long-term growth trend; Roraima, Sergipe and Santa Catarina have SRAG incidence at alert/risk/high risk but no long-term growth. SRAG is a complication of respiratory infections caused by multiple viruses, including influenza, RSV, rhinovirus, and hMPV. Vaccination remains the main prevention; priority-group individuals should stay up-to-date, with particular attention to the elderly, young children, and those with chronic conditions or immunosuppression.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19が5州で再び増加；対象州一覧
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でCOVID-19重症例（SRAG）や他の呼吸器ウイルスの増加傾向が報告されているが、発生率は依然低く、季節性の範囲内と考えられるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 季節性呼吸器感染症（COVID-19、RSV、hMPV、ライノウイルス等）の通常の監視報告であり、重症度や異常性を示す具体的データは乏しい。複数州でSRAG活動が「警戒/リスク」レベルにあるが、長期的増加傾向は一部地域のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz projeta 866 mil casos de dengue em 2027 e faz alerta sobre El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz projects 866,000 dengue cases in 2027 and warns about El Niño.
article.articleSummary: Brazil is projected to have about 866,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, with the peak in April, according to Fiocruz. The central estimate does not directly include El Niño effects, though an extremely intense El Niño could raise transmission in the South; the overall forecast remains uncertain, with an 80% confidence interval of roughly 560,000 to 1.6 million. Six states show higher expected case numbers versus the previous season: Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, Acre, and Minas Gerais. Other states are forecast to be similar to or lower than last season. Chikungunya is also a concern, with over 90,000 probable cases in 2027, up from 76,000 in 2025-2026, concentrated in the Northeast, three Southern states, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, and Mato Grosso do Sul. Transmission is by Aedes aegypti; Fiocruz urges eliminating standing water and seeking early care for fever, body pain, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: フィオクルス、2027年のデング熱症例数を86万6千件と予測、エルニーニョに警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 2027年の将来予測に基づく statistical forecast であり、現時点での異常な流行拡大や重篤事例の急増を示す情報はないが、デング熱・チクングニア熱の継続的な流行可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はFiocruzによる2027年の予測値に基づく将来予測であり、現在進行中の急性アウトブレイクの報告ではない。デング熱・チクングニア熱は毎年流行するエンデミック疾患であり、ベクター媒介性感染症の季節的リスク情報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: A cada 100 imóveis, cerca de três têm focos do mosquito da dengue, diz Prefeitura de Ribeirão
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For every 100 properties, about three have dengue mosquito breeding sites, says Ribeirão City Hall.
article.articleSummary: Ribeirão Preto, Brazil reports an Aedes aegypti infestation index of 2.9% in October 2026, placing the city in an alert for dengue, chikungunya and Zika per the Ministry of Health. From January 1 to November 3, 2026, 392 dengue cases were confirmed with no deaths. With the rainy season extending to December, authorities warn that standing water in containers can rapidly become breeding sites and urge residents to inspect their yards weekly. Control measures include weekend sweeps, door-to-door visits, breeding-site blocking, and nebulization in treated areas, plus 1,248 larvicide-disseminating stations and traps in priority neighborhoods. Since the year’s start, 68,713 kg of water-holding debris and 9,427 tires have been removed; weekend campaigns yielded 21,030 kg of objects and 2,276 tires. Public participation remains essential, including checking gutters and disposing of tires and debris at ecopontos. Butantan Institute outlines distinguishing symptoms among dengue, chikungunya and Zika.

triage.headline_ja: 100件の建物のうち約3件でデング熱蚊の発生源がある、とリベイラン・プレト市役所
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節的なデング熱媒介蚊対策報道であり、死亡例なく感染拡大の異常性や国際的リスクも認められない定例的な公衆衛生広報。
triage.notes: 392件のデング熱症例が報告されているが死亡はなく、地方自治体による通常の雨季対策（防虫・清掃活動）の一環としての報道。季節性の媒介蚊対策活動であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: NVBDCP of Directorate of Health Service Implements Anti-Larval and Source Reduction Activities to Reduce the Risk of Dengue, Malaria and Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Sri Vijaya Puram's National Vector Borne Disease Control Programme (NVBDCP) Unit, Directorate of Health Services (DHS), is conducting a weekly Anti-Larval and Source Reduction programme across the municipal area to curb mosquito breeding and reduce the risk of Dengue, Malaria, and Chikungunya. Field teams inspect potential breeding sites, eliminate stagnant water, apply anti-larval measures in water-holding containers, and run resident awareness activities. The schedule covers different localities to ensure systematic coverage, with the public urged to cooperate and allow premises inspections. Preventive measures advised include: not allowing water to stagnate around homes and public places; regularly empty, scrub, and clean water storage containers; keep overhead tanks and drums covered; remove discarded tyres, coconut shells, and plastic containers that collect rainwater; maintain cleanliness and proper solid-waste disposal. Mosquito control is a shared responsibility, and ongoing weekly activities aim to maintain a mosquito-free environment in the municipal area.

triage.headline_ja: 保健サービス局NVBDCPが、デング熱・マラリア・チクングニア熱のリスク低減に向けた幼虫駆除・発生源除去活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的な蚊媒介性疾患対策活動の報告であり、具体的な症例数や異常な発生状況の記載がなく、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・アンダマン諸島（Sri Vijaya Puram市）での定例的な蚊媒介性疾患予防活動に関するもので、実際の感染症発生や症例急増の報告ではない。発生地域としてIndiaが付与されているが、具体的な症例数等の記載がなくルーチン活動の内容であるため、監視対象イベントとしての重要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Mapa confirma novo foco de doença de Newcastle em Nova Itaberaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Map confirms new outbreak of Newcastle disease in Nova Itaberaba.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, within an established sanitary restriction area. It marks the fifth detection since the state declared a zoosanitary emergency. The Ministry of Agriculture (MAPA) announced the case on 7 November during routine surveillance under the National Poultry Health Program. Epidemiological investigation, intensified surveillance, and containment measures are being implemented by the Official Veterinary Service. In the first three foci — Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim — all response protocols have been completed and a sanitary fallow period has begun. The fourth focus in Nova Erechim is undergoing cleaning and disinfection. With the new confirmation, MAPA continues coordinated actions with state agro-defense agencies to control the outbreak and protect national poultry production. No case or death counts are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、ノヴァ・イタベラバで新たなニューカッスル病の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病発生であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは低く、既存の防疫区域内での管理された事例であるため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患でありヒトへの感染リスクはほぼない。家禽輸出への貿易影響の可能性はあるが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Agricultura identifica quinto caso de doença de Newcastle - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture identifies the fifth case of Newcastle disease - Sim Notícias
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease has been confirmed for the fifth time in Brazil, with the latest case detected in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Identified on Saturday, November 7, during surveillance under the National Avian Health Program, the case is in a city that already lies within a sanctioned sanitary restriction area. MAPA notes that control measures are underway, including epidemiological investigation, intensified surveillance, and containment actions led by the Official Veterinary Service (SVO). This city reports its second case, reinforcing ongoing concerns within the country’s avian health program. Symptoms or laboratory confirmation details are not provided in the report. Authorities continue monitoring and response efforts as of November 9, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、ニューカッスル病の5例目を確認 - Sim Notícias
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病で人体への健康影響は報告されていないが、ブラジルの家禽輸出に関わる貿易制限リスクがあるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（動物）の疾病であり、人への感染や健康影響は報告されていない。既存の衛生制限区域内での5例目確認であり、ブラジル農業省（MAPA）が自国の獣医当局により対応中。国際貿易（家禽輸出）への影響可能性はあるが、現時点で他国への伝播や人的被害の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Acre está entre seis estados com tendência de aumento da dengue em 2027, aponta estudo nacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre is among six states with a rising dengue trend in 2027, according to a national study.
article.articleSummary: Acre is among six Brazilian states with rising probable dengue cases in 2027, based on a cross-country forecast from 22 IMDC (InfoDengue-Mosqlimate) models developed by 130 researchers across eight countries and presented at a dengue-preparation webinar. The other states with increasing trends are Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, and Minas Gerais; other states show near-equal or lower projections. For Brazil, the central estimate is about 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027, with an 80% credible interval from 560,000 to 1.6 million; transmission peak is projected for April, potentially around 40,000 cases in a single month. The study notes Acre’s trend stems from recent oscillations and does not specify Acre's case count. Nationally, projections for chikungunya exceed 90,000 cases in 2027 (vs around 76,000 in 2025–2026 and 127,000 in 2024–2025). Both diseases remain vector-borne by Aedes aegypti and require ongoing surveillance and health-system readiness.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州は2027年にデング熱が増加傾向にある6州の一つ、全国調査が指摘
triage.triage_reason: これは将来予測研究に基づく記事であり、現時点での異常な発生や急増を報告するものではないが、デング熱・チクングニア熱は媒介蚊による流行しやすい疾患であり動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は予測モデル研究の紹介であり、実際の症例急増や異常事態を報じるものではない。将来の流行シーズンに向けた準備情報として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Agricultura identifica quinto caso de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture identifies the fifth case of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: New Newcastle disease outbreak in poultry in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. This is the fifth confirmed case in the country and the second in the city. The initial focus was confirmed last Saturday, the 7th, during surveillance under the National Poultry Health Program. MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock) says control measures are in progress, including epidemiological investigation, intensified surveillance, and containment actions led by the Official Veterinary Service (SVO). Nova Itaberaba already lies within a sanitary restriction area established by health authorities. Authorities are maintaining containment and monitoring to curb spread within the state and nationwide. The cases reflect ongoing concern for avian health and economic impact in southern Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、ニューカッスル病の5例目を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州で養鶏のニューカッスル病が5例目確認され、国内衛生規制区域が設定されるなど、輸出大国としての貿易制限リスクが懸念されるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本疾患は家禽（動物）の感染症であり人への直接影響は限定的だが、ブラジルは主要な鶏肉輸出国であるため、貿易制限や国際的な家禽衛生への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño pode elevar casos de dengue no Brasil em 2027, alerta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño could raise dengue cases in Brazil in 2027, Fiocruz warns.
article.articleSummary: Brazil could see dengue cases rise in 2027 as a very intense El Niño influences temperature and rainfall patterns, say researchers including Fiocruz from eight countries. The IMDC (InfoDengue-Mosqlimate) project, using 22 models, estimates about 860,000 probable dengue cases in 2027 with a peak around April (~40,000). The 80% uncertainty range spans 560,000 to 1.6 million. Despite the possibility of a 'Super El Niño,' the central projection resembles recent years and does not indicate a 2024-like epidemic; only three models incorporate climate variables, and results vary on magnitude and geographic spread. A six-state increase is anticipated: Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Mato Grosso do Sul, Sergipe, Acre and Minas Gerais; other states are expected to be stable or lower. Authorities urge ongoing surveillance and short-term forecasts; prevention focuses on eliminating standing water and mosquito habitats, with prompt medical care for fever, body pains, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョが2027年にブラジルのデング熱症例を増加させる可能性、フィオクルスが警告
triage.triage_reason: 2027年の将来予測に基づく研究報告であり、現時点での急激な異常事態や重篤な公衆衛生危機を示すものではないが、デング熱の流行可能性として継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は2027年の将来予測に関する研究発表であり、現在進行中の異常なアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。モデルによる推計であり不確実性が大きい（56万〜160万例の幅）。デング熱の季節的・気候変動関連の流行予測として、今後の実際の症例動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mapa identifica novo foco da doença de Newcastle em Nova Itaberaba (SC)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Map identifies a new focus of Newcastle disease in Nova Itaberaba (SC).
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease is laboratory-confirmed at a poultry establishment in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, within an already established sanitary restriction area. Confirmed on Saturday, November 7, this marks the fifth detection since the zoosanitary emergency was declared. Under the National Poultry Health Program, actions include epidemiological investigation, intensified surveillance, and containment by the Official Veterinary Service. For the three initial foci—Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim—response protocols are complete and the affected properties are under sanitary rest; the fourth focus, in Nova Erechim, is in the cleaning and disinfection phase. MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock) continues to collaborate with state agricultural defense agencies to control the outbreak and protect the national poultry industry.

triage.headline_ja: 農業畜産省、ノヴァ・イタベラバ(サンタカタリーナ州)でニューカッスル病の新たな感染拠点を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における動物疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は確認されていないが、養鶏産業への影響と感染拡大が継続している動物衛生上の懸念事項として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、ヒト感染症としての重大性は低い。ブラジル農業省（MAPA）による既存の衛生規制区域内での5例目の検出で、国家の対応体制下で管理されている。貿易制限（家禽輸出への影響）の可能性はあるが、ヒトの公衆衛生緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo confirma mais um foco de Doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Confirms Another Newcastle Disease Outbreak in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture at a commercial turkey-breeding farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The case was detected within an established sanitary-restriction area and does not change the trade restrictions limited to Santa Catarina. This is the fifth detection since the zoosanitary emergency was declared on 19 October. The outbreak occurred in a commercial turkey breeder operation; laboratory confirmation of the virus was returned on 7 November (Saturday). Overall, six Newcastle disease cases have been reported in commercial establishments in Brazil, with the first case recorded in July 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul (RS).

triage.headline_ja: 政府、サンタカタリナ州でニューカッスル病の新たな発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生で、既存の衛生規制区域内での検出であり人への健康影響は低いが、同一州での発生が継続しており貿易制限が維持されているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジル・サンタカタリナ州の商業用七面鳥繁殖場での家禽疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり、2024年7月以降の継続的な発生の一部（累計6例目、同州では5例目）。人への直接的健康リスクは低いが、貿易制限が継続しているため動向を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Governo confirma 5º foco da doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government confirms the 5th outbreak of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease, a highly contagious viral infection of birds, has a new outbreak confirmed on a farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina (SC), Brazil, within an existing sanitary restriction area. This marks the fifth outbreak detected since the zoosanitary emergency declaration in the state. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock reports ongoing epidemiological investigation and enhanced surveillance under the National Poultry Health Program, with the Official Veterinary Service implementing containment measures. In the three earlier foci—Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim—all required actions have been completed, and these properties are in a sanitary void (no animals). The fourth focus, in Nova Erechim, continues with cleaning and disinfection. The disease is described as a viral infection that spread easily among birds; authorities are coordinating containment to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 政府がサンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病の第5発生地点を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（鳥類のニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されておらず、当局により封じ込め対応が進行中であるため見送りとする。
triage.notes: 本疾患は鳥類のウイルス性感染症であり、ヒトへの感染・公衆衛生上の脅威は報告されていない。農業当局による家禽衛生プログラムの一環として封じ込め対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: MSF calls for Ebola vaccine access to expand
article.articleSummary: MSF calls for rapid expansion of access to an Ebola vaccine to tackle the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. More than 5,000 have died among nearly 11,000 cases, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history. There is no specific vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak, but trials are assessing Ervebo, approved for a more common Ebola strain, for cross-protection. MSF argues expanding access could protect more at-risk people. WHO recently launched a clinical trial in the DRC to test cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Since September, MSF has been vaccinating about 20,000 frontline workers in an observational study using Ervebo. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, with the WHO's PHEIC declaration two days later.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、エボラワクチンへのアクセス拡大を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最悪規模のエボラ流行（約11,000症例、5,000人超死亡）が継続中で、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: WHOは既に本流行に対しPHEICを宣言しており、史上最多規模の症例・死亡数。ワクチンアクセスの課題が国際支援の必要性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox aumentam no Brasil; veja os sintomas e os cuidados para prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases are rising in Brazil; see the symptoms and preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: 665 mpox cases were confirmed in Brazil in 2026, per November updates from the Ministry of Health; October recorded 119 confirmations. Although total cases are down 94% from 2022, when Brazil had over 10,000, prevention and early detection remain essential. Mpox, caused by the MPXV virus of the Orthopoxvirus genus (formerly monkeypox), can spread from animals to humans and mainly through direct contact with lesions, bodily fluids, mucous membranes, or contaminated objects; prolonged close respiratory contact also poses risk. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions on the face, hands, feet, genitals, or anal area that crust and fall off. Infected individuals should isolate until all lesions heal; illness typically lasts 2–4 weeks. Vaccination exists but is not for mass use; priority groups include severely immunocompromised individuals and exposed laboratory workers, with vaccination considered for others after health authority assessment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpox症例が増加；症状と予防策について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるMpox症例の継続報告であり、2022年比94%減少という既知の流行の推移を示す内容。新規の異常性や国際的拡大の兆候は見られないが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 保健省による月次統計報告の形式で、全体的に症例数は減少傾向にある。新規の緊急性は低いが、継続的なサーベイランス情報として注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará confirma 40 casos de mpox em 2026; Secretaria da Saúde reforça medidas de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará confirms 40 mpox cases in 2026; Health Department reinforces preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Ceará, Brazil, reports 40 confirmed cases in 2026 with no deaths and two hospitalizations as of 2026-11-09. The Ceará Health Department (Sesa) issued a technical note outlining symptoms, transmission, prevention, and the epidemiological context. Mpox is caused by MPXV; typical symptoms include fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy, followed by skin or mucosal lesions, rashes, blisters, or crusts on face, hands, mouth, genital, or anal regions. Incubation is 3–16 days, up to 21 days. Diagnosis is through laboratory testing available via the SUS. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact with lesions, wounds, crusts, or secretions; it can also spread during sexual contact, via shared personal items, or prolonged respiratory exposure. Most cases are mild to moderate with recovery in 2–4 weeks; higher risk for severe disease in immunocompromised individuals, pregnant people, and children. Since 2022, Sesa maintains surveillance, with IntegraSUS figures supporting the data.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州、2026年のmpox症例40件を確認；保健局が予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例なく重症例も限定的で、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、Mpoxは継続監視対象疾患であり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 2022年以降の継続サーベイランス下での症例報告であり、地域的な公衆衛生対応として管理されている模様。死亡なし、入院2件のみで重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil identifica novo foco da Doença de Newcastle na mesma área afetada de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Identifies New Newcastle Disease Outbreak in the Same Area Affected in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak identified in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, marking the fifth Newcastle detection since the state declared a zoosanitary emergency last month. The new focus is in the same area recently affected by the disease in Santa Catarina. The commercial impact on Brazil's chicken meat exports has been limited, as importing countries have regionalized embargoes to the local problem area. In October, chicken meat exports rose despite some embargoes due to the disease, according to ABPA. The report is based on a note from the Ministry of Agriculture, underscoring ongoing outbreak management and trade measures to localize restrictions while allowing broader exports to continue.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州の同じ被害地域で新たなニューカッスル病の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家きんのニューカッスル病（動物感染症）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。貿易影響も地域限定の禁輸措置に留まり管理下にある。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家きん（鶏）の疾患であり、ヒト感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは認められない。ブラジル農務省により地域限定の禁輸措置で輸出全体への影響は限定的と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de mpox quase triplicam no Rio e acendem alerta para sintomas e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases nearly triple in Rio and raise awareness about symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases in Rio de Janeiro state reached 269 from January through November 3, 2026, nearly triple the 92 in the same period in 2025, with no deaths this year. In Rio de Janeiro city, 2026 cases total 196, up from 94 in all of 2025. The Ministry of Health sent 2,000 additional vaccine doses to boost stocks and prevention, joining 953 doses already administered by November 2. Vaccination targets include people living with HIV with immunosuppression, exposed laboratory workers, and individuals with medium- or high-risk exposure to suspected or confirmed cases; the two-dose regimen has a 28-day interval and is not offered to the whole population. Early mpox symptoms include skin lesions that may appear with fever, headache, or lymphadenopathy; diagnosis relies on molecular testing from lesion material. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with lesions and not sharing personal items.

triage.headline_ja: リオ州でmpox症例がほぼ3倍に増加、症状と予防への警戒呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 死亡例はないものの症例数が前年比約3倍に増加しており、ワクチン追加配布など対策強化の動きがあるため経過観察が妥当。国際的拡大や渡航制限等の明確な根拠はない。
triage.notes: 症例数増加は地域限定的でブラジル保健省が自国対応中。死亡例なし、国際的支援要請の記載もないためPICKUPには至らずWATCH判定。

article.articleHeadline: Quinto foco de doença de Newcastle é confirmado em SC após novos exames em granja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifth Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in Santa Catarina after new tests on a farm.
article.articleSummary: Santa Catarina confirmed a fifth Newcastle disease outbreak on a poultry farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, within an established sanitary restriction area. The positive result was confirmed on Saturday, the 7th, during routine surveillance by the National Poultry Health Program, per Mapa. The Nova Itaberaba property lies inside restricted zone; containment actions under the zoosanitary emergency protocol are ongoing, including epidemiological investigation, intensified surveillance, and containment by the Official Veterinary Service (SVO). Of four prior foci, three have completed all response measures and are in a sanitary fallow period; the fourth, in Nova Erechim, is still undergoing cleaning and disinfection. First records occurred in Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Five of six sanitary barriers have been deactivated; one remains active. A 10-km radius surrounds the first focus; exports restrictions were reversed in 19 days. Human health risk is low; inspected poultry meat and eggs are safe.

triage.headline_ja: 新たな検査でサンタカタリーナ州の農場にてニューカッスル病の第5の発生地が確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（家禽ニューカッスル病）であり人health risk is lowと明記されているが、継続的な発生拡大（5例目）がみられ、貿易・畜産業への影響があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本疾患は家禽の動物衛生事案であり、人への健康リスクは低いと記事内で明記。ヒト感染症としてのRRA対象ではないが、畜産物貿易・輸出制限への影響があるため動物衛生当局としての継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 流感3毒株同時流行　中疾控稱無交叉保護力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains co-circulating; China CDC says there is no cross-protection.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are circulating in mainland China—A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and influenza B Victoria lineage—with no cross-protection between strains, meaning infection with one does not prevent infection with another. China CDC warns this co-circulation may increase short-term sequential infections and extend the season. National sentinel surveillance shows influenza-like illness (ILI) at 4.1% of emergency department visits from Oct 26 to Nov 1, with southern provinces higher than northern by 1.5 percentage points. Activity is fluctuating and rising, with A(H1N1) proportion increasing; the south is at moderate activity, the north at low but rising. Age pattern shows higher positivity among 5–14-year-olds. Laboratory data indicate 65.4% of confirmed influenza samples are Type A and 34.6% Type B; among Type A, 51.2% are A(H1N1)pdm09 and 48.8% A(H3N2).

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ3株が同時流行、中国疾病予防コントロールセンターは交差免疫なしと発表
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの複数株同時流行で感染拡大・季節延長の可能性が指摘されているが、重篤度や特異な異常性を示す情報は乏しく、通常の季節性サーベイランス報告の範囲内。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの定例サーベイランス報告であり、重症度や死亡者数についての具体的情報はない。複数株の同時流行により感染の長期化・拡大の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra casos leves de Covid-19 sem internações ou óbitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho reports mild cases of COVID-19 with no hospitalizations or deaths.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 remains stable in Porto Velho, Brazil, with 46 mild cases reported in epidemiological weeks 40–43 of 2026 and no hospitalizations or deaths during the period, per Semusa (Municipal Health Secretariat). The data are part of respiratory virus surveillance aligned with the Ministry of Health. Mayor Léo Moraes states indicators show the city is under control, enabling ongoing daily transparency in monitoring. Health Secretary Sandra Cardoso notes the increase is mild and within the public system’s capacity, not indicating population risk; Health Surveillance Director Geisa Brasil Ribeiro cautions that figures may change as new laboratory results are integrated. To sustain control, residents should keep COVID-19 vaccination up to date per age-based guidance, verifiable at any Basic Health Unit. For flu-like symptoms, follow hygiene measures and avoid close contact with vulnerable individuals; seek urgent care if shortness of breath or worsening symptoms occur.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョ市、新型コロナウイルスの軽症例を報告、入院・死亡なし
triage.triage_reason: 軽症例のみで入院・死亡なく、当局も「管理下」としており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の流行病であり、軽症46例・入院死亡ゼロという通常の季節性サーベイランス報告。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、本記事の内容はルーチンの公衆衛生報告でありピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra 832 casos e uma morte por Mpox em 2026, diz ministério - Sim Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records 832 cases and one death from Mpox in 2026, says the ministry - Sim News.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil totalled 832 confirmed cases and one death as of 8 November 2026, with the surge centered in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará, and the Federal District. Most cases are mild to moderate; deaths are rare but occur among high-risk, immunocompromised patients, such as people living with HIV/AIDS. Transmission occurs through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, and respiratory secretions during close, prolonged contact; sexual contact can also facilitate spread. Main symptoms are fever, malaise, body pains, lymphadenopathy, and evolving skin lesions that crust. The Health Ministry approved purchasing 25,000 Mpox vaccine doses via PAHO Revolving Fund; the stock has delivered 3,650 doses to nine states, including Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and the Federal District. Vaccination targets include adults with HIV/AIDS (CD4 <100 or <200), PrEP users, and lab workers; a two-dose schedule (28 days apart) is offered at Immunization Reference Centers, not mass vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年にMpox832例と死亡1例を記録と保健省が発表
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxは国内で継続的に報告されており重症度は低く国際的拡大のリスクも明示されていないが、ハイリスク層（HIV感染者等）での感染継続とワクチン接種拡大が進行中であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 保健省がワクチン接種プログラム（PAHO Revolving Fund経由）を実施中であり、既に管理体制が機能している模様。重症例は稀でHIV感染者などハイリスク層に限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Município registra 20 casos prováveis de dengue em 2026 | Barra do Pirai | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Municipality records 20 probable dengue cases in 2026 | Barra do Pirai | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Barra do Piraí reports 154 dengue notifications in 2026, with 134 discarded and 20 probable cases, amid rising Aedes aegypti activity that also transmits chikungunya and zika. Environmental surveillance recorded 44,200 eggs collected by ovitrampas and found larvae predominantly in residential settings (over 80%). Over 170,000 property visits have been conducted in 2026 to identify breeding sites and direct interventions; October figures remain partial. A Ministry of Health alert warns of potential arbovirus increases in 2026–2027 linked to El Niño, with dengue impact expected to be strongest in the Southeast. Public health guidance urges residents to spend at least ten minutes weekly inspecting homes and eliminating breeding sites such as yards, water tanks, gutters, plant pots, drains, tires, and other containers, emphasizing community participation to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: バーラ・ド・ピライ市、2026年にデング熱疑い症例20件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地方自治体によるデング熱サーベイランス報告であり、症例数は少なく(確定20例)、既知の風土病的状況で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルの地方自治体(バーラ・ド・ピライ)における通常のデング熱サーベイランス記事。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列とする。エルニーニョに関連した今後のアルボウイルス増加への注意喚起が含まれるが、現時点で規模は小さく特段の懸念は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Corguinho investiga leishmaniose em 22 pessoas de comunidades rurais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Corguinho investigates leishmaniasis in 22 people from rural communities.
article.articleSummary: Corguinho Health Secretariat identified 22 people with clinical signs of leishmaniasis across rural communities Furnas da Boa Sorte (quilombo), Assentamento Vista Alegre, and Zigurats, about 99 km from Campo Grande in Mato Grosso do Sul. From 38 collected samples, 22 results were labeled positive and 16 negative, but officials emphasize these 22 are clinically suspected cases, not confirmed by lab tests. Of the 22, 15 were referred for specialized clinical evaluation; six are in treatment and two have not yet started. An outreach event is planned for November 19 at 9:00 a.m. at Furnas da Boa Sorte to provide guidance and distribute 500 repellent units. Origins appear linked to residents arriving with signs from Dakla and Zigurats and exposure near forested areas. A woman with a leg lesion tested positive. Fogging was not authorized due to potential impacts on pollinators. In Zigurats, two rounds of canine blood tests were negative; Furnas da Boa Sorte will conduct further canine testing. No outbreak is declared.

triage.headline_ja: コルギーニョ、農村部の22人でリーシュマニア症を調査
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地方における疑い症例クラスターで、地元保健当局が調査・対応中。アウトブレイク宣言はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: リーシュマニア症はブラジル農村部で風土病的に発生する媒介者媒介感染症であり、本事例は地方保健当局による日常的な調査・対応（忌避剤配布、啓発活動）の範囲内。検査確定症例ではなく臨床的疑い例であり、アウトブレイク宣言もされていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'ONU alerte sur les conséquences des violences à Djugu dans la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: the UN warns about the consequences of violence in Djugu in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: UN humanitarian coordinator in the DRC, Alain Akpadji, voiced deep concern over violence since 8 November 2026 in Fataki health zone, Djugu territory, Ituri, threatening civilians and the Ebola response. In a 9 November 2026 statement, he condemned attacks on civilians and urged all parties to respect international humanitarian law, protect civilians and critical infrastructure, and facilitate aid access to save lives. On 8 November 2026, at least five civilians were injured near the Plaine Savo displacement site, with gunfire also reported in the town of Fataki about 25 km away. Ongoing insecurity has curtailed humanitarian access and suspended an in-progress needs assessment mission since late October. Plaine Savo hosts over 76,000 displaced people; health authorities, with partners, continue Ebola outbreak response in the region. Ituri, among the most affected provinces, accounts for about 70% of Ebola-confirmed cases and hosts the outbreak epicenter.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：国連、ジュグにおける暴力がエボラ対応に与える影響に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州（エボラ流行の震源地で確認症例の約70%を占める）で、治安悪化により人道支援とエボラ対応が妨げられており、IHR基準複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものの新規発生ではなく、既存流行地での治安悪化が対応活動に与える影響を報告するもの。7万6千人超の避難民が滞在するPlaine Savoサイト周辺での暴力により、ニーズアセスメントも中断。感染拡大リスクと支援活動継続性への懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Inteligência artificial avança no diagnóstico da tuberculose pediátrica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Artificial intelligence advances in the diagnosis of pediatric tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: TBPed, a multicenter Brazilian study led by Hospital Moinhos de Vento under PROADI-SUS, develops a machine-learning model to identify pediatric tuberculosis signals on chest radiographs. The project addresses diagnostic challenges in children under 15, where low bacillary load and sampling difficulties hamper confirmation and radiograph interpretation is constrained by limited sensitivity and few trained readers. Involving 27 centers across Brazil, 2,068 participants were enrolled: 1,288 hospitalized and 780 ambulatory. Among hospitalized, 54 TB diagnoses (41 laboratory-confirmed, 13 presumptive); among ambulatory, 143 TB diagnoses (38 lab-confirmed, 105 presumptive). The model trained on 2,068 chest X-rays (2,011 after quality control), with 197 TB cases (79 lab-confirmed, 118 presumptive). Internal AUROC: 0.744 (0.704–0.779). External validation: Brazil/public datasets AUROC 0.854; Peru 0.847; Cape Town, South Africa 0.543. Next steps: real-world validation and comparison with radiologists and large-language models to translate into a usable clinical tool as of 2026-11-09.

triage.headline_ja: 人工知能、小児結核の診断において進歩
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は小児結核診断のためのAI研究・技術開発に関する報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: ブラジル主導の多施設研究で、ペルー・南アフリカ（ケープタウン）のデータセットで外部検証を実施しているが、いずれも疾病流行事象ではなく研究報告。ペルー・南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Abogan por corredor de paz para garantizar respuesta a ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Advocates for a Peace Corridor to Ensure an Ebola Response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: On 9 November 2026, African CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya urged establishing a 'peace corridor' to secure the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), following an Islamic State–affiliated attack by Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) that killed about 30 civilians in Cantine-Aloya, North Kivu, and allowed Ebola patients to flee a health center. The violence disrupts care, contact tracing, and surveillance, with hundreds of people infected or suspected fleeing for safety. Kaseya emphasized that safe access to health care and the ability of health workers to provide essential services must be protected, and called on all parties to uphold international humanitarian law protecting health care and facilities, while expressing solidarity with the DRC population.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応確保へ『平和回廊』を訴え
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ対応中に武装勢力の襲撃が発生し、患者の逃亡や接触追跡・監視活動の中断を招いており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクを伴う異常事態と判断されるため。
triage.notes: 武装勢力ADFによる攻撃でエボラ患者が医療施設から逃亡し、接触追跡・監視が困難化。アフリカCDC長官が安全な医療アクセス確保のための『平和回廊』設置を訴えている。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox chega a 832 casos e uma morte no Brasil em 2026, com concentração no Rio, em São Paulo e no Ceará - CIC7 Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox reaches 832 cases and one death in Brazil in 2026, with concentrations in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo and Ceará - CIC7 News.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Brazil reached 832 cases and one death in 2026, per the Health Ministry (data released November 8). Outbreak concentrations are in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará, and the Federal District. Most infections are mild-to-moderate; fatalities are rare but possible among immunocompromised individuals, including people living with HIV/AIDS. Transmission is mainly by direct contact with skin lesions; body fluids and respiratory secretions can spread in close, prolonged contact, and sexual activity may facilitate transmission. Symptoms include fever, malaise, myalgias, lymphadenopathy, and evolving skin lesions that crust. Rio de Janeiro state reported 269 cases (Jan 1–Nov 3, 2026) with no deaths; Brazil totaled 665 that period. The government authorized 25,000 vaccine doses via the PAHO Revolving Fund; 3,650 doses have been dispatched to nine units. Vaccination targets: adults with HIV/AIDS (CD4 <100 or <200), PrEP users, lab workers, and medium/high-risk contacts; two-dose schedule, 28 days apart, at Immunization Centers. Not mass vaccination. Source: CNN Brasil.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで2026年のMpox症例が832件、死亡1件に達する - リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ州に集中
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxのヒト-ヒト感染（性的接触含む）が継続しており、政府がPAHO回転基金を通じてワクチン配布を実施するなど公的対応が明確であるため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的・行政的関心も高いと判断。
triage.notes: 政府保健省の公式データに基づく報告で、PAHO回転基金を通じたワクチン配布（25,000回分）が既に実施されており、公的な対応が進行中。重症度は低いが、継続的な感染拡大とHIV陽性者等の免疫不全者への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Washington exige aux voyageurs 21 jours hors de la RDC avant d'autoriser l'embarquement vers les USA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Washington requires travelers to spend 21 days outside the DRC before allowing boarding to the United States.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo triggers temporary U.S. travel restrictions. As of 9 November 2026, the CDC requires that travelers who have stayed in the DRC within the 21 days before departure, including those who only transited through a DRC airport, are barred from boarding flights to the United States. The rule applies to all travelers, including U.S. citizens, to reduce the risk of importing Ebola. The U.S. Embassy in Brazzaville disseminated the alert. Travelers denied boarding are advised to email [email protected] for assistance; correspondents should provide full name, date of birth, nationalities, contact details, passport details, flight information, and dates and locations of stays in RDC, Uganda, and South Sudan. The measure is described as temporary, with guidance for financial or consular assistance and lodging arrangements in a third country.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:ワシントン、米国への搭乗許可にはDRC出国後21日間の経過を渡航者に義務付け
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ発生を受け米国が渡航制限措置を実施しており、IHR基準の渡航・貿易制限および国際的拡大リスクに該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるエボラ流行に対する米国の渡航制限措置を報じている。コンゴ共和国(Brazzaville)は米国大使館の所在地として言及されているのみで、発生国はDRC。ウガンダ・南スーダンは渡航履歴申告先として言及されているが対象国リストに該当国なし（Sudan, Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれない）。

article.articleHeadline: மா்மநோய் தாக்குதலால் கோழிகள் இறப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickens die due to Marmnoi outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Marm disease in chickens near Mudikandanallur, Sembanakkovil area, Tamil Nadu, has caused significant mortality. Over the past week, more than 120 chickens have died, with birds showing respiratory symptoms over two days before death. There is concern the disease may be spreading from Kadalur district, where avian influenza has been reported, threatening Tarangambadi taluk. Reports indicate vaccination of chickens is conducted only on Saturdays, potentially increasing losses as birds are not vaccinated promptly. Veterinary department post-mortems found no avian influenza; deaths may be due to an influenza‑like virus, affecting unvaccinated flocks. No details on imported or exported birds were provided. Authorities are urged to take action to contain the outbreak and implement vaccination and surveillance measures.

triage.headline_ja: 原因不明の疾患（マーム病）流行によりニワトリが大量死
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州で鶏の大量死が発生しているが、獣医当局の解剖検査では鳥インフルエンザは否定されており、人への感染報告もないため直ちにフルRRAを要する段階ではないが、近隣で鳥インフルエンザが確認されていることから継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 鳥インフルエンザとして検出されなかったものの、近隣地域（Kadalur district）で鳥インフルエンザ確認済みであり、同種の呼吸器症状による鶏の大量死が続いている点から、病原体不明のインフルエンザ様ウイルスの拡大リスクを注視する必要がある。人への感染は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Volta da covid? Hospitais privados de SP relatam alta de casos da doença após alerta da Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Return of COVID-19? Private hospitals in São Paulo report a rise in COVID-19 cases after Fiocruz alert.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 and other respiratory syndromes are rising in São Paulo after a Fiocruz alert. From January through Nov 9, São Paulo recorded 356 COVID-19 cases, 104 ICU admissions, and 46 deaths. Beneficência Portuguesa reported 28 confirmed SARS-CoV-2 cases in October, with 7 in September and 3 in August. Hospital Santa Catarina-Paulista logged 98 positives in October, 57 in September, 18 in August. Hospital Nove de Julho reported a November uptick in demand due to respiratory syndromes. SES-SP SRAG panel shows COVID-19 increases from late October. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe flags growth of COVID-19–related syndromes in MT, DF, SP, RJ, SC, with rhinovirus and metapneumovirus circulating. Year-to-date in the state: 1,375 cases, 440 ICU admissions, 195 deaths; about 26% confirmations, 24% ICU admissions/deaths in the capital. City totals Jan–Nov: 1,123 cases, 387 ICU, 187 deaths; state totals: 4,338 cases, 1,402 ICU, 745 deaths. In 2026, 1,335,844 vaccines administered, mostly to children under one.

triage.headline_ja: コロナの再来？サンパウロの民間病院、フィオクルスの警告後にCOVID-19症例増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州でCOVID-19やメタニューモウイルス等の呼吸器症候群の季節的増加が報告されているが、新規・異常な病原体ではなく国際的拡大の兆候もないため、現時点ではフルRRAの必要性は低いが動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州における季節性のCOVID-19増加とフィオクルスの呼吸器症候群監視警告に関する国内サーベイランス報告であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報は含まれていない。メタニューモウイルスやライノウイルスとの同時流行が指摘されており、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: WHO / DRC EBOLA DIGNIFIED BURIALS
article.articleSummary: On 05 October 2026 in Jina, Fataki Health Zone, Ituri Province, DRC, WHO-supported Safe and Dignified Burial teams responded to a community death alert from Ebola. Teams explained the dignified burial process to the family, obtained consent, and, after donning full protective gear, secured the body in a body bag following swab collection for testing. The coffin was prepared and carried to the cemetery for burial, with team members undressing after sealing the coffin. The operation included disinfection of entrances and engagement with residents. Medical Director Dr. Danny Byaruhanga emphasized that community awareness led to acceptance of trained teams, helping to break the transmission chain. A father of a child who died from Ebola expressed relief that the burial was conducted by professionals. The report highlights ongoing Ebola-related SDB activities in Jina to reduce infection risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHO/DRC エボラ 尊厳ある埋葬
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対するWHO支援の安全な埋葬活動の報告であり、重症度・流行可能性・国際支援の必要性からIHR基準2項目以上該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO支援による埋葬活動の運用報告であり、新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの対応状況を示す。地域名'Jina'はDRC国内の地名であり対象国リストには含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsとした。

article.articleHeadline: Volta da covid? Hospitais privados de SP relatam alta de casos da doença após alerta da Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19's return? Private hospitals in São Paulo report a rise in COVID-19 cases after Fiocruz's alert.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 shows resurgence in São Paulo, Brazil, with private hospitals reporting rising respiratory syndromes linked to SARS-CoV-2. From January to Nov 9, 2026, São Paulo city tallies 356 COVID-19–associated respiratory illness cases, 104 ICU admissions, and 46 deaths; October alone saw 28 SARS-CoV-2 confirmations at Beneficência Portuguesa (Sept 7, Aug 3), and 98 positives at Hospital Santa Catarina-Paulista (Oct). Hospital Nove de Julho reported an unexpected early-November surge in demand due to respiratory syndromes. The SES-SP SRAG panel indicates COVID-19 uptick since late October. Fiocruz InfoGripe notes growth of respiratory syndromes in Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina; SARS-CoV-2, metapneumovirus, and rhinovirus are contributing, with rhinovirus and COVID-19 driving a sizable share of recent deaths (≈43% rhinovirus, ≈24.1% COVID-19). In SP state this year: 1,375 cases, 440 ICU, 195 deaths; city accounts for ~26% of cases and ~24% of hospitalizations and deaths. By 2026, 1,335,844 vaccines administered in the state, mostly to children under one year; authorities urge continued preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の再来？サンパウロの民間病院がフィオクルスの警告後に症例増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で季節性呼吸器疾患（COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス、ライノウイルス）の増加が報告されているが、既知病原体の国内流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州（市・州）における呼吸器疾患増加を報告。Fiocruz（ブラジル国立衛生研究機関）とSES-SPが監視データを公表しており、COVID-19・メタニューモウイルス・ライノウイルスの混合流行とされる。新規病原体ではなく既知のCOVID-19の季節的再流行のため、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは限定的とみられるが、死亡者数・ICU入院数の増加傾向は継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Volta da covid? Hospitais privados de SP relatam alta de casos da doença após alerta da Fiocruz | Tribuna de Petrópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19’s return? Private hospitals in São Paulo report a surge in COVID-19 cases after Fiocruz alert | Tribuna de Petrópolis
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 resurgence in São Paulo, Brazil, with private hospitals reporting rising SARS-CoV-2 activity after a Fiocruz alert. In the capital, January–Nov 9, 2026, 356 COVID-19 cases, 104 ICU admissions, and 46 deaths have been recorded. October figures include Beneficência Portuguesa with 28 confirmed SARS-CoV-2 cases; Santa Catarina-Paulista with 98 positives; and Nove de Julho reporting an early‑November surge in demand due to respiratory syndromes. The SES-SP SRAG monitoring panel shows COVID-19 upticks beginning in late October. Fiocruz’s InfoGripe notes growth in five states—Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina—with the Oct 25–31 period showing 8.5% SARS-CoV-2, 50.1% rhinovirus, 10.1% RSV, 4.2% influenza A, 4.7% influenza B; 43% of deaths were rhinovirus-related and 24.1% COVID-19. Year-to-date SP state totals: 1,375 cases, 440 ICU, 195 deaths; city accounts for about 26% of confirmations and 24% of deaths. Vaccinations in 2026 total 1,335,844, mostly in children under one.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の再来？ サンパウロの民間病院、フィオクルスの警告後に症例急増を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州でCOVID-19の季節的な増加が報告されているが、既知の病原体による国内の呼吸器サーベイランスの範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: 複数州（サンパウロ、リオデジャネイロ、サンタカタリーナ等）でCOVID-19・呼吸器疾患の季節的増加がFiocruzのInfoGripeにより報告されているが、ライノウイルスが主要な流行株であり、COVID-19単独の異常な急増とは言えない。続報の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Volta da covid? Hospitais privados de SP relatam alta de casos da doença após alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19's return? Private hospitals in São Paulo report a surge in COVID-19 cases after the alert.
