Year-to-date in SP state: 1,375 cases, 440 ICU, 195 deaths; city accounts for ~26% of confirmations and 24% of ICU admissions and deaths. Vaccination in 2026 totals 1,335,844 doses in the state, mainly in children under one year.

triage.headline_ja: コロナの再来？サンパウロの民間病院、警告後にCOVID-19症例の増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロでCOVID-19関連の重症呼吸器症候群（SRAG）が季節的に増加しているが、既知の病原体による通常範囲内の変動とみられ、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは認められない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: SES-SPおよびFiocruz InfoGripeによる通常の公衆衛生サーベイランス報告であり、COVID-19は既知の疾患。死亡例の多くはライノウイルス関連（43%）であり、COVID-19関連は24.1%。季節的な呼吸器症候群の増加としての位置づけが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: International Workshop Highlights Community Engagement to Control Aedes
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil hosted an international workshop in September 2025 on Strengthening North-South research cooperation in social sciences for protecting vulnerable populations from Aedes-borne diseases. It underscored that community engagement and social dynamics are central determinants of effective, equitable vector control for dengue, chikungunya, and zika transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, a threat intensified by climate change, rapid urbanisation, social inequalities, and weak public infrastructures. Technical vector-control innovations (e.g., Wolbachia and sterile insect techniques) require strong social science integration, local ownership, and adaptive governance to be sustainable. Case studies from Latin America, Africa, and Europe highlighted trust, locally grounded knowledge, participatory governance, and intersectoral collaboration; citizen science, participatory surveillance, and co-designed interventions improve data quality and acceptability of innovations, empowering communities to address structural exposure determinants. Integrating social sciences into One Health is essential for resilient, inclusive responses to arboviral threats.

triage.headline_ja: Aedes媒介疾患対策における地域社会の関与を強調する国際ワークショップ
triage.triage_reason: これは実際の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、Aedes媒介疾患対策に関する国際ワークショップの開催報告であり、具体的な症例増加や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はリオデジャネイロで開催された研究・政策ワークショップに関するものであり、特定の国でのアウトブレイク発生を報告するものではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra 832 casos e uma morte por Mpox em 2026, diz Ministério da Saúde - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records 832 Mpox cases and one death in 2026, says the Ministry of Health - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Brazil: The Ministry of Health reports 832 confirmed cases and one related death in 2026, with notifications rising chiefly in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará, and the Federal District. Most patients experience mild to moderate illness; severe disease and fatalities are less common, though risk is higher for immunocompromised people, including those living with HIV/AIDS. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions; other routes include bodily fluids and respiratory secretions during close, prolonged contact, and sexual contact. Common symptoms are fever, malaise, body aches, enlarged lymph nodes, and skin lesions at various stages that eventually crust. In response, Brazil authorized purchase of 25,000 mpox vaccine doses via PAHO’s Revolving Fund; 3,650 doses have been distributed to nine units, including Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and the Federal District. Vaccination follows two doses 28 days apart for those at medium/high risk, not mass vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル保健省、2026年のMpox症例832件・死亡1例を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でMpoxの継続的な症例報告と死亡例があり、HIV感染者など免疫不全者への重症化リスクや性的接触を含む人-人感染の可能性があるため、WPRO基準に複数該当し社会的関心（保健省公式発表）も認められる。
triage.notes: Mpoxは既知の継続流行であり新規性は低いが、脆弱層（HIV感染者等）への影響と性的接触を含む伝播経路への懸念からWPRO基準に該当。ワクチン調達はPAHO回転基金を通じた既存メカニズムであり、外部からの緊急支援要請には該当しないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil registra uma morte e 832 casos de mpox em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records one death and 832 mpox cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 832 mpox cases in 2026, including one death, as of 8 November 2026, per the Ministry of Health. The surge is concentrated in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Ceará, and the Federal District, with most infections mild to moderate. High-risk groups include people with low immunity (e.g., HIV/AIDS). Deaths are rare but possible in these groups. Mpox spreads mainly through direct contact with skin lesions; transmission can occur via body fluids and respiratory secretions during prolonged close contact, with sexual contact potentially facilitating spread. Symptoms include fever, malaise, body aches, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that progress to crusting. Brazil authorized 25,000 mpox vaccine doses via the PAHO Revolving Fund; about 3,650 doses have been distributed to nine states, including Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and the Federal District. Vaccination is targeted (not mass), two doses 28 days apart at immunization centers; close contacts may be vaccinated after assessment, and vaccination does not replace preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年に死亡1例と832例のサル痘（Mpox）症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準で複数該当（重症例の発生、持続的曝露、性的接触を含む流行しやすさ）し、保健省による予防接種対応など政府関心も見られるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（リオデジャネイロ、サンパウロ、セアラ州、連邦直轄区）での継続的なMpox流行状況の更新報告。HIV等免疫低下者における重症化・死亡リスクと、性的接触を介した感染拡大の可能性が指摘されている。ワクチン接種はPAHO回転基金を通じた自国対応であり、外部支援要請の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Brasil soma 908 casos confirmados e um óbito em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Brazil totals 908 confirmed cases and one death in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, Brazil reports 908 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 42 probable, 403 suspected, and one death. Rio de Janeiro leads with 368 confirmed/probable cases, followed by São Paulo with 332. The Ministry of Health has secured 25,000 mpox vaccine doses from a Danish manufacturer, with delivery in three weeks amid global shortages. Vaccination targets high-risk groups: people living with HIV/AIDS aged 18+ with CD4 counts under 100 cells/mm³; those with CD4 under 200; PrEP users; laboratory workers handling mpox samples; and all people living with HIV/AIDS regardless of CD4. Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headaches, body aches, chills, and weakness. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with lesions, fluids, or contaminated objects. Isolation is advised during the infectious period; hygiene and avoidance of shared items are essential. Treatment is supportive; no mpox-specific drug is available.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox：ブラジル、2026年累計で確定症例908件、死亡1例
triage.triage_reason: HIV陽性者など高リスク層における死亡例の発生とワクチン世界的不足下での対応が必要であり、WPRO基準（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: HIV/AIDS患者（特にCD4低値）を対象とした優先接種体制が組まれており、免疫不全集団への感染拡大リスクが懸念される。ワクチンはデンマークメーカーから調達予定だが、世界的供給不足のため納入に3週間を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 'मुझे फांसी दे दो, मैं जिम्मेदार हूं...', बांग्लादेश में खसरे से 1200 से ज्यादा मौतों पर बोले स्वास्थ्य मंत्री
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Hang me, I am responsible'... Health minister comments on more than 1,200 measles deaths in Bangladesh.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Bangladesh has claimed 1,284 lives, mostly children, as of 9 November, with 105 lab-confirmed deaths and 1,179 suspected. Over 240,000 suspected cases have been reported nationwide, of which 24,523 are lab-confirmed. Most fatalities involve infants under six months who were not vaccinated. Health Minister Sardar Mohammad Sakawat Hussain took personal responsibility, saying he should be hanged, and rejected claims that India supplied most vaccines; about 8% came from India, with the rest from Germany, Japan, Australia, the United Kingdom, South Korea, and Indonesia, verified by WHO and supplied by UNICEF. The BNP government blames the Yunus interim administration for vaccination delays; a three-member commission is investigating. Emergency vaccine stocks ran out, and mass campaigns have been paused since 2020 due to political turmoil in 2024. An emergency vaccination drive with international support is now underway.

triage.headline_ja: 「私を絞首刑にしろ、私が責任者だ」...バングラデシュの麻疹による1200人以上の死亡に保健相が発言
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹により1,284人（主に乳幼児）が死亡し、24万人超の疑い症例が報告される重大な公衆衛生事案であり、IHR基準2つ以上・WPRO基準複数該当、社会的関心も高い。ただし発生国バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれない。
triage.notes: 実際の発生国はバングラデシュであり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には含まれない。記事中のインド・インドネシア・日本・韓国・オーストラリア・ドイツ・英国はワクチン供給国として言及されているのみで、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Testes positivos para Covid aumentam em hospitais de São Paulo; entenda o cenário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Positive COVID-19 tests rise in hospitals in São Paulo; understand the situation.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo records rising COVID-19 diagnoses in recent weeks, driven by October hospital data. At Hospital Sírio-Libanês, positive tests climbed to 70 in October (vs 19 in September and 12 in August); Hospital Santa Catarina - Paulista logged 98 positives in Oct (vs 57 in Sep, 18 in Aug). NIES data show upticks in the capital since late September, with sharper increases in October. Cumulatively through November 6, 2026, São Paulo state had 348 cases and 45 deaths; in 2025 the totals were higher (1,099 cases, 185 deaths). Fiocruz’s InfoGripe (Nov 5) notes a national rise in severe Covid cases, with São Paulo among states with a 95% probability of increasing. Sequencing of 2,199 samples (weeks 1–43) identified 127 lineages; no single variant explains the rise. Large events may boost transmission. Vaccination remains the primary strategy; schedules include: 6 months–<5 years three doses; 60+ every six months; pregnant each gestation; immunocompromised semiannual; comorbidities annual. Vaccines available at UBSs and AMAs/UBSs Integrated.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの病院でコロナ陽性検査が増加、その背景を解説
triage.triage_reason: 季節的なCOVID-19症例増加だが、既知の病原体で新規変異株の特定もなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。引き続き動向を注視する。
triage.notes: COVID-19の季節的増加であり、既存の対策（ワクチン接種等）で対応可能とみられる。新規変異株の特定はなく、127系統が混在。重症例の増加傾向はあるが既知の病原体による季節性変動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Scoping review maps mucormycosis risks across diabetes and COVID-19
article.articleSummary: Rhino-orbital-cerebral mucormycosis (ROCM) is mapped across four subgroups: diabetic patients with COVID-19, diabetic without COVID, non-diabetic with COVID, and non-diabetic without COVID. In 258 patients drawn from 155 studies (124 case reports, 31 case series) published between 2010 and August 2025, Asia, led by India, accounted for the majority of cases. Diabetes mellitus was the most common comorbidity (70.9%), with prior COVID-19 in 38.4%. Early presentation featured nonspecific sinonasal symptoms; black eschar was rare (0–9.2%). Ocular involvement was frequent, with ophthalmoplegia: 55.3% in diabetics with COVID versus 35.7% without. Radiology using the Ebaid classification showed most cases at Stage IV–V (orbital to skull base/brain). Treatments combined surgical debridement with systemic antifungal therapy, predominantly liposomal amphotericin B, with posaconazole or isavuconazole as alternatives. Mortality ranged 44.3–64.3%, highest in non-diabetic, COVID-associated cases (64.3%). Evidence is descriptive, underscoring need for earlier detection and standardized staging.

triage.headline_ja: 糖尿病とCOVID-19におけるムコール症リスクを地図化したスコーピングレビュー
triage.triage_reason: 2010年〜2025年の文献レビューであり、新規の公衆衛生イベントや急性発生ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de covid-19 na UPA de Divinópolis chegam a 92 em 23 dias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 cases at the Divinópolis UPA reach 92 in 23 days.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases at Divinópolis Emergency Care Unit (UPA Padre Roberto Cordeiro), Brazil, total 92 over 23 days (Oct 18–Nov 9): 45 staff and 47 patients tested positive. Transmission within the facility remains under investigation. The Municipal Health Secretariat (Semusa) says there is no evidence of a citywide outbreak; the rise is localized to the UPA. Of the 92 cases, 64 are Divinópolis residents and 28 are from other cities. Vaccination uptake is described as low, with emphasis on updating vaccination cards. Context notes include 85 city-wide cases by Oct 20 with no deaths reported at that time, and earlier counts of 72 notifications with 54 confirmed (19 patients, 35 staff) around Nov 4–6. Data sources and dates vary, and Semusa/UPA will continue monitoring and act if the situation changes.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスのUPA（緊急医療ユニット）でCOVID-19症例が23日間で92件に達する
triage.triage_reason: 単一医療施設内での局地的なCOVID-19集団発生で、当局は市全体の流行とは認めておらず、死亡報告もないため、IHR・WPRO基準の該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 施設内クラスターであり、当局（Semusa）が市全体の流行を否定している。死亡報告なし。COVID-19は既知の疾患でありIHR新規性基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox cases under control, infections 'only sporadic'
article.articleSummary: Mpox remains under control in Thailand as of 9 November 2026, with infections occurring sporadically and no evidence of widespread community transmission. Clade Ib has replaced Clade IIb as the dominant strain detected. Most cases involve men aged 18-49; risk factors include sexual contact, exposure to infected household members, and attending parties with infected individuals. Transmission is mainly via close physical or sexual contact, contaminated clothing and towels, and prolonged exposure to respiratory droplets. Suspected cases should isolate, avoid sexual contact, and seek medical attention. Confirmed patients may isolate at home with physician approval but must remain isolated until all lesions have healed. The rise in cases since mid-2026 is noted but remains limited to sporadic cases.

triage.headline_ja: タイにおけるエムポックス感染、「散発的」で管理下にあると発表
triage.triage_reason: クレードIbがIIbに取って代わり優勢株となったことは疫学的に注目すべき変化だが、現時点では散発的で地域内流行の証拠はなく、重症度や国際的拡大の情報も不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: クレードIbの優勢化は国際的に懸念されるMpox系統であり、今後の症例増加や性的接触以外の伝播経路の有無について続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas inicia semana de mobilização para combater o Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas kicks off a week of mobilization to combat Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Campinas launches the 2nd Municipal Week of Mobilization to Combat Arboviruses (Aedes aegypti) from 9 to 14 November 2026 to intensify prevention and control of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The campaign aims to preempt vector proliferation amid climate change and El Niño, which may raise temperatures and alter rainfall. The intersectoral Municipal Arboviroses Committee coordinates actions across health, education, public works, civil defense, housing, social assistance, environment, culture, and more, with citizen and brigadista participation pivotal to eliminating breeding sites. Highlights include the Dengue Brigade (≈220 members) conducting over 2,000 inspections in more than 560 municipal buildings; a house-to-house citywide campaign on 14 November, including removal of waste, cleaning of drains, and safe storage of recyclables. Targeted neighborhoods include Jardim Santo Antônio and Parque Eldorado dos Carajás, among others; activities run daily with educational outreach and intra-secretariat coordination.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス市、ネッタイシマカ対策の動員週間を開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防啓発・ベクター対策キャンペーンであり、具体的な症例急増や異常事態の報告がないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はカンピーナス市による季節性のデング・ジカ・チクングニア予防キャンペーン（蚊対策動員週間）の広報であり、具体的な感染者数増加や異常な流行報告は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde libera R$ 524 mil para combater sarampo no Amazonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health releases R$ 524 thousand to combat measles in Amazonas.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Health allocated 524,000 reais to reinforce measles control in Amazonas—specifically Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, and Tabatinga. The funds will support vaccination campaigns, epidemiological surveillance, and transmission-blocking measures, transferred in a single installment from the National Health Fund to municipal accounts. The action complements intensified vaccination efforts launched on November 7 in these municipalities and São Paulo de Olivença, with emphasis on ports, riverine communities, and Indigenous areas. Of 65 imported measles cases confirmed in Brazil in 2026, 21 are in Amazonas (Tabatinga 9, Benjamin Constant 6, São Paulo de Olivença 4, Atalaia do Norte 2). Brazil has not had endemic measles transmission since 2024; in 2019 there were more than 20,000 cases. Health authorities maintain active case finding, monitoring, and vaccination to prevent renewed transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、アマゾナス州の麻疹対策に52万4千レアルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾナス州で輸入麻疹症例21例が確認され政府が対策予算を投入しているが、国内は非流行状態であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は現時点で限定的。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 輸入症例が主体で、先住民・河川地域など感染リスクの高い集団への対応として政府が予算措置を実施。国内伝播再燃のリスクはあるが、現時点で重症度や国際拡大の明確な情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mais da metade dos casos de SRAG no Acre é registrada em crianças menores de 5 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than half of SARI cases in Acre are recorded in children under 5 years old.
article.articleSummary: In Acre, 1,669 Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) records were reported, with about 53% in children under five (884 cases; 660 under two). The under-two group includes 405 boys and 255 girls; ages 2–4 total 224 (134 boys, 90 girls); 5–14: 187; 15–49: 196; 50–64: 116; 65+ : 286 (152 females, 134 males). Males predominate at 56%. Racial distribution: pardos 83.9%, indigenous 10.9%, whites 3.8%, blacks 0.8%, yellows 0.2%; unknown 0.4%. Mean age 24; median 7 years. Identified pathogens include influenza A (unsubtyped) 65; adenovirus 53; influenza A(H1N1) 18; influenza A(H3N2) 9; influenza B 2; bocavirus 3; COVID-19 28 (Rio Branco 10; Cruzeiro do Sul 9). SARI not specified: 932 cases with 23 deaths; under investigation 88. Overall outcomes: 97.25% recovered, 2.75% died. Rio Branco leads non-specified SARI (367 cases, 16 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州のSARI症例の半数以上が5歳未満の子どもで記録されている

triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・アクレ州における定期的なSARIサーベイランスデータの報告であり、既知の季節性病原体（インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19、アデノウイルス等）の通常範囲内の分布を示している。特段の異常発生や新規病原体の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Merck Ebola Vaccine Urged for Wider Use Against Bundibugyo Outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-09, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) urges wider deployment of Merck’s Ebola vaccine Ervebo in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s escalating Bundibugyo outbreak, citing emerging evidence that the shot may protect against Bundibugyo ebolavirus despite being developed against the Zaire strain. Ervebo was developed against the Zaire ebolavirus strain; MSF argues broader use could bolster outbreak response given potential cross-protection. The article does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or specific infection sources. The emphasis remains on extending vaccine access to curb transmission in the DRC outbreak, with ongoing questions about cross-strain effectiveness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行に対しメルク社エボラワクチンの広範な使用を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が拡大中とされ、国際機関（MSF）がワクチン展開拡大を求めるなど公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクが認められるため、フルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事には症例数・死亡数・検査確定情報が記載されておらず、流行の規模や重症度の詳細は不明。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチン（ザイール株用）の交差防御効果についても未確定。

article.articleHeadline: 加拿大查获逾万瓶中国药物 检出危险细菌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Canada seizes over 10,000 bottles of Chinese medications; pathogenic bacteria detected.
article.articleSummary: Over 11,400 injectable drugs imported from China were seized by Health Canada after being sold online domestically; the products lacked Canadian approval and were supplied by Shanghai ERP Peptide Biotechnology Co. Ltd. Two Canadian online retailers, True North Bio Labs and BC Axiom Peptide, sold them; both sites have been shut down. Some samples tested positive for bacteria, including Burkholderia cepacia complex, risking serious infections, especially for immunocompromised individuals. The seized items include Tirzepatide, Retatrutide, MOTS-C, Tesamorelin, and NAD+, none approved for sale in Canada. Health Canada, with the Canada Border Services Agency, obtained court authorization to seize and stop further shipments. Unapproved peptide injections may lack safety, efficacy, and quality data; potential contamination with bacteria or heavy metals; possible infections, blood sugar disturbances, hormonal imbalances, and liver/kidney injury. If used, seek medical advice; monitor for fever, injection-site redness or pain.

triage.headline_ja: カナダで1万本超の中国製薬品を押収、危険な細菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: カナダでの未承認注射薬（ペプチド製品）の押収・細菌汚染に関する規制対応の記事であり、対象国（中国含む）における実際の感染症患者発生は報告されていない。また疾患名Melioidosisは誤分類（検出菌はBurkholderia cepacia complexでBurkholderia pseudomalleiではない）。
triage.notes: 製造元はShanghai（中国）だが、実際の細菌汚染検出・製品押収・規制対応はカナダで発生しており、対象国リストにCanadaは含まれないため verified_locations は空。また疾患分類（Melioidosis）は検出菌（Burkholderia cepacia complex）と一致せず誤分類の可能性が高い。感染症の人への実害（患者発生）報告はなく、消費者安全・規制上の事案として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba registra queda de 73% nos casos graves de Covid-19 em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba records a 73% drop in severe COVID-19 cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Paraíba, Brazil, records a 73% drop in severe COVID-19 cases in 2026 compared with 2025, based on January 1 to November 7 data from the State Health Secretariat (SES-PB). In 2026, there were 98 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) notifications linked to COVID-19, down from 364 in the same period of 2025. The state maintains ongoing surveillance of respiratory diseases. SES-PB emphasizes vaccination, hand hygiene, and mask use for those with flu-like symptoms to reduce transmission. The report highlights progress in limiting severe disease, while surveillance remains active to detect potential outbreaks and to guide public health measures in Paraíba.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、2026年の新型コロナウイルス重症例が73%減少
triage.triage_reason: 重症例の大幅減少を報告する内容であり、公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性は見られず、社会的関心も高くない。
triage.notes: 記事は改善傾向を示す定期報告であり、トリアージ対象となる新規または深刻な公衆衛生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Suspeita de sarna humana causa suspensão de aulas em escola de Vespasiano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected human scabies leads to suspension of classes at a school in Vespasiano.
article.articleSummary: Suspected human scabies leads to school suspension in Vespasiano, Minas Gerais. Escola Municipal de Ensino Especial Vovó Mariquita suspended classes until Nov 11 after confirmation of one scabies case. Health and Education secretariats ordered preventive measures for students, staff, and families; classes will resume on Nov 12. As of 2026, the state health secretariat reports 11 scabies outbreaks in Minas Gerais, in Alfenas, Andradas, Belo Horizonte, Campos Gerais, Coronel Xavier Chaves, Itapecerica, Joaquim Felício, Lagoa Santa, Lavras, Paraguaçu, and São Gonçalo do Pará. Scabies is a skin disease caused by a mite, with intense itching and lesions. Transmission occurs mainly via prolonged skin-to-skin contact; sharing clothes, towels, or bedding can spread it. Hygiene is not the cause, and it is not spread by coughing or sneezing. Seek health care if symptoms appear; close contacts should be treated if advised; no preventive medication, and return to school depends on professionals’ guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬の疑いによりヴェスパシアーノの学校で授業停止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性が低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない一般的な皮膚疾患であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はダニによる皮膚疾患で人から人への濃厚接触で感染するが重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低い。ミナスジェライス州で複数の発生が報告されているが地域的な公衆衛生対応の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Covid voltou? Entenda o novo surto de casos no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has Covid returned? Understand the New Outbreak of Cases in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 cases rise in Brazil, with 118,920 infections recorded in 2026 as of November 4, across 19 federative units: Alagoas, Bahia, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Espírito Santo, Goiás, Maranhão, Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Paraíba, Pernambuco, Piauí, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro, Rondônia, Roraima, Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and São Paulo. The Ministry of Health and Fiocruz’s InfoGripe describe the trend as expected and of low alarm. Infectious-disease expert Lilian Ávilla notes that COVID-19 maintains a stable seasonal pattern and persists in the population, with incidence rates monitored to flag spikes. Public health actions emphasize vaccination to reach herd immunity and, if cases rise, potential multi-state immunization campaigns. Regionally, the Southeast reported the most COVID-19-like cases, while the Central-West recorded the highest incidence per 100,000 inhabitants.

triage.headline_ja: コロナは戻ってきたのか？ブラジルにおける新たな症例急増を理解する
triage.triage_reason: 保健省・フィオクルスは季節的変動の範囲内で警戒度は低いと評価しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の症例増加であり、保健当局は『予想内・低警戒』と評価。ワクチン接種推進が対応策として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Artsen zonder Grenzen dringt aan op breder gebruik van Merck Ervebo-vaccin bij Bundibugyo-uitbraak in Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders Urges Broader Use of Merck's Ervebo Vaccine in Bundibugyo Outbreak in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered on Bundibugyo, reports 10,920 confirmed infections and 5,323 deaths as of 7 November 2026 (largest Ebola outbreak in the country and second-largest globally). Doctors Without Borders (MSF) urges expanded access to Merck’s Ervebo vaccine (Zaïre ebolavirus) beyond current targets, to include more at-risk groups such as young children, despite Ervebo being developed for the Zaïre strain. Early field observations show reduced mortality and fewer confirmed infections among those vaccinated before this outbreak, suggesting possible cross-protection, though not proven against Bundibugyo. MSF notes Ervebo is already administered under trials and calls for fewer restrictions; 500,000 doses were requested from the international stock, but only 70,000 released. WHO vaccine advisory group meets next week to decide on expanded use. Bundibugyo-specific vaccines by Oxford and Moderna are expected to join the Tumaini study after national approvals.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴのブンディブギョ型エボラ流行に対しメルク社のエルベボワクチンの幅広い使用を強く求める
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模（確認感染10,920例、死亡5,323例）のエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）流行が継続しており、国際的なワクチン供給・対応が焦点となっている重大な公衆衛生イベントであるため。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは言及されておらずコンゴ国内（ブンディブギョ地域）が主題のため除外。致死率約49%と非常に高く、ワクチン供給不足（要求50万回分に対し7万回分のみ放出）が国際的懸念となっている。

article.articleHeadline: Casos graves de covid sobem em cinco estados; Rio tem falta de vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe COVID-19 cases rise in five states; Rio de Janeiro faces a vaccine shortage.
article.articleSummary: Severe COVID-19 cases rise in five Brazilian states, with Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Mato Grosso, Santa Catarina, and the Federal District showing upticks, per Fiocruz weekly bulletin. Overall incidence remains very low, but risk of severe illness, hospitalizations, and deaths persists; vaccination remains essential. In Rio de Janeiro city, vaccine shortage caused temporary stockouts as demand surged; 21,000 new doses were sent by the Ministry of Health to replenish supply, with prioritization to high-traffic vaccination sites to stabilize service. Authorities urge immediate vaccination for those never vaccinated or needing boosters. Target groups include: people aged 60+, pregnant and puerperal individuals, children 6 months–4 years, immunosuppressed patients (e.g., cancer therapy), and those with comorbidities or permanent disabilities. Surveillance and coordination to prevent future interruptions continue.

triage.headline_ja: 5つの州で新型コロナ重症例が増加、リオデジャネイロではワクチン不足
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患（COVID-19）の季節的増加とワクチン供給の一時的不足に関する国内保健当局の通常対応であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていないが、ワクチン供給状況は継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 既知の季節的COVID-19動向とワクチン供給管理の記事であり、新規変異株や異常事態の報告はない。保健省による迅速な補充対応がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू मरीजों को परेशान कर रही यह खतरनाक बीमारी, इग्‍नोर करना पड़ सकता है भारी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This dangerous disease troubling dengue patients could prove costly if ignored.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in India continues to surge, with Delhi at the center of concern. Across Delhi, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, and Kolkata, dengue cases rise after the monsoon, with liver-related problems reported among patients. In Delhi, doctors say 6–10 dengue admissions daily, and most patients are aged 20–40. Capillary leak syndrome—where plasma leaks into surrounding tissues causing swelling and a rise in blood pressure—emerges as a major complication; without timely treatment it can be fatal. Early dengue symptoms highlighted include irritability, fatigue, abdominal pain, muscle aches, excessive thirst, and sudden weight gain. The outbreak has affected thousands and led to several deaths across states. As of 9 November 2026, dengue remains a significant public health challenge in India, underscoring the need for early recognition and timely medical care to prevent progression to capillary leak and liver complications.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者を悩ませるこの危険な病気、無視すると重大な結果を招く可能性
triage.triage_reason: インド複数州（デリー、ビハール、ウッタル・プラデーシュ、コルカタ）でデング熱が流行し、重症合併症（毛細血管漏出症候群）による死亡例も報告されており、重症度・継続的曝露・流行しやすさの基準に該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: インドで毎年季節的に発生するデング熱の記事だが、重症合併症（毛細血管漏出症候群）や肝障害、死亡例の報告があり、医療現場の負荷が示唆される。ただし新規性・国際的拡大リスクは低く、既知の季節性疾患である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Melioidosis Antibody Response Persists Years After Infection
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis antibody responses persist for years after infection, according to a Lancet Microbe retrospective cohort study from UC Davis and Mahidol University. In Thailand, researchers followed individuals after confirmed Burkholderia pseudomallei infection and found antibody levels against two diagnostic targets remained detectable long term, meaning positive antibody tests may reflect past exposure rather than current disease. Melioidosis, a serious infection transmitted through contact with soil and surface water contaminated with Burkholderia pseudomallei, causes fever, stomach pain, seizures and has a 10–50% fatality rate. Historically endemic in northern Australia and Southeast Asia (notably northeast Thailand), its geographic range appears expanding; in 2022 the CDC linked human cases in Mississippi to soil and water, signaling establishment in the continental US, with rising reports in South Asia and Africa. Climate change may broaden suitable environments, underscoring need for surveillance and clinician awareness.

triage.headline_ja: メリオイドーシス抗体反応は感染後何年も持続する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染後の抗体反応持続性に関する研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究論文（Lancet Microbe掲載、UC Davis・マヒドン大学共同）であり、タイにおける既知の流行地域での過去症例を対象とした抗体持続性研究。気候変動による地理的拡大への言及はあるが、具体的な新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国リストに該当する国があってもイベントとしての発生は確認できず、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance Study Details Rapid Spread and Severe Complications of
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus (Orthobunyavirus oropoucheense) surveillance from 1955 to early 2025 shows rapid spread beyond the Amazon with sustained transmission across South and Central America and imported infections in North America and Europe. Primary vector is Culicoides paraensis, with possible secondary vectors including Culex quinquefasciatus and several mosquitoes (Aedes serratus, Psorophora cingulata, Haemagogus tropicalis). After its 1955 isolation in Trinidad, the 1961 Belém urban outbreak (~11,000 cases) preceded Brazilian spread to Pará, Amapá, Amazonas, Maranhão and Goiás, with Brazil reporting about 500,000 infections (likely underestimated). International introductions began 1989 (Panama) and spread to Peru, Bolivia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Haiti, Colombia, French Guiana, and Cuba (2024). A late-2021 sublineage drives 2023–2025 activity; 2024 autochthonous Brazilian cases were 13,784 across 22 states, led by Espírito Santo and Rondônia. Outside Brazil: Peru 1,263; Cuba 626; Bolivia 356; plus imports to the United States and several European countries; WHO raised alert to high in August 2024. Severe disease includes confirmed vertical transmission with fetal deaths and congenital anomalies, aseptic meningitis, encephalitis, and deaths in healthy adults. Deforestation, land-use change, urbanization, and climate warming fuel vector expansion.

triage.headline_ja: サーベイランス研究、オロプーシュウイルスの急速な拡大と重篤な合併症の詳細を報告
triage.triage_reason: オロプーシュウイルスは垂直感染による胎児死亡・先天異常、脳炎などの重症例を伴い、南米域内で急速に拡大、北米・欧州への輸入例もあり、WHOが2024年8月に警戒レベルを「高」に引き上げている。IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は1955年から2025年初頭までの長期サーベイランスをまとめたレビュー研究であり、速報的な単一アウトブレイクではない。主発生地はブラジルで、ペルー・ボリビア・キューバ・パナマ等への拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。2021年末に出現した新亜系統が2023-2025年の活動を牽引しており、ベクター拡大の背景には森林破壊・都市化・気候変動が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ca cúm A, sốt xuất huyết tăng, bệnh viện phải kê thêm giường ra lối đi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A case, dengue fever on the rise, hospitals forced to place extra beds in the corridors
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases and dengue fever are rising, forcing Vietnamese hospitals to place extra beds in corridors and bolster physicians to treat severe cases. The report notes intensified patient care as respiratory and vector-borne illnesses surge, with hospital capacity stretched by the dual outbreaks. No specific numbers on cases or deaths are provided. The piece emphasizes the strain on healthcare facilities and the need for heightened clinical management and staffing to handle severe influenza A and dengue fever. The information comes from VOV.VN, with no laboratory confirmation details or infection sources disclosed in the article. The date of publication is 2026-11-10, reflecting ongoing public health concerns in the country.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAとデング熱の症例増加、病院は廊下に追加ベッドを設置
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のインフルエンザAとデング熱の増加により病院の収容能力が逼迫しているが、具体的な症例数・死亡者数や異常性を示す情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 具体的な症例数・死亡者数・流行規模のデータがなく、インフルエンザAとデング熱は共に季節性の既知疾患であるため異常性は低いと判断。ただし病院のキャパシティ逼迫は公衆衛生上の懸念材料であり、続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao một người có thể mắc bệnh sốt xuất huyết Dengue tới 4 lần?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why can a person contract Dengue fever up to four times?
article.articleSummary: Vietnam reports all four dengue serotypes circulating nationwide (DENV-1 to DENV-4). From January 2026 through 10 November 2026, there have been over 170,000 suspected dengue cases and 21 deaths. Dengue is now year-round, not seasonal, due to climate change, increased rainfall, and urbanization that sustain Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. DENV-1 and DENV-2 remain predominant (about 90% of cases); DENV-3 has re-emerged after 2020–2024. Immunity to one serotype does not protect against others, allowing up to four infections per person, with sequential infections raising the risk of severe disease. Vector control is difficult because mosquitoes persist and long-running control programs waned after 2020; resource gaps at local health facilities hinder response. Surveillance tools exist, but early outbreak detection and a synchronized, multi-sector response are essential. Risk spans children, adults, and the elderly with underlying conditions.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ一人の人がデング熱に4回もかかることがあるのか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで2026年に17万件超の疑い症例・21名の死亡が報告され、4血清型が同時流行し季節性を失い通年化している異常な状況であり、WPRO基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAでの精査が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は解説記事的内容だが、年間17万件超の疑い症例・21名死亡、4血清型同時流行、季節性喪失、DENV-3再興、ベクター対策体制の弱体化など複数の懸念材料が含まれており、国内公衆衛生上のリスクとして注視が必要。国際伝播リスクは低い（蚊媒介性のため）。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Chagas: Sete casos são confirmados em Óbidos; 33 são monitorados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chagas disease: Seven cases have been confirmed in Óbidos; 33 are being monitored.
article.articleSummary: Seven acute Chagas disease cases and one death have been confirmed in Óbidos, western Pará, Brazil, linked to an outbreak tied to artisanal patauá wine. Thirty-three residents who drank the suspected beverage remain under monitoring. A health task force visited Vila Liberdade for new exams; authorities issued an interdiction order and seized the fruit-processing equipment. Endemic vectors and samples of the suspected fruit are being collected for lab analysis. Fiocruz and Hospital Tropical de Manaus assist, with Diacho procedures to speed diagnosis. Thick-blood smear and serology are complemented by tests, with samples sent to Belém’s lab. Acute Chagas symptoms include fever, headache, abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, and nausea, and can resemble malaria or dengue. Exposure occurred after ingestion between Sept 21 and Oct 2; fruit harvested in Breu and processed at Vila Liberdade. Treatment with Chagas medication is underway; two patients hospitalized, four on home care, 26 under monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: シャーガス病：オビドスで7例確定、33人が経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: 食品（パタウア椰子酒）媒介による急性シャーガス病の集団発生で、死亡1例・確定7例・監視中33人を確認。経口感染による集団発生は稀でIHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を満たす。
triage.notes: 原因食品（パタウア椰子の果実加工品）の摂取による経口感染が疑われ、ヒト-ヒト感染ではない。Fiocruzおよびマナウス熱帯病院が協力して対応中であり、既に原因食材の押収・処理場閉鎖などの措置が取られている。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、症例の異常性と死亡例の発生からシグナルとして注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil contabiliza 832 casos de mpox e uma morte em 2026; Ministério da Saúde compra 25 mil vacinas - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil records 832 mpox cases and one death in 2026; Ministry of Health buys 25,000 vaccines - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports 832 mpox cases and one death in 2026 (data through November 6). To curb rising notifications, the Health Ministry bought 25,000 vaccine doses (20,000 initially, plus 5,000 via PAHO); 3,650 doses have been distributed to nine states and the Federal District, with Rio de Janeiro and Ceará among areas with higher counts. Mpox is transmitted mainly by close contact, especially with skin lesions; standard hygiene and avoiding contact with suspected cases are advised. Vaccination targets HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 <100 cells/mm3 (two-dose schedule, 28 days apart) and may also cover those with CD4 <200, PrEP users, and laboratory workers, with intradermal administration to stretch doses. Compared with the 2022 outbreak (~10,500 cases, 14 deaths), 2026 shows about 92% fewer cases and deaths; 2025 had ~1,000 cases, 2 deaths, and 58 hospitalizations. International vaccine supply is limited due to single-Denmark production; doses bolster the national stock.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2026年にmpox832例・死亡1例を記録；保健省がワクチン2万5千回分を購入
triage.triage_reason: HIV陽性者など脆弱な集団を含むmpoxの継続的な国内流行があり、政府がワクチン調達・配布で対応中であることから、WPRO基準の複数該当と行政的関心の高さが確認される。
triage.notes: 2022年流行時と比較し症例数・死亡数は約92%減少傾向にあり、既存のアウトブレイクへの継続対応という性質が強い。新規異常事象ではないが、HIV患者等への感染拡大リスクと政府の積極的なワクチン対応を踏まえPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Где в мире можно заразиться оспой обезьян?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Where in the world can you contract monkeypox?
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox risk persists in popular destinations such as Thailand, Spain, the United Kingdom, and other countries, but infection likelihood hinges on close contact rather than travel route, according to Dr. Murad Shakhmardanov, Doctor of Medical Sciences and professor at Pirogov University. The World Health Organization reports the highest recent cases in Africa in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Angola, Kenya, and Cameroon, with historically large foci in DRC, Uganda, and Sierra Leone. Cases also occur in Europe (Spain, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy) and in Asia (Thailand). In 2026, reports include Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador, Singapore, Norway, Costa Rica, Ghana, and Lithuania. A recent imported case in Russia involved a man hospitalized in Domodedovo after returning from Barcelona; it was the fourth case in the past month. Symptoms include fever, signs of systemic toxicity, lymphadenopathy, followed by a characteristic rash; risk is higher for immunocompromised individuals, pregnant women, and young children.

triage.headline_ja: 世界のどこでサル痘（エムポックス）に感染する可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: 記事は既知のエムポックス流行状況に関する一般的な解説記事であり、新たな突発的事象ではないが、複数国での継続的な人-人感染が示唆されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事はロシアの医師による一般的な渡航リスク解説であり、新規の具体的アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。タイ、ガーナ、DRCは記事内で実際の症例発生国として言及されているため対象国リストに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos graves de covid-19: o que fazer diante da suspeita da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in Severe COVID-19 Cases: What to Do When COVID-19 Is Suspected
article.articleSummary: Rising SRAG cases due to COVID-19 were reported by Fiocruz InfoGripe. Mato Grosso, Distrito Federal, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro and Santa Catarina showed the largest increases. In the four most recent weeks, 8.5% of SRAG cases tested for respiratory viruses were due to SARS-CoV-2, which accounted for 24.1% of SRAG-related deaths. Clinician Carlos Aita notes cyclical waves of contagion; most cases are not severe thanks to vaccination, and there is no immediate pandemic threat. The elderly, children, immunocompromised and those with diabetes remain at risk. Prevention centers on vaccination; verify vaccination cards and follow age-specific schedules, says Tatiana Portella of Fiocruz. Symptoms include fever, cough, fatigue, dyspnea, myalgia, headache, sore throat and congestion. For suspected cases, wear a mask and seek medical care for testing (COVID-only, influenza A/B plus COVID, rapid tests ~15 minutes; labs test for >20 pathogens). Mild cases hydrate, rest, antipyretics/analgesics; severe cases require hospitalization.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス感染症の重症例増加：感染が疑われる場合の対処法
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でCOVID-19による重症呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例と死亡の増加が報告されているが、臨床医は周期的な流行波であり差し迫ったパンデミック脅威はないと明言しており、IHR基準は満たさない。重症化・死亡の報告はあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（マットグロッソ州、連邦直轄区、サンパウロ州、リオデジャネイロ州、サンタカタリーナ州）における季節的なCOVID-19重症例増加に関する一般的な医療情報・啓発記事であり、Fiocruzの臨床医はパンデミックの新たな脅威ではないと明言している。既存の季節性波動の範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Aumento de casos graves de covid-19: o que fazer diante da suspeita da doença | Tribuna de Petrópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in Severe COVID-19 Cases: What to Do When COVID-19 Is Suspected | Tribuna de Petrópolis
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-10, Fiocruz's InfoGripe reports a rise in COVID-19–related severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) across Brazil, led by Mato Grosso, the Federal District, São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, and Santa Catarina. In the last four monitored weeks, 8.5% of SRAG cases tested for respiratory viruses were due to SARS-CoV-2, which accounted for 24.1% of SRAG deaths in that period. Clinician Carlos Aita notes cyclical waves of transmission; most infections are not severe in a heavily vaccinated population. The elderly, immunocompromised, children, and those with comorbidities (e.g., diabetes) remain most at risk, with respiratory illnesses progressing quickly in the elderly. Vaccination is the principal preventive measure; verify complete immunization per age group. Symptoms include fever, cough, fatigue, dyspnea, myalgia, headache. If symptoms arise, wear a mask, seek medical care, and be tested. Mild cases treat with hydration, rest, antipyretics; severe cases require hospitalization. Flu still causes more deaths than COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: 重症COVID-19症例の増加：疾患が疑われる場合の対処法 | Tribuna de Petrópolis
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の季節的な増加を報じる一般的な公衆衛生啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19の周期的な流行波とワクチン接種の重要性を説明する健康啓発記事であり、既知の病原体による季節的変動の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: बांग्लादेश में खसरे का कहर, मौत का आंकड़ा 1200 पार, स्वास्थ्य मंत्री ने स्वीकार की नाकामी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Ravages Bangladesh; Death Toll Surpasses 1,200; Health Minister Admits Failure.
article.articleSummary: Measles ravages Bangladesh, with 1,284 deaths reported as of 9 November, mostly infants under six months. In the latest 24-hour update, two suspected deaths occurred in the Dhaka and Chattogram divisions, raising suspected deaths to 1,179 and confirmed deaths to 105; total confirmed cases stand at 24,523 from 240,199 suspected cases nationwide. Since 15 March 2026, hospitals have admitted 214,251 measles patients, with 205,383 recovered. An emergency vaccination drive is ongoing with international assistance, yet outbreaks persist. Vaccination supply has been contested; Health Minister Sardar Mohammad Sakawat Hossain said only 8% of vaccines came from India, with the rest from Germany, Japan, Australia, the UK, South Korea, and Indonesia, inspected by WHO and supplied via UNICEF. The minister took personal responsibility, while critics blame past administrations for delaying routine campaigns; a three-member commission was formed to probe.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹猛威、死者1,200人超え、保健相が失敗を認める
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュで麻疹による死者が1,284人に達し、確定・疑い症例合わせて26万人超と甚大な公衆衛生被害が発生。IHR基準で「深刻な影響」「異常性」の2項目が該当し、国際的なワクチン支援も行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Hospitais de SP têm alta de casos de covid
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospitals in São Paulo report a surge in COVID-19 cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 9 November 2026, hospitals in São Paulo report a rise in cases of respiratory syndromes associated with COVID-19. In the capital, January–yesterday recorded 356 COVID-19 cases, 104 ICU admissions and 46 deaths. Beneficência Portuguesa de São Paulo reported 28 confirmed SARS-CoV-2 cases in October, 7 in September, and 3 in August, still below the same period last year (October 33, September 70, August 32). Hospital Santa Catarina logged 98 positive cases in October (57 September, 18 August); Hospital Nove de Julho reported an early-November uptick in demand due to higher respiratory-syndrome activity. The SES-SP SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) monitoring panel showed rising COVID-19 cases from late October. Authorities urge continued transmission-prevention measures: cover coughs or sneezes with the inner elbow and wash hands regularly. The city’s municipal health secretariat did not respond to requests for comment.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロの病院でCOVID-19症例が急増

article.articleHeadline: Mudanças climáticas já causam aumento de doenças infecciosas no país - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change is already causing an increase in infectious diseases in the country - Jornal O Sul.
article.articleSummary: Climate change is driving dengue expansion in Brazil, with Rio Grande do Sul registering nearly 210,000 confirmed dengue infections and 281 deaths in 2024, and Bahia about 163,000 cases and 188 deaths. A Fiocruz study (2006–2024) found epidemic dengue microregions rose from 110 to 292, representing about 54% of the country, suggesting irreversible expansion once the virus and vector are introduced. The spread tracks warmer temperature anomalies that alter mosquito biology. Dengue outbreaks are reaching cooler regions and even autochthonous cases have occurred in the continental United States; France and Italy reported autochthonous cases as well. Oropouche fever surpassed 12,000 infections in 2023 across 23 states and the Federal District. Leptospirosis spikes followed floods, notably in Rio Grande do Sul, while hantavirus cardiopulmonary syndrome has 530 infections and 212 deaths since 2016. El Niño forecasts may worsen extremes.

triage.headline_ja: 気候変動がすでに国内の感染症増加を引き起こしている - Jornal O Sul紙
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内でデング熱、オロプーシュ熱、レプトスピラ症、ハンタウイルス肺症候群が気候変動に伴い拡大し、多数の死者が報告されており、国際的な拡大（米国・欧州での自然発生例）も言及されているためIHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動による複数のベクター媒介・人獣共通感染症（デング熱、オロプーシュ熱、レプトスピラ症、ハンタウイルス肺症候群）の拡大傾向を分析したもので、主にブラジル国内の長期的データに基づく。米国・フランス・イタリアでの自然発生例も言及されているが、対象国リストには含まれないため除外。
